accepted: One reason why many households do not sort their rubbish is that the rules are confusing.
One reason many households do not sort their rubbish is that the rules are confusing.
One reason that many households do not sort their rubbish is that the rules are confusing.
One of the reasons why many households do not sort their rubbish is that the rules are confusing.
One of the reasons many households do not sort their rubbish is that the rules are confusing.
Many households do not sort their rubbish partly because the rules are confusing.
Many households do not sort their rubbish because the rules are confusing.
criteria: 原句 One reason … is because … 语义重复（reason 已经含“因为”的意思）。必须把 is because 改为 is that，或改写成不含 reason 的因果句（如 Many households do not sort their rubbish partly because the rules are confusing.；直接用 because 也可以接受，但最好用 partly because 保留“原因之一”的含义）。须保留“规则令人困惑导致很多家庭不做垃圾分类”的意思。只删除 why 或把 why 改成 that、却保留 is because 的，判错；改成 is due to 的，同样判错。其他正确改动都可以接受。
hints: 关注 reason 后面、is 之后的那个连接词。
reason 本身已经表示“原因”，后面再用一个表示“因为”的词就重复了。
is 后面应该换成一个只负责引出表语从句、本身没有“因为”意思的连接词。
explanation: 中文“原因之一是因为……”译成英语会造成语义重复：reason 已经是“原因”，is because 又说“是因为”。学术写作中应用 is that 引出表语从句：One reason why many households do not sort their rubbish is that the rules are confusing. 这种 is because 在英美口语里也常听到，但在 IELTS/TOEFL 等正式写作中被视为不规范。
focus: 原因表达冗余（reason…is because 等）

instruction: 选出填入空白处最恰当、最符合学术写作规范的一项。
content: Bee populations have fallen sharply in many farming regions. ______ farmers are using more pesticides, many of which are harmful to bees.
options: The reason is because
This is why
This is because
The reason is due to
option_explanations: 不规范：reason（原因）和 because（因为）语义重复，相当于“原因是因为”，正式写作中应避免，应写成 The reason is that。
错误：This is why 意为“这就是……的原因”，后面接的是结果。填进去就变成“蜜蜂减少导致农民使用更多农药”，因果方向颠倒，也和后半句“这些农药对蜜蜂有害”对不上。
正确：This is because 意为“这是因为”，前一句是结果（蜜蜂减少），空白后是原因（农药增多），因果方向正确，表达也规范。
错误：due to 是介词，后面不能接完整的句子；而且 The reason is due to 同样是语义重复（“原因是由于”）。
hints: 先判断：空白前后两部分中，哪个是原因，哪个是结果？
reason 后面再接 because 或 due to 会重复“原因”的意思；this is why 和 this is because 引出的内容方向相反。
空白后面引出的是“原因”，选一个既不重复、因果方向又正确的说法。
explanation: 中文“原因是因为……”直译成 The reason is because…，会造成语义重复；The reason is due to… 同理，而且 due to 后面不能接句子。在“结果。______ 原因。”这种结构里，应该用 This is because…（这是因为）；This is why… 用于“原因。This is why + 结果。”。正确：Bee populations have fallen sharply in many farming regions. This is because farmers are using more pesticides, many of which are harmful to bees. 也可以写 One reason is that farmers are using more pesticides…
focus: 原因表达冗余（reason…is because 等）

instruction: 下面的句子有一处中式句型错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Even though online courses allow students to study at their own pace, but many learners find it difficult to stay motivated without a teacher.
accepted: Even though online courses allow students to study at their own pace, many learners find it difficult to stay motivated without a teacher.
Although online courses allow students to study at their own pace, many learners find it difficult to stay motivated without a teacher.
Though online courses allow students to study at their own pace, many learners find it difficult to stay motivated without a teacher.
While online courses allow students to study at their own pace, many learners find it difficult to stay motivated without a teacher.
Online courses allow students to study at their own pace, but many learners find it difficult to stay motivated without a teacher.
Online courses allow students to study at their own pace, yet many learners find it difficult to stay motivated without a teacher.
Online courses allow students to study at their own pace; however, many learners find it difficult to stay motivated without a teacher.
Online courses allow students to study at their own pace. However, many learners find it difficult to stay motivated without a teacher.
Many learners find it difficult to stay motivated without a teacher, even though online courses allow students to study at their own pace.
Many learners find it difficult to stay motivated without a teacher even though online courses allow students to study at their own pace.
Many learners find it difficult to stay motivated without a teacher, although online courses allow students to study at their own pace.
criteria: 原句 Even though 和 but 同时使用。必须删去 Even though 或 but 中的一个（也可以改用 although / though / while / yet / however 等其他正确的让步或转折表达），保留全部信息和让步关系。删去 Even though 时，句首的 online 要大写为 Online，but 前的逗号保留。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意都可以接受（如 difficult 换成 hard）；如果仍然同时保留 even though（或 although/though）和 but，判错。
hints: 这个句子比较长，先找出表示“尽管”和“但是”的两个连接词。
even though 和 although 一样表示让步，不能再和 but 在同一句中成对使用。
只保留其中一个连接词；如果删去句首的那个，记得把新的句首字母大写。
explanation: even though 和 although 一样引导让步从句，语气更强，但同样不能再和 but 搭配。句子越长，学生越容易在后半句“补”一个 but 来对应中文的“但是”。正确：Even though online courses allow students to study at their own pace, many learners find it difficult to stay motivated without a teacher. 或 Online courses allow students to study at their own pace, but many learners find it difficult to stay motivated without a teacher.
focus: 让步/因果连词成对使用

instruction: 选出语法正确的一项。
options: Every summer, there are thousands of volunteers helping to run the city's music festival.
Every summer, there are thousands of volunteers help to run the city's music festival.
Every summer, there are thousands of volunteers are helping to run the city's music festival.
Every summer, there are thousands of volunteers they help to run the city's music festival.
option_explanations: 正确：helping 是现在分词（非谓语），作后置定语修饰 volunteers，相当于 who help，句中只有 are 一个谓语。
错误：help 是谓语动词，和 are 在同一个分句里，构成双谓语。
错误：are helping 又是一个谓语，和前面的 there are 构成双谓语。
错误：they help 是一个新的主谓结构，直接接在 volunteers 后面，既重复了主语，又形成双谓语；应改为 who help 或 helping。
hints: 四个选项都保留了 there are，区别只在 volunteers 后面的动词形式。
there are 已经是谓语，后面修饰名词的动词只能用非谓语形式或从句，不能再出现一个谓语动词。
想一想：除了定语从句，还有哪种动词形式可以放在名词后面修饰它，同时又不算谓语？
explanation: There be 句型本身没有错，错在后面又接了一个谓语动词。名词后面可以用 -ing 分词（helping）或定语从句（who help）来补充信息，因为它们都不是这个分句的谓语。正确：Every summer, there are thousands of volunteers helping to run the city's music festival. 也可以写 Every summer, thousands of volunteers help to run the city's music festival. 中国学生受“有……人在做……”的影响，常写成 there are + 名词 + 动词原形 / are doing。
focus: There be + 名词 + 谓语动词（双谓语）

instruction: 选出没有中式句型错误的一项。
options: Small mountain villages, the money that tourists spend there often helps to preserve traditional crafts.
The money that tourists spend in small mountain villages often helps to preserve traditional crafts.
The money that tourists spend in small mountain villages, it often helps to preserve traditional crafts.
Tourists spend money in small mountain villages often helps to preserve traditional crafts.
option_explanations: 错误：先摆出话题 Small mountain villages，再接一个完整句，是中文“山村，游客花的钱……”的话题-评论结构；Small mountain villages 在句中没有任何语法作用。
正确：主语 The money that tourists spend in small mountain villages（中心词 money + 定语从句）只出现一次，谓语 helps 和单数主语一致。
错误：长主语后面又用 it 复指，主语重复。
错误：Tourists spend money in small mountain villages 是完整句，不能直接作主语，句中出现了 spend 和 helps 两个谓语。
hints: 找出每个选项中谓语 helps 的主语究竟是什么。
英语句子不用“话题 + 评论”结构，长主语后不能用代词复指，完整句也不能直接作主语。
把“游客在山村花的钱”整体做成一个名词短语作主语，看哪个选项做到了，并且谓语前没有多余成分。
explanation: 这道题集中了三种中式主语问题：话题-评论结构（Small mountain villages, …）、长主语后用 it 复指、完整句直接作主语。英语要把“游客在山村花的钱”整体做成一个名词短语作主语：中心词 The money 加定语从句 that tourists spend in small mountain villages，后面直接接谓语 helps。正确：The money that tourists spend in small mountain villages often helps to preserve traditional crafts.
focus: 话题-评论结构与主语代词复指

instruction: 下面的句子有一处中式句型错误（用完整句直接作主语），请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Many drivers do not slow down when they pass primary schools is a serious concern for parents.
accepted: The fact that many drivers do not slow down when they pass primary schools is a serious concern for parents.
That many drivers do not slow down when they pass primary schools is a serious concern for parents.
It is a serious concern for parents that many drivers do not slow down when they pass primary schools.
Many drivers do not slow down when they pass primary schools, which is a serious concern for parents.
Many drivers do not slow down when they pass primary schools. This is a serious concern for parents.
Many drivers do not slow down when they pass primary schools; this is a serious concern for parents.
Many drivers do not slow down when they pass primary schools, and this is a serious concern for parents.
The failure of many drivers to slow down when they pass primary schools is a serious concern for parents.
Many drivers' failure to slow down when they pass primary schools is a serious concern for parents.
Parents are seriously concerned that many drivers do not slow down when they pass primary schools.
criteria: 原句把完整句 Many drivers do not slow down when they pass primary schools 直接当作主语，句中出现了 do not slow down 和 is 两个谓语（when 从句里的 pass 属于从句）。这个小句带否定（do not），直接改成动名词很别扭，常用的改法有：在句首加 The fact that（或 That）构成主语从句；用形式主语 It is a serious concern for parents that…；让小句独立成句，再用“, which is…”或句号/分号 + This is… 补上评论；改成名词短语（The failure of many drivers to slow down…）；或改成 Parents are seriously concerned that…。须保留“很多司机经过小学时不减速”和“这让家长非常担忧”两层意思。用动名词改写（Many drivers not slowing down when they pass primary schools is…）语法上成立但较生硬，也可判对。其他语法正确、意思不变的改法都可以接受；如果一个分句里仍有两个谓语、写成“…schools, this is…”（逗号连句），或者只在 schools 后加逗号，判错。
hints: 找出谓语 is，再看它前面的部分是一个名词短语，还是一个有自己谓语的完整句。
完整句不能直接作主语；这个小句里有否定词 do not，很难直接改成 -ing 形式。
可以在句首加上几个词，把整个小句变成主语从句；也可以先让它独立成句，再用 which 或 This 来评论它。
explanation: 中文“很多司机经过小学时不减速是家长非常担心的问题”可以直接用小句作主语，但英语里 Many drivers do not slow down when they pass primary schools 是完整句（有自己的谓语 do not slow down），不能再直接作 is 的主语。这个小句带有否定，改成动名词很别扭，最常用的办法是加 the fact that，把它变成名词性从句：The fact that many drivers do not slow down when they pass primary schools is a serious concern for parents. 也可以用形式主语 it：It is a serious concern for parents that many drivers do not slow down when they pass primary schools. 或者让小句独立成句，再加评论：Many drivers do not slow down when they pass primary schools, which is a serious concern for parents.
focus: 完整句或动词原形直接作主语

instruction: 下面的长句有一处中式句型错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: There are several factors in the current property market contribute to the soaring cost of housing in major cities, including limited land supply and speculative investment.
accepted: Several factors in the current property market contribute to the soaring cost of housing in major cities, including limited land supply and speculative investment.
Several factors in the current property market have contributed to the soaring cost of housing in major cities, including limited land supply and speculative investment.
There are several factors in the current property market that contribute to the soaring cost of housing in major cities, including limited land supply and speculative investment.
There are several factors in the current property market which contribute to the soaring cost of housing in major cities, including limited land supply and speculative investment.
There are several factors in the current property market that have contributed to the soaring cost of housing in major cities, including limited land supply and speculative investment.
There are several factors in the current property market contributing to the soaring cost of housing in major cities, including limited land supply and speculative investment.
criteria: 原句主干是 There are several factors … contribute to …，are 和 contribute 两个谓语在同一个分句里（介词短语 in the current property market 只是修饰 factors）。必须删去 There are（让 Several factors… 作主语），或在 contribute 前加 that/which 构成定语从句，或把 contribute 改为 contributing。须保留 in the current property market 和 including limited land supply and speculative investment 表达的信息，以及“多种因素推高大城市房价”的意思。时态改为 have contributed 等其他正确改动都可以接受；如果仍保留 There are … contribute 结构，或删掉信息导致意思不完整，判错。
hints: 先暂时去掉修饰 factors 的介词短语，再看句子的主干。
主干里 there are 后面又出现了一个谓语动词，同一分句不能有两个谓语。
可以去掉句首的结构，让 factors 直接作主语；也可以把后面的动词改成非谓语形式或从句。
explanation: 介词短语 in the current property market 把 factors 和 contribute 隔开了，双谓语因此更难发现。去掉修饰成分后，主干是 There are several factors contribute to…，和 There are many people think… 是同一种错误。最简洁的改法是删去 There are：Several factors in the current property market contribute to the soaring cost of housing in major cities, including limited land supply and speculative investment.；也可以写 There are several factors … that contribute to / contributing to …。
focus: There be + 名词 + 谓语动词（双谓语）

instruction: 选出没有中式句型错误的一项。
options: Expensive as the new treatment is, but it has already saved thousands of lives.
Although expensive as the new treatment is, it has already saved thousands of lives.
Although the new treatment is expensive, but it has already saved thousands of lives.
Expensive as the new treatment is, it has already saved thousands of lives.
option_explanations: 错误：“形容词 + as + 主语 + be”本身就是让步状语（= although it is expensive），后面再加 but，就和 although…but 一样重复表达了让步转折。
错误：Expensive as… 已经表示“尽管”，前面再加 Although 就是双重让步，结构混乱。
错误：Although 和 but 同时使用，是“虽然……但是……”的直译。
正确：Expensive as the new treatment is 是倒装形式的让步状语从句，意为“尽管这种新疗法很贵”，主句前不再加 but。
hints: 留意每个选项里有几处表达“尽管/但是”的成分，包括不那么明显的结构。
“形容词 + as + 主语 + 动词”放在句首时本身就表示让步，相当于一个 although 从句。
表示让步转折的成分在整个句子里只能出现一次，看哪个选项做到了。
explanation: Expensive as the new treatment is 等于 Although the new treatment is expensive，是正式文体中的让步倒装结构。它已经包含“尽管”的意思，所以后面不能再加 but，前面也不能再加 although。这和 although…but 的错误本质相同：中文“虽然……但是……”让学生习惯成对使用让步词和转折词。正确：Expensive as the new treatment is, it has already saved thousands of lives. 也可以写 Although the new treatment is expensive, it has already saved thousands of lives.
focus: 让步/因果连词成对使用

instruction: 选出标点最规范的一项。
options: If a city plants more trees along its streets summer temperatures can drop by several degrees.
If a city plants more trees along its streets; summer temperatures can drop by several degrees.
If a city plants more trees along its streets, summer temperatures can drop by several degrees.
If a city plants more trees along its streets. Summer temperatures can drop by several degrees.
option_explanations: 不规范：句首 If 从句结束后应加逗号与主句隔开。这里没有逗号，读者容易把 streets summer temperatures 连读成一串名词；学术写作中这个逗号建议一律加上。
错误：分号两边都必须是完整句，If 引导的从句不能独立成句，不能放在分号前。
正确：句首状语从句 + 逗号 + 主句。
错误：句号把 If 从句切成了一个残句（fragment），从句必须和主句写在同一个句子里。
hints: 先找出 If 从句在哪里结束、主句从哪里开始。
句首的状语从句要用一个标点与后面的主句隔开，但这个标点不能把从句变成独立的一句。
分号和句号前后都必须是完整句——“If a city plants more trees along its streets”能单独成句吗？
explanation: 句首状语从句（If… / When… / Because… / Although…）结束后加逗号，再接主句：If a city plants more trees along its streets, summer temperatures can drop by several degrees. 没有逗号时，读者会把 streets summer temperatures 连在一起读，一时分不清主句从哪里开始。从句不能独立成句，所以也不能用分号或句号把它和主句分开，否则会产生残句。中文“如果……，就……”本来也用逗号，但学生常因为“这半句很长，像一个完整的句子”而改用分号或句号，或者干脆漏掉标点。
focus: 句首引导成分后漏逗号

instruction: 下面的句子缺少一个标点，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Compared with their parents' generation young people today tend to get married much later.
accepted: Compared with their parents' generation, young people today tend to get married much later.
Compared to their parents' generation, young people today tend to get married much later.
Young people today, compared with their parents' generation, tend to get married much later.
Young people today, compared to their parents' generation, tend to get married much later.
criteria: 句首分词短语 Compared with their parents' generation 结束处（generation 与 young 之间）必须加逗号。parents' 的撇号本身是正确的（指“他们的父母”），不应改成 parent's 或 parents。用 compared to 代替 compared with，或把该短语移到主语之后并用一对逗号隔开，也可接受。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 这个句子的主语是什么？看看主语前面那一大段。
句首较长的分词短语或介词短语（Compared with…、Faced with…）是“开场白”，结束时要用标点和主句隔开。
parents' 的写法没有问题；问题出在开场白与主语交界的地方。
explanation: 句首的分词短语（Compared with…、Faced with…、Encouraged by…）属于引导成分，结束处加逗号，再接主句。没有逗号时，读者会把 generation young people 连读成一串名词，一时分不清主语从哪里开始。中文“与父母那一代相比，……”本来就有逗号，但英文短语较长时学生容易忘记在短语结束处停顿；也有学生把注意力放在撇号上，误以为 parents' 写错了——它是以 s 结尾的复数所有格，写法正确。正确：Compared with their parents' generation, young people today tend to get married much later.
focus: 句首引导成分后漏逗号

instruction: 下面的句子缺少一个标点，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: In countries where smoking in restaurants and bars has been banned the number of people admitted to hospital with heart attacks has fallen.
accepted: In countries where smoking in restaurants and bars has been banned, the number of people admitted to hospital with heart attacks has fallen.
In countries where smoking in restaurants and bars has been banned, the number of people admitted to the hospital with heart attacks has fallen.
The number of people admitted to hospital with heart attacks has fallen in countries where smoking in restaurants and bars has been banned.
The number of people admitted to the hospital with heart attacks has fallen in countries where smoking in restaurants and bars has been banned.
criteria: 句首介词短语 In countries where smoking in restaurants and bars has been banned（介词短语中包含限制性 where 定语从句）结束处，即 banned 与 the number 之间，必须加逗号。把这个短语移到句末（此时不加逗号）也可接受；admitted to hospital（英式）和 admitted to the hospital（美式）均可。如果把逗号加在 countries 后面（把限制性 where 从句和它修饰的 countries 隔开，意思变成“所有国家都禁了烟”），或加在其他位置，判错。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 先找到句子的主语和谓语：哪个名词短语后面跟着 has fallen？
句首这一大段（介词短语里还套着一个 where 从句）是“开场白”，结束时要用标点和主句分开。
读到 has been banned the number… 时会不会卡住？在开场白真正结束的地方停一下，注意不要把 where 从句和 countries 拆开。
explanation: 句首较长的介词短语也是引导成分，后面要加逗号。本句的开场白是 In countries where smoking in restaurants and bars has been banned（介词短语，里面还带一个 where 定语从句），主句从 the number of people… 开始。没有逗号时，读者读到 has been banned the number of people… 很容易卡住，要回头重读才分清主句在哪里。正确：In countries where smoking in restaurants and bars has been banned, the number of people admitted to hospital with heart attacks has fallen. 注意逗号不能加在 countries 后面：where 从句限定“哪些国家”，不能和 countries 隔开。也可以把这个短语移到句末：The number of people admitted to hospital with heart attacks has fallen in countries where smoking in restaurants and bars has been banned. 学生写长句时注意力集中在词汇和语法上，常常漏掉这个“分界逗号”。
focus: 句首引导成分后漏逗号

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: Many visitors love this old town because ______ narrow streets are full of history.
options: it's
its
its'
option_explanations: 错误：it's 是 it is / it has 的缩写，“because it is narrow streets are…”说不通。
正确：its 是物主代词，意为“它的（古镇的）”，和 his、her 一样不带撇号。
错误：英语中没有 its' 这种写法。
hints: 空格后面是名词 narrow streets，这里要表达“谁的街道”？
表示“它的”的词是物主代词；想想 his、her、our 这些物主代词有没有撇号。
把能还原的选项还原成两个词，代入句子读一读，能读通吗？
explanation: its = 它的（物主代词，没有撇号）；it's = it is / it has（缩写）。这里要表达“这个古镇的狭窄街道”，所以用 its：Many visitors love this old town because its narrow streets are full of history. 中国学生常把名词所有格“名词 + 's”的规则类推到代词上，写成 it's。判断方法：能换成 it is / it has 的才写 it's。
focus: 所有格撇号误用

instruction: 下面的句子有一处标点错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Many teachers' worry that students rely too heavily on AI tools to write their essays.
accepted: Many teachers worry that students rely too heavily on AI tools to write their essays.
Many teachers' main worry is that students rely too heavily on AI tools to write their essays.
criteria: 这里 worry 是谓语动词（worry that…“担心……”），teachers 是主语，只是普通复数，不是所有格，必须删去撇号改为 teachers。若学生把 worry 改作名词并补全句子（如 Many teachers' main worry is that…），只要句子正确、意思不变也可接受。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 检查句中带撇号的词，并找出这个句子的谓语动词。
撇号只用于所有格（谁的）和缩写；如果后面的词是动词，前面的名词就不是“谁的”。
worry 在这里是名词“担忧”还是动词“担心”？据此判断 teachers 后面是否需要撇号。
explanation: 撇号只有两种用途：所有格（the teachers' room）和缩写（it's, don't）。普通复数只加 -s，不加撇号。本句 worry 是谓语动词（worry that…“担心……”），teachers 是主语，所以应写 teachers：Many teachers worry that students rely too heavily on AI tools to write their essays. 学生看到 teachers 后面紧跟一个“看起来像名词”的 worry，容易误以为是“老师们的担忧”而加撇号；也有学生把 's 当成复数标记（如 smartphone's），英语中称为 greengrocer's apostrophe，在议论文中会显得很不严谨。
focus: 所有格撇号误用

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: Busy parents often have little time to help with their ______ homework.
options: childrens'
children
childrens
children's
option_explanations: 错误：children 已是复数，不能再加 s；把撇号放在 s 后面，是把规则复数的写法错误地套用到不规则复数上。
错误：缺少所有格标记，their children homework 不能表示“孩子们的作业”。
错误：没有 childrens 这个词，而且缺少撇号，无法表示所属。
正确：不以 s 结尾的不规则复数（children、people、women）所有格加 's。
hints: 空格要表达“孩子们的”，先写出 child 的复数形式。
复数所有格的写法取决于复数形式是否以 s 结尾。
children 是不规则复数，看看它最后一个字母是什么，再决定撇号放在哪里。
explanation: 复数所有格分两种：① 以 s 结尾的规则复数只加撇号：parents', students'；② 不以 s 结尾的不规则复数加 's：children's, people's, women's, men's。children 本身已经是复数，不存在 childrens。正确：Busy parents often have little time to help with their children's homework. 学生容易把“复数所有格 = s'”机械套用到所有复数上，写出 childrens'。
focus: 所有格撇号误用

instruction: 选出标点完全正确的一项。
options: Despite the government's new data protection rules, the platform still shares its users' personal information with advertisers.
Despite the government's new data protection rules, the platform still shares it's users' personal information with advertisers.
Despite the government's new data protection rules, the platform still shares its users personal information with advertisers.
Despite the governments new data protection rules, the platform still shares its users' personal information with advertisers.
option_explanations: 正确：government 是单数，所有格 government's；its 是物主代词“它的”，不带撇号；users 是以 s 结尾的复数，所有格只加撇号 users'。
错误：it's 是 it is 的缩写，这里需要物主代词 its（“平台的用户”）。
错误：users 后缺少撇号，users personal information 无法表示“用户们的个人信息”。
错误：governments 缺少撇号，不能表示“政府的新规定”；而且这里只指一个政府，应为单数所有格 government's。
hints: 四个选项只在撇号上有区别，逐一检查 government、its、users 三处。
单数名词所有格加 's，以 s 结尾的复数名词所有格加 '，物主代词不加撇号。
每处都问自己：谁的？一个还是多个？是名词还是代词？
explanation: 本句有三处所有格：① the government's new rules——一个政府，单数所有格加 's；② its users——“平台的用户”，物主代词 its 不带撇号（it's = it is）；③ users' personal information——“用户们的个人信息”，users 是以 s 结尾的复数，只加撇号。正确：Despite the government's new data protection rules, the platform still shares its users' personal information with advertisers. 中文一律用“的”表示所属，学生在长句中很容易漏掉撇号或把撇号放错位置。
focus: 所有格撇号误用

instruction: 下面的句子有一处标点错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Regular exercise has many benefits; such as better sleep and lower stress.
accepted: Regular exercise has many benefits, such as better sleep and lower stress.
Regular exercise has many benefits such as better sleep and lower stress.
criteria: 分号后面的 such as better sleep and lower stress 只是举例短语，不是完整句，不能用分号。须把分号改为逗号或直接删除。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 检查分号后面的部分。
分号前后两部分都必须能各自独立成句。
such as… 这部分有没有自己的主语和谓语？它能单独成句吗？
explanation: 分号相当于“弱句号”，两边都必须是完整句。such as better sleep and lower stress 是举例短语，没有谓语，不能放在分号后。正确：Regular exercise has many benefits, such as better sleep and lower stress.（such as 前的逗号也可以省略。）学生常以为分号比逗号“更正式、更高级”，或者把中文“，比如……”前的停顿看得很重，于是误用分号。
focus: 分号与连接副词误用

instruction: 选出标点完全正确的一项。
options: Online shopping saves a great deal of time, as a result, many people now rarely visit physical shops.
Online shopping saves a great deal of time; as a result, many people now rarely visit physical shops.
Online shopping saves a great deal of time; which is why many people now rarely visit physical shops.
Because online shopping saves a great deal of time; many people now rarely visit physical shops.
option_explanations: 错误：as a result 是连接性短语，不是连词，前面只用逗号连接两个完整句，构成逗号连句（comma splice）。
正确：分号两边都是完整句；as a result 放在第二个分句开头，后面加逗号。
错误：which is why… 是 which 引导的关系从句，不能独立成句，不能放在分号后面；应改为逗号：…time, which is why many people now rarely visit physical shops.
错误：Because 引导的是从句，不能独立成句，所以不能放在分号前；句首状语从句后应该用逗号：Because online shopping saves a great deal of time, many people now rarely visit physical shops.
hints: 每个选项都被一个分号或逗号分成两半，分别检查两半能不能各自独立成句。
分号两边都必须是完整句；as a result、therefore 这类连接语不是连词，也不能只靠逗号把两个完整句连起来。
which 从句和 Because 从句都不能独立成句；找出分号两边都是完整句、而且连接语后面标点也正确的那一项。
explanation: 分号相当于“弱句号”，两边都必须是完整句。as a result、therefore、however、nevertheless 是连接副词（短语），不能像 and、so、but 那样把两个完整句连成一句，所以前面要用分号或句号，后面加逗号：Online shopping saves a great deal of time; as a result, many people now rarely visit physical shops.（也可写作 …time. As a result, many people…）只用逗号是逗号连句；which is why… 是关系从句，Because… 是状语从句，都不能独立成句，所以不能放在分号的任何一边，应该用逗号和主句相连。中文“因此”“结果”前用逗号很正常，学生又常把分号当作“更正式的逗号”，这两种错误都很常见。
focus: 分号与连接副词误用

instruction: 下面的句子有一处标点错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Scientists have been warning about rising sea levels for decades, nevertheless, many coastal cities continue to build expensive housing close to the shore.
accepted: Scientists have been warning about rising sea levels for decades; nevertheless, many coastal cities continue to build expensive housing close to the shore.
Scientists have been warning about rising sea levels for decades. Nevertheless, many coastal cities continue to build expensive housing close to the shore.
Scientists have been warning about rising sea levels for decades; many coastal cities, nevertheless, continue to build expensive housing close to the shore.
Scientists have been warning about rising sea levels for decades, but many coastal cities continue to build expensive housing close to the shore.
Scientists have been warning about rising sea levels for decades, yet many coastal cities continue to build expensive housing close to the shore.
Although scientists have been warning about rising sea levels for decades, many coastal cities continue to build expensive housing close to the shore.
Even though scientists have been warning about rising sea levels for decades, many coastal cities continue to build expensive housing close to the shore.
criteria: nevertheless 前后是两个完整句，nevertheless 是连接副词，不能只用逗号连接（逗号连句）。须把 nevertheless 前的逗号改为分号或句号（改句号时 Nevertheless 首字母大写），nevertheless 后的逗号保留；或把 nevertheless 移到第二个分句的主语之后（; many coastal cities, nevertheless, continue…）；或改用连词 but / yet；或用 Although / Even though 引导从句改写。须保留全部信息。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受；同时使用 but 和 nevertheless 判错。
hints: 这个句子里有两个完整句，先找到它们的分界。
nevertheless 和 however 一样是连接副词，不能用逗号把两个完整句连起来。
nevertheless 后面的逗号没有问题，需要改的是它前面那个标点。
explanation: nevertheless（尽管如此，然而）是连接副词，和 however、therefore 一样不能单独连接两个完整句。“完整句 + 逗号 + nevertheless + 逗号 + 完整句”是典型的逗号连句。改法：前面用分号或句号，后面保留逗号：Scientists have been warning about rising sea levels for decades; nevertheless, many coastal cities continue to build expensive housing close to the shore. 也可改用连词 but，或用 Although 引导从句。中文“然而”“尽管如此”前常用逗号，而且句子越长，学生越倾向于“一逗到底”。
focus: 分号与连接副词误用

instruction: 下面的句子有一处标点错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Our city needs more parks、bike lanes and bus routes.
accepted: Our city needs more parks, bike lanes and bus routes.
Our city needs more parks, bike lanes, and bus routes.
criteria: 英文中没有顿号“、”，必须把 parks 后的顿号改为英文半角逗号（不能用中文全角逗号“，”）。and 前加不加逗号（牛津逗号）均可。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 看看列举的三样东西之间用了什么标点。
英文标点系统里有没有“、”这个符号？英文列举时各项之间用的是哪种标点？
换上英文里最常用来分隔并列词语的那个半角标点，并确认它是在英文输入法下打出来的。
explanation: 英文没有顿号“、”。列举三项及以上时，前面各项之间用英文半角逗号，最后一项前用 and（and 前的逗号可加可不加，全文统一即可）：Our city needs more parks, bike lanes and bus routes. 中国学生习惯中文列举用顿号，而且常在中文输入法下打字，容易混入“、”或全角逗号“，”。写完后切换到英文输入法再检查一遍标点。
focus: 列举与引出列举的标点

instruction: 下面的句子有一处标点错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Team sports teach young people many useful skills, including: cooperation, leadership and self-discipline.
accepted: Team sports teach young people many useful skills, including cooperation, leadership and self-discipline.
Team sports teach young people many useful skills, including cooperation, leadership, and self-discipline.
Team sports teach young people many useful skills: cooperation, leadership and self-discipline.
Team sports teach young people many useful skills: cooperation, leadership, and self-discipline.
criteria: including（以及 such as、include 等）后面直接接列举内容，不能加冒号，须删除 including 后的冒号；列举中 and 前加不加逗号均可。若删除 including，让冒号直接跟在完整句 …many useful skills 之后，也可接受。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 检查引出列举的那个标点。
冒号前面必须是意思完整的句子；including、such as 本身就起“引出”作用，后面的内容是它们的宾语。
读到 “…many useful skills, including” 停住——这一部分完整吗？
explanation: 冒号引出列举时，冒号前必须是完整句：Team sports teach young people many useful skills: cooperation, leadership and self-discipline. 而 including / such as / include 等词本身已经引出后面的内容，后面直接接宾语，不能再加冒号：…many useful skills, including cooperation, leadership and self-discipline. 中文“包括：……”“例如：……”习惯加冒号，学生直接迁移成 including: / such as:。
focus: 列举与引出列举的标点

instruction: 选出标点完全正确的一项。
options: Low-cost daily activities, such as walking, gardening and cooking can help elderly people remain independent for much longer.
Low-cost daily activities such as walking, gardening and cooking, can help elderly people remain independent for much longer.
Low-cost daily activities, such as: walking, gardening and cooking, can help elderly people remain independent for much longer.
Low-cost daily activities, such as walking, gardening and cooking, can help elderly people remain independent for much longer.
option_explanations: 错误：such as 插入成分前面用逗号“打开”，后面却没有逗号“关上”，读者会误以为 cooking can help… 是一个新的主谓结构。
错误：前面没有逗号，后面却有一个，等于在主语（Low-cost daily activities such as … cooking）和谓语 can help 之间插入了单个逗号。
错误：such as 后面直接接例子，不能加冒号。
正确：such as 列举作为插入成分，两端用一对逗号隔开；列举内部的各项也用逗号分隔。
hints: 找出主语、插入的举例部分和谓语 can help，看看举例部分两端的标点。
插入句子中间的补充成分如果用逗号隔开，逗号必须“成对”出现；such as 后面直接接例子。
数一数：举例部分的开头和结尾是否都有逗号？
explanation: such as + 列举放在主语和谓语之间时，有两种正确写法：① 两端都加逗号，作插入的补充说明：Low-cost daily activities, such as walking, gardening and cooking, can help elderly people remain independent for much longer. ② 两端都不加逗号，作限定：Low-cost daily activities such as walking, gardening and cooking can help… 最常见的错误是只加一个逗号——要么忘了“关上”，要么在谓语前多出一个，把主语和谓语隔开；such as 后也不能加冒号。中文“例如：……”的冒号习惯，以及“说到哪里停就在哪里加逗号”的写法，是这类错误的主要来源。
focus: 列举与引出列举的标点

instruction: 选出标点最规范的一项。
options: The survey compared three groups: retired people, who visit museums most often, students, who mainly attend free events, and working adults, who rarely have time for cultural activities.
The survey compared three groups; retired people, who visit museums most often; students, who mainly attend free events; and working adults, who rarely have time for cultural activities.
The survey compared three groups: retired people, who visit museums most often; students, who mainly attend free events; and working adults, who rarely have time for cultural activities.
The survey compared three groups: retired people, who visit museums most often; students, who mainly attend free events, and working adults, who rarely have time for cultural activities.
option_explanations: 不规范：每个列举项内部已经带有逗号（who 从句），项与项之间仍用逗号，读者无法分清哪里是一项的结束、哪里是下一项的开始。
错误：引出列举应该用冒号；分号后面必须是完整句，而 retired people, who… 只是名词短语。
正确：完整句后用冒号引出列举；列举项内部含逗号，所以项与项之间（包括 and 前）用分号。
错误：分隔符不一致——前两项之间用分号，后两项之间又改回逗号，working adults 看起来像是 students 那一项的一部分。
hints: 先看引出列举的那个标点，再看三个列举项之间的标点。
每个列举项内部已经带有逗号（who 从句）；引出列举的标点前面是一个完整句。
如果项与项之间也用逗号，读者能分清每一项在哪里结束吗？三个分隔处的标点还应该保持一致。
explanation: ① 引出列举：完整句 + 冒号（The survey compared three groups: …）；分号后必须是完整句，不能用来引出列举。② 列举项内部已经含有逗号（这里每一项都带一个非限制性 who 从句）时，项与项之间改用分号，最后 and 前也用分号，全句保持一致：retired people, who visit museums most often; students, who mainly attend free events; and working adults, who rarely have time for cultural activities. 只用逗号会让读者分不清各项的边界。中文没有与之完全对应的规则，学生很少主动使用这种分号，或者只用了一半。
focus: 列举与引出列举的标点

instruction: 选出标点正确的一项。
options: Spending several hours a day in front of a screen can seriously damage children's eyesight.
Spending several hours a day in front of a screen, can seriously damage children's eyesight.
Spending several hours a day, in front of a screen can seriously damage children's eyesight.
option_explanations: 正确：Spending several hours a day in front of a screen 是动名词短语，作整句的主语，与谓语 can seriously damage 之间不加逗号。
错误：把动名词主语误当作句首引导语，在主语和谓语之间加了逗号。
错误：逗号插在动名词主语内部，把 spending several hours a day 和 in front of a screen 硬生生拆开；主语内部同样不能随意加逗号。
hints: 先找出这个句子的谓语动词，再判断它前面那一整段在句中作什么成分。
句首的 -ing 短语如果本身就是句子的主语，它就不是“开场白”。
试着用 It 代替谓语前面的整段内容，看看剩下的部分是否仍是一个完整的句子。
explanation: 句首 -ing 短语有两种身份：① 作状语（分词短语），后面另有主语，要加逗号：Spending several hours a day online, many children neglect their homework. ② 作主语（动名词短语），后面直接接谓语，不加逗号：Spending several hours a day in front of a screen can seriously damage children's eyesight. 判断方法：用 It 替换 -ing 短语后句子仍完整（It can seriously damage children's eyesight），说明它是主语。学生学了“句首引导语后加逗号”后容易过度类推；中文长主语后习惯停顿（“每天花几个小时看屏幕，会严重损害……”），也会迁移成逗号。
focus: 主谓之间多余逗号

instruction: 下面的句子有一处标点错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: The idea that longer prison sentences automatically make society safer, is not supported by most research on reoffending.
accepted: The idea that longer prison sentences automatically make society safer is not supported by most research on reoffending.
Most research on reoffending does not support the idea that longer prison sentences automatically make society safer.
criteria: 整个 The idea that longer prison sentences automatically make society safer 是句子的主语（idea + 同位语 that 从句），主语与谓语 is not supported 之间不能用单个逗号隔开，必须删除 safer 后的逗号。如果只是在 idea 后再加一个逗号使逗号“成对”，不算改正。把句子改为主动语态（Most research on reoffending does not support the idea that…）且没有多余逗号，也可接受。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 找出句子的谓语动词，看看它前面的全部内容在句中充当什么成分。
英语中主语无论多长，都不能用单个逗号和谓语隔开；朗读时的停顿不等于书面上的逗号。
that 从句说明 idea 的具体内容，属于主语的一部分；想一想句子真正的谓语从哪个词开始。
explanation: 本句主语是 The idea + 同位语从句 that longer prison sentences automatically make society safer，谓语是 is not supported。英语中无论主语多长，主语与谓语之间都不能只用一个逗号隔开。正确：The idea that longer prison sentences automatically make society safer is not supported by most research on reoffending. 也不要在 idea 和 that 之间再加一个逗号把它“配成对”——同位语 that 从句与 the idea 关系紧密，不用逗号隔开。中文长主语后习惯停顿加逗号（“认为刑期越长社会就越安全的观点，并没有得到多数研究的支持”），学生容易直接迁移到英文中。
focus: 主谓之间多余逗号

instruction: 下面的句子有一处主谓一致错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Online shopping save people a lot of time and energy.
accepted: Online shopping saves people a lot of time and energy.
Online shopping can save people a lot of time and energy.
criteria: 主语 Online shopping 表示一种活动，作主语时视为第三人称单数，save 必须改为 saves（使用情态动词 can save 也可以）。其他改动只要正确且不改变原意，均可接受。
hints: 先找出句子的主语和谓语动词。
Online shopping 表示“网购”这一种活动，作主语时按第三人称单数处理。
一般现在时中，主语相当于 it 时，动词需要什么变化？用这条规则检查 save。
explanation: Online shopping（网购）是一个整体概念，作主语时视为第三人称单数，一般现在时谓语要加 -s：Online shopping saves people a lot of time and energy. 中文说“网购节省时间”，动词没有任何形态变化，所以中国学生写英语时很容易漏掉三单 -s。
focus: 单数/不可数主语漏加三单 -s（含 does/has）

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: A healthy diet ______ not have to be expensive.
options: do
does
is
are
option_explanations: 错误：A healthy diet 是单数主语，助动词应该用 does；do 只用于复数主语或 I/you。
正确：第三人称单数主语 + does not + 动词原形，构成 does not have to。
错误：be 动词后面不能直接接动词原形 have；have to 的否定要借助助动词 do/does。
错误：are 是复数形式，与单数主语不一致；而且 be 动词后面不能直接接动词原形 have。
hints: 空格后面是 not have to，先想一想这种否定句需要什么助动词。
实义动词（包括 have to）在一般现在时的否定句中要借助助动词 do 的某种形式，而这个助动词要和主语的单复数一致。
A healthy diet 是单数名词短语：把它换成 It 再读一遍。
explanation: 一般现在时中，实义动词（包括 have to）构成否定要借助助动词 do/does，助动词必须与主语一致。A healthy diet 是第三人称单数，所以用 does：A healthy diet does not have to be expensive. 中文“健康饮食不一定贵”里的“不”没有形态变化，所以学生容易写成 do not，或者误写成 is not have to。
focus: 单数/不可数主语漏加三单 -s（含 does/has）

instruction: 下面的句子有一处主谓一致错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Mass tourism often bring economic benefits to local communities, but it also damages historic sites.
accepted: Mass tourism often brings economic benefits to local communities, but it also damages historic sites.
Mass tourism can often bring economic benefits to local communities, but it also damages historic sites.
Mass tourism often brings economic benefits to local communities; however, it also damages historic sites.
criteria: 主语 Mass tourism 是不可数名词，作主语时为第三人称单数。频率副词 often 不影响谓语形式，bring 必须改为 brings（改用 can often bring 等情态结构也可以）。后半句 it also damages 本身正确，不应改成复数。其他改动只要正确且不改变原意，均可接受。
hints: 这个句子有两个分句，比较一下两个分句里谓语动词的形式。
often、usually、always 等频率副词夹在主语和动词之间时，不会改变动词应有的形式。
前半句的主语和后半句的 it 指同一个东西，两个动词的形式应该一样吗？
explanation: Mass tourism（大众旅游）是不可数名词，作主语时为第三人称单数。often 只是频率副词，夹在主语和谓语之间也不改变谓语形式，所以应该用 brings：Mass tourism often brings economic benefits to local communities, but it also damages historic sites. 学生在后半句紧跟 it 时往往记得加 -s，前半句却因为 often 隔开、或 tourism 看起来不像典型的单数名词而漏掉。根本原因是中文动词没有人称变化。
focus: 单数/不可数主语漏加三单 -s（含 does/has）

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: The high cost of flats in major cities ______ many young couples to postpone having children.
options: force
are forcing
have forced
forces
option_explanations: 错误：被紧挨空格的 cities 带偏了。主语的核心词 cost 是单数，一般现在时要用 forces。
错误：are 是复数形式，与单数核心主语 cost 不一致（用进行时应为 is forcing）。
错误：have 是复数形式，与单数核心主语不一致（用完成时应为 has forced）。
正确：核心主语 The high cost 是单数，谓语用第三人称单数 forces。
hints: 空格前有好几个名词：cost、flats、cities。哪一个才是主语的核心？
of flats in major cities 是介词短语，只修饰前面的名词，不决定谓语的单复数。
把介词短语括起来，只读“The high cost ______ many young couples…”。
explanation: 主语是 The high cost (of flats in major cities)，核心名词 cost 是单数，所以谓语用 forces：The high cost of flats in major cities forces many young couples to postpone having children. 中国学生常按“就近原则”看到 cities 就选复数。这是因为中文谓语不需要与主语保持形式一致，学生习惯只看离动词最近的词。
focus: 修饰语隔开主语与谓语时就近一致

instruction: 下面的句子有一处主谓一致错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: The amount of food wasted by restaurants and supermarkets every year are shocking.
accepted: The amount of food wasted by restaurants and supermarkets every year is shocking.
The amount of food that is wasted by restaurants and supermarkets every year is shocking.
criteria: 主语的核心词是 The amount（单数）。of food 和过去分词短语 wasted by restaurants and supermarkets every year 都只是修饰成分，所以 are 必须改为 is。其他改动只要正确且不改变原意，均可接受。
hints: 这句话的谓语动词在哪里？它前面的主语一共有多长？
介词短语 of food 和过去分词短语 wasted by… 都只是修饰成分，不决定谓语的单复数。
去掉所有修饰成分后，主语只剩一个名词。它是单数还是复数？
explanation: 主语 The amount (of food wasted by restaurants and supermarkets every year) 的核心名词是 amount，是单数，所以谓语用 is：The amount of food wasted by restaurants and supermarkets every year is shocking. 学生容易被紧挨谓语的 restaurants and supermarkets 带偏，甚至误把这个 A and B 当成主语。注意：the amount of + 不可数名词、the number of + 复数名词，都用单数谓语。
focus: 修饰语隔开主语与谓语时就近一致

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: A recent survey of more than 2,000 teachers working in state secondary schools ______ that heavy workloads are driving many of them out of the profession.
options: suggests
suggest
have suggested
are suggesting
option_explanations: 正确：核心主语 survey 是单数。of more than 2,000 teachers 和分词短语 working in state secondary schools 都只是修饰语。
错误：被 teachers 或 schools 带偏了。主语核心是单数的 survey。
错误：have 是复数形式，与单数主语 survey 不一致（用完成时应为 has suggested）。
错误：are 是复数形式，与单数主语 survey 不一致。
hints: 句子里有两个谓语：空格处，以及 that 从句里的 are。先只看空格处的主语。
主语后面的 of 介词短语和 -ing 分词短语再长，也只是修饰成分。
把 of more than 2,000 teachers working in state secondary schools 括起来，剩下的主语是什么？
explanation: 主语是 A recent survey (of more than 2,000 teachers working in state secondary schools)，核心名词 survey 是单数，所以谓语用 suggests：A recent survey of more than 2,000 teachers working in state secondary schools suggests that heavy workloads are driving many of them out of the profession. that 从句有自己的主语 heavy workloads（复数），所以从句里用 are 是对的：两个谓语各自与自己的主语一致。中文说“调查显示”时，中间插入多长的修饰语都不影响动词，所以学生容易按离空格最近的 schools 或 teachers 选复数。
focus: 修饰语隔开主语与谓语时就近一致

instruction: 下面的句子有一处主谓一致错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: People who exercises regularly usually sleep better at night.
accepted: People who exercise regularly usually sleep better at night.
People that exercise regularly usually sleep better at night.
A person who exercises regularly usually sleeps better at night.
criteria: 定语从句 who exercises regularly 中，主语 who 指代先行词 People（复数），所以 exercises 必须改为 exercise。主句谓语 sleep 本身正确。也可以把主语整体改为单数：A person who exercises regularly usually sleeps…。其他改动只要正确且不改变原意，均可接受。
hints: 这个句子有两个谓语动词：一个在 who 引导的从句里，一个在主句里。
定语从句中关系代词 who 作主语时，谓语的单复数取决于它所指代的先行词。
who 在这里指的是哪个词？那个词是单数还是复数？
explanation: 定语从句中 who 作主语时，谓语与先行词一致。先行词 People 是复数（people 不加 s 也表示复数），所以从句谓语用 exercise：People who exercise regularly usually sleep better at night. 学生常把 who 当成单数的“他”，或者因为 people 没有 -s 而误以为它是单数。
focus: 定语从句谓语与先行词不一致

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: Children who ______ up in bilingual families often find it easier to learn a third language.
options: grows
has grown
grow
is growing
option_explanations: 错误：who 指代复数的 Children，从句谓语不能用第三人称单数。
错误：has 是单数形式，与复数先行词 Children 不一致（用完成时应为 have grown）。
正确：who 指代复数的 Children，谓语用 grow。全句陈述普遍情况，用一般现在时。
错误：is 是单数形式，与复数先行词 Children 不一致。
hints: 空格在 who 引导的从句里。先找出 who 指代的名词。
关系代词本身没有单复数，从句谓语的单复数跟着先行词走。
Children 是 child 的什么形式？
explanation: 定语从句中 who 作主语时，谓语与先行词一致。先行词 Children 是 child 的不规则复数形式（没有 -s），所以从句用 grow：Children who grow up in bilingual families often find it easier to learn a third language. children 不以 -s 结尾，学生又常把 who 理解成“他/她”，所以容易误用 grows。
focus: 定语从句谓语与先行词不一致

instruction: 下面的句子有一处主谓一致错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Companies that allow employees to work from home and offers flexible hours tend to have lower staff turnover.
accepted: Companies that allow employees to work from home and offer flexible hours tend to have lower staff turnover.
Companies which allow employees to work from home and offer flexible hours tend to have lower staff turnover.
Companies that allow employees to work from home and that offer flexible hours tend to have lower staff turnover.
A company that allows employees to work from home and offers flexible hours tends to have lower staff turnover.
criteria: 定语从句 that allow… and offers… 中，两个由 and 连接的谓语共用主语 that，而 that 指代复数的 Companies，所以 offers 必须改为 offer。主句的 tend 本身正确。也可以把整句改为单数：A company that allows… and offers… tends…。其他改动只要正确且不改变原意，均可接受。
hints: 定语从句里有两个由 and 连接的动词，比较一下它们的形式。
and 后面的动词和前面的动词共用同一个主语 that，而 that 的单复数取决于先行词。
先行词 Companies 是单数还是复数？两个并列动词的形式应该统一吗？
explanation: 定语从句中 that 作主语，指代复数先行词 Companies，所以从句里由 and 连接的两个谓语都要用复数形式：Companies that allow employees to work from home and offer flexible hours tend to have lower staff turnover. 学生写到 and 后面的第二个动词时，往往已经忘了真正的主语，又被紧挨着的单数名词 home 带偏，于是写出 offers。
focus: 定语从句谓语与先行词不一致

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: Nearly everyone in my class ______ a smartphone.
options: own
owns
have
are owning
option_explanations: 错误：everyone 意思上指“所有人”，语法上却是单数，不能用动词原形 own。
正确：everyone 作主语时，谓语用第三人称单数 owns。
错误：have 是复数形式；everyone 后面应该用单数动词（如 has 或 owns）。
错误：are 是复数形式；而且 own 是状态动词，一般不用进行时。
hints: 主语是哪个词？in my class 只是修饰它。
everyone、everybody、someone、nobody 这类不定代词在意思上可能指很多人，但在语法上怎么处理？
把 everyone 换成 he 或 she，读一读哪个动词形式合适。
explanation: everyone、everybody、someone、nobody 等不定代词作主语时，语法上是单数，谓语用第三人称单数：Nearly everyone in my class owns a smartphone. 中文“每个人都有”里的“都”让人联想到复数，所以学生常写成 everyone have。
focus: 数量词与不定代词主语（everyone / every…and… / percent of）

instruction: 下面的句子有一处主谓一致错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Every child and teenager in the country have the right to free education.
accepted: Every child and teenager in the country has the right to free education.
Every child and every teenager in the country has the right to free education.
All children and teenagers in the country have the right to free education.
criteria: 主语 Every child and teenager 中，every 修饰由 and 连接的单数名词，整个主语视为单数，have 必须改为 has（也可以把主语改为 All children and teenagers 并保留 have）。其他改动只要正确且不改变原意，均可接受。
hints: 主语里有 and，但 and 前面还有一个限定词 every，注意这个词。
every 或 each 修饰由 and 连接的单数名词时，主语的单复数怎么判断？
想一想 Every child ___ the right… 怎么写。后面加上 and teenager 之后，every 的作用变了吗？
explanation: 一般来说，A and B 作主语用复数。但当 every 或 each 修饰由 and 连接的单数名词时（如 Every man and woman…），强调的是“每一个”，谓语用单数：Every child and teenager in the country has the right to free education. 学生看到 and 就机械地用复数，中文“每个孩子和青少年都有”里的“都”又加强了复数感。如果想用复数，可以改为 All children and teenagers… have…。
focus: 数量词与不定代词主语（everyone / every…and… / percent of）

instruction: 选出主谓一致完全正确的一项。
options: Around 30 percent of the city's water are lost through leaks because most of the pipes are over fifty years old.
Around 30 percent of the city's water are lost through leaks because most of the pipes is over fifty years old.
Around 30 percent of the city's water is lost through leaks because most of the pipes are over fifty years old.
Around 30 percent of the city's water is lost through leaks because most of the pipes is over fifty years old.
option_explanations: 错误：percent of 后面的 water 是不可数名词，谓语应该用单数 is，不能用 are。后半句的 are 是正确的。
错误：两处都错。water 不可数，应该用 is；pipes 是复数，应该用 are。
正确：percent of 和 most of 作主语时，谓语看 of 后面的名词：water 不可数，用 is；pipes 是复数，用 are。
错误：前半句的 is 正确，但 most of the pipes 指的是复数的水管，应该用 are。
hints: 每个选项都有两个分句，主语分别以 percent of… 和 most of… 开头，要分别判断。
percent of、most of、half of、the rest of 作主语时，谓语的单复数由 of 后面的名词决定，而不是由 percent 或 most 本身决定。
分别想一想 water 和 pipes 是可数还是不可数、是单数还是复数。
explanation: 百分数、分数以及 most、half、some、all、the rest + of 作主语时，谓语与 of 后面的名词一致：of 后面是不可数名词或单数名词，谓语用单数；of 后面是复数名词，谓语用复数。water 不可数，所以说 30 percent of the city's water is lost；pipes 是复数，所以说 most of the pipes are…。完整正确的句子是：Around 30 percent of the city's water is lost through leaks because most of the pipes are over fifty years old. 学生常见两种错误：觉得“30 percent”表示很多，就用复数；或者看到 most 就一律用单数（或一律用复数）。
focus: 数量词与不定代词主语（everyone / every…and… / percent of）

instruction: 下面的句子有一处主谓一致错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: In many remote villages, the elderly often needs extra help with shopping and transport.
accepted: In many remote villages, the elderly often need extra help with shopping and transport.
In many remote villages the elderly often need extra help with shopping and transport.
In many remote villages, elderly people often need extra help with shopping and transport.
In many remote villages, older people often need extra help with shopping and transport.
criteria: “the + 形容词”结构 the elderly 表示一类人，作主语时视为复数，needs 必须改为 need（也可以改为 elderly people 或 older people + need）。其他改动只要正确且不改变原意，均可接受。
hints: 句子的主语是 the elderly。想一想它指的是一个人还是一类人。
the rich、the young、the elderly 这类“the + 形容词”表示一类人时，语法上按单数还是复数处理？
把 the elderly 换成 elderly people，再读一遍动词。
explanation: “the + 形容词”表示一类人（the elderly = elderly people，the young = young people），作主语时谓语用复数：In many remote villages, the elderly often need extra help with shopping and transport. the elderly 没有复数词尾 -s，中文“老年人”也没有单复数标记，所以学生容易误以为它是单数。
focus: 无 -s 词尾的复数名词作主语

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: In most countries, the police ______ a vital role in keeping communities safe.
options: play
plays
is playing
has played
option_explanations: 正确：police（警方）在英式和美式英语中都作复数名词，谓语用 play。
错误：把 police 当成了单数。police 没有 -s，却表示复数。
错误：is 是单数形式，与复数的 police 不一致；而且这里陈述普遍事实，用一般现在时更合适。
错误：has 是单数形式，与复数的 police 不一致。
hints: 主语是 the police。它没有 -s 结尾，但这能说明它是单数吗？
英语里有一些名词没有复数词尾，却总是按复数使用，例如 people、cattle。
police 的用法和 people 一样。想一想 People ______ a vital role… 这个空应该怎么填。
explanation: police（警方、警察们）是集合名词，在英式和美式英语中都作复数用，谓语用复数：In most countries, the police play a vital role in keeping communities safe. 指一名警察时要说 a police officer。中文“警察”没有单复数变化，police 又没有 -s，所以学生常误用 plays 或 is。
focus: 无 -s 词尾的复数名词作主语

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: Whether online classes are as effective as face-to-face lessons ______ largely on how motivated the students are.
options: depend
are depending
have depended
depends
option_explanations: 错误：被紧挨空格的 lessons 带偏了。主语是整个 whether 从句，应视为单数。
错误：are 是复数形式，与单数的从句主语不一致；而且 depend 表示状态，一般不用进行时。
错误：have 是复数形式，与单数的从句主语不一致；而且这里陈述一般情况，应该用一般现在时。
正确：whether 引导的主语从句作主语，谓语用第三人称单数 depends。
hints: 空格前面从 Whether 到 lessons 的整个部分，在句中是什么成分？
whether、how、why、that 引导的从句作主语时，它代表“一件事”。谓语应该用单数还是复数？
用 This question 代替整个从句，再读一遍句子。
explanation: whether、how、why、that 引导的名词性从句作主语时，整个从句表示“一件事”，谓语用单数：Whether online classes are as effective as face-to-face lessons depends largely on how motivated the students are. 从句内部的 classes 和 lessons 都是复数，而且 lessons 紧挨谓语，学生容易按“就近原则”选 depend。（what 从句作主语、后面的表语又是复数时情况特殊，如 What we need are more teachers，本题不涉及。）
focus: 名词性从句作主语用单数

instruction: 下面的句子有一处主谓一致错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: How much screen time young children should be allowed are a question that many parents find difficult to answer.
accepted: How much screen time young children should be allowed is a question that many parents find difficult to answer.
How much screen time young children should be allowed is a question many parents find difficult to answer.
How much screen time young children should be allowed is a question which many parents find difficult to answer.
criteria: 主语是 how 引导的名词性从句 How much screen time young children should be allowed，视为单数，are 必须改为 is。从句内的 should be allowed 和定语从句中的 find 都是正确的，不应改动。其他改动只要正确且不改变原意，均可接受。
hints: 先找出主句的谓语动词。注意句子里有好几个动词。
从 How 到 allowed 是一个完整的从句。它在整个句子中作什么成分？
用 This 代替整个 How 从句，再看主句的动词是否合适。
explanation: How much screen time young children should be allowed 是 how 引导的主语从句，整体表示“一件事、一个问题”，谓语用单数：How much screen time young children should be allowed is a question that many parents find difficult to answer. 学生容易被从句里的复数名词 children、或后面定语从句里的 many parents 干扰，也可能觉得主语“内容多”就该用复数。
focus: 名词性从句作主语用单数

instruction: 下面的句子有一处动词错误（时态或动词形式），请改正并写出完整句子。
content: A part-time job can teaches teenagers how to manage their money.
accepted: A part-time job can teach teenagers how to manage their money.
A part-time job could teach teenagers how to manage their money.
A part-time job teaches teenagers how to manage their money.
criteria: 情态动词 can 后必须接动词原形，须把 can teaches 改为 can teach（could teach 也可）。删去 can、只保留 teaches 语法上也正确，可以接受，但最好保留 can。写成 can to teach、can teaching、can taught 均判错。其他正确且不改变原意的改动可以接受。
hints: 找到句中的情态动词，看紧跟在它后面的动词。
情态动词后的动词不随主语的人称和数变化，要用什么形式？
主语是单数，但这不影响 can 后面的动词：它不能带任何词尾。
explanation: 情态动词 can / should / must / may / will 后一律接动词原形，不受主语人称和数的影响。汉语“能教”没有词形变化，学生常把“主语单数，动词加 -s”的规则错误地用到情态动词后面。正确：A part-time job can teach teenagers how to manage their money.
focus: 情态动词后接动词原形

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: Within a few decades, household robots will ______ do most of the cooking and cleaning in ordinary homes.
options: can
able to
being able to
be able to
option_explanations: 错误：will 和 can 都是情态动词，英语中两个情态动词不能连用（✗ will can）。
错误：able 是形容词，前面需要系动词 be；will 后必须接动词原形，will able to 缺了 be。
错误：will 后接动词原形，不能接 -ing 形式 being。
正确：will 后接动词原形 be，be able to do 表示“能够”，合起来表示将来能够做某事。
hints: 空格前已经有一个情态动词 will。
英语中两个情态动词不能直接连用；will 后面必须接动词原形。
can 没有将来形式，“将来能够”要换一种说法；再逐个检查 will 后面紧跟的那个词是不是动词原形。
explanation: will 和 can 都是情态动词，不能连用。can 没有将来形式，表示“将来能够”要用 will be able to do。学生把汉语“将能”“会能够”逐字直译，容易写成 will can，或漏掉 be 写成 will able to。正确：Within a few decades, household robots will be able to do most of the cooking and cleaning in ordinary homes.
focus: 情态动词后接动词原形

instruction: 下面的句子有一处动词错误（时态或动词形式），请改正并写出完整句子。
content: The organisers of the outdoor concert should had provided more free drinking water, as several people fainted in the heat.
accepted: The organisers of the outdoor concert should have provided more free drinking water, as several people fainted in the heat.
The organisers of the outdoor concert ought to have provided more free drinking water, as several people fainted in the heat.
criteria: 情态动词后必须接原形。批评过去本应做而没做的事，结构是 should + have + 过去分词，须把 should had provided 改为 should have provided（ought to have provided 也可）。改成 should provide 判错，因为晕倒的事已经发生，说的是过去。其他正确且不改变原意的改动可以接受。
hints: 看 should 后面紧跟的那个助动词。
批评过去“本应该做却没做”的事，用“should + 完成形式（助动词 + 过去分词）”；情态动词后的助动词同样要用原形。
句中 should 后面的助动词用了过去式。情态动词后面能出现过去式吗？
explanation: 批评过去本应做而没做的事，用 should have + 过去分词。情态动词后一律接原形，所以是 have，不是 had。学生常因为“事情发生在过去”就把 have 改成 had，把过去标记加错了位置：过去的含义已经由“have + 过去分词”表达了。正确：The organisers of the outdoor concert should have provided more free drinking water, as several people fainted in the heat.
focus: 情态动词后接动词原形

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: A lot of food waste can ______ if supermarkets give unsold food to charities.
options: avoid
avoided
be avoided
be avoid
option_explanations: 错误：food waste 不会自己去“避免”什么，它是被避免的对象，需要被动；can avoid 是主动。
错误：情态动词 can 后不能直接接过去分词，被动语态必须有 be。
正确：情态动词后的被动结构是 can + be + 过去分词，food waste 是被避免的对象。
错误：被动语态中 be 后面要用过去分词，不能用原形 avoid。
hints: food waste 是“避免”这个动作的执行者，还是承受者？
情态动词后的被动语态结构是“情态动词 + be + 过去分词”。
逐个检查：有没有 be？be 后面的动词是不是过去分词？
explanation: food waste 是被“避免”的对象，要用被动语态；情态动词后的被动结构是 can + be + 过去分词。汉语说“食物浪费可以避免”，不用“被”字，所以学生常写成主动的 can avoid，或漏掉 be 写成 can avoided。正确：A lot of food waste can be avoided if supermarkets give unsold food to charities.
focus: 被动语态构成：be + 过去分词

instruction: 下面的句子有一处动词错误（时态或动词形式），请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Thousands of hectares of rainforest destroy every year to create new farmland.
accepted: Thousands of hectares of rainforest are destroyed every year to create new farmland.
Thousands of hectares of rainforest are being destroyed every year to create new farmland.
Thousands of hectares of rainforest are cleared every year to create new farmland.
Thousands of hectares of rainforest are cut down every year to create new farmland.
criteria: 雨林是被破坏的对象，必须用被动语态。主语核心词 thousands 是复数，every year 表示经常发生的事，应改为 are destroyed（are being destroyed、are cleared、are cut down 也可）。只把 destroy 改成 destroys / destroyed 而不加 be 的判错，用 is destroyed 的也判错（主谓不一致）。其他正确且不改变原意的改动可以接受。
hints: 雨林是自己去“破坏”别的东西，还是被人破坏？
主语承受动作时用被动语态：be + 过去分词；every year 提示用一般现在时。
谓语部分还缺一个助动词，而且 destroy 本身的形式也要变。
explanation: 雨林是被砍伐、被破坏的对象，必须用被动语态“be + 过去分词”。every year 表示经常发生的事，用一般现在时；主语 thousands of hectares 是复数，所以用 are destroyed。汉语“每年有数千公顷雨林遭到破坏”常省略“被”，学生便直接写成 rainforest destroy。正确：Thousands of hectares of rainforest are destroyed every year to create new farmland.
focus: 被动语态构成：be + 过去分词

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: Many historic buildings in the old city centre ______ at the moment to make room for new shopping malls.
options: are demolishing
have demolished
are being demolished
are demolished
option_explanations: 错误：are demolishing 是主动语态，意思变成“建筑物正在拆除（别的东西）”；demolish 是及物动词，这里又缺宾语。
错误：这是主动语态，建筑物不可能去拆除别的东西；而且现在完成时与 at the moment 不搭配。
正确：at the moment 表示动作正在进行，建筑是被拆除的对象，用现在进行时的被动 are being demolished。
错误：语态对了，但一般现在时表示经常性的动作，不能和 at the moment 连用。
hints: 注意时间状语 at the moment，以及主语 buildings 和 demolish 之间的关系。
at the moment 要求进行时；buildings 是被拆除的对象，要求被动语态。
找一个同时满足“进行时”和“被动语态”两个条件的选项。
explanation: at the moment 表示此刻正在进行，要用进行时；历史建筑是被拆除的对象，要用被动。进行时的被动结构是 am/is/are + being + 过去分词：are being demolished。学生常常只顾一头：要么写成主动的 are demolishing，要么写成一般现在时的被动 are demolished。正确：Many historic buildings in the old city centre are being demolished at the moment to make room for new shopping malls.
focus: 被动语态构成：be + 过去分词

instruction: 下面的句子有一处动词错误（时态或动词形式），请改正并写出完整句子。
content: During last summer's heatwave, thousands of fish were died in the river because the water became too warm.
accepted: During last summer's heatwave, thousands of fish died in the river because the water became too warm.
During last summer's heatwave, thousands of fish were killed in the river because the water became too warm.
criteria: die 是不及物动词，没有被动语态，须把 were died 改为 died。改用及物动词 kill 的被动 were killed 也正确，可以接受。句中有 last summer，说的是过去的事，必须用一般过去时；改成 die 或 have died 判错。改成 were dead 也判错：dead 是形容词，只表示“已死”的状态，不能表示“死去”这一事件。其他正确且不改变原意的改动可以接受。
hints: 检查句中的谓语 were died。
die 后面能不能接宾语？不能接宾语的动词有没有被动语态？
last summer 说明这件事发生在过去，时态本身没有问题；问题出在语态上，想想原谓语里哪部分是多余的。
explanation: die（死亡）是不及物动词，不能带宾语，所以没有被动语态。学生常把“be + 过去分词”当作“过去”或“已经发生”的标记，写出 were died、was happened。last summer 表示过去，用一般过去时的主动形式 died 即可。也不要改成 were dead：dead 是形容词，只表示“已死”的状态，不表示“死去”这一事件。对比：kill 是及物动词，可以说 were killed（被杀死）。正确：During last summer's heatwave, thousands of fish died in the river because the water became too warm. 同类不及物动词还有 happen、occur、arise、emerge、exist、disappear。
focus: 不及物动词不用被动

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: Online fraud ______ for as long as the internet itself, but it has become far more sophisticated in recent years.
options: exists
has existed
has been existed
is existed
option_explanations: 错误：for as long as… 表示从过去持续到现在的一段时间，要用现在完成时；一般现在时 exists 不能和这个时间段连用。
正确：exist 是不及物动词，用主动；表示“一直存在到现在”用现在完成时 has existed。
错误：exist 是不及物动词，不能用被动语态，has been existed 是典型的中式错误。
错误：exist 没有被动语态，is existed 不成立，时态也不对。
hints: 注意 for as long as… 这个时间状语，以及 exist 这个动词本身。
exist 后面不能接宾语，这类动词能不能用被动？“从过去一直持续到现在”要用哪种时态？
先排除所有含“be + 过去分词”的选项，再从剩下的选项里选能表达“一直存在至今”的时态。
explanation: exist（存在）是不及物动词，没有被动语态。学生受汉语影响，又习惯用 has been + 过去分词表示“一直”，于是写出 has been existed。for as long as the internet itself 表示从过去持续到现在，要用现在完成时的主动形式。正确：Online fraud has existed for as long as the internet itself, but it has become far more sophisticated in recent years.
focus: 不及物动词不用被动

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: Our school ______ every student a tablet three years ago, but many teachers still prefer printed textbooks.
options: gave
has given
gives
was given
option_explanations: 正确：three years ago 是明确的过去时间，动作已经完成，用一般过去时 gave。
错误：现在完成时不能与 ago 这类明确的过去时间连用。
错误：一般现在时表示经常性的动作或现状，与 three years ago 矛盾。
错误：学校是“发”平板电脑的一方，应用主动语态；was given 意思变成“学校被给予”，后面还跟着两个宾语，句子不通。
hints: 注意句中的时间状语 three years ago。
带 ago、last year、in 2020 等明确过去时间的句子，用哪种时态？
现在完成时虽然也表示“已经做了”，但它不能和明确的过去时间点同时出现。
explanation: ago 表示明确的过去时间，动作发生在过去并已完成，用一般过去时。学生会把这句理解成“三年前学校已经给每个学生发了平板”，“已经”二字容易让人选现在完成时，但英语的现在完成时不能和 ago、yesterday、in 2020 等明确的过去时间连用。正确：Our school gave every student a tablet three years ago, but many teachers still prefer printed textbooks.
focus: 现在完成时与一般过去时的选择

instruction: 下面的句子有一处动词错误（时态或动词形式），请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Ever since the first video-sharing websites appeared, the way young people spend their free time changed dramatically.
accepted: Ever since the first video-sharing websites appeared, the way young people spend their free time has changed dramatically.
Ever since the first video-sharing websites appeared, the way young people spend their free time has dramatically changed.
Ever since the first video-sharing websites appeared, the way young people spend their free time has been changing dramatically.
criteria: ever since 引导的时间段一直延续到现在，主句必须用现在完成时，须把 changed 改为 has changed（has dramatically changed、has been changing 也可）。从句中的 appeared 说的是过去某个时间点，本身正确，不要改。主语核心是单数 the way，写成 have changed 判错。其他正确且不改变原意的改动可以接受。
hints: 这句话有两个谓语：一个在 Ever since 从句里，一个在主句里。
since 从句说的是过去的起点，主句说的是从那时起一直到现在的变化，两者时态不同。
主句主语的核心词是单数 the way，它描述的变化一直延续到现在。
explanation: ever since + 过去的时间点（或从句）表示“从那时起直到现在”，主句用现在完成时；since 从句本身说的是过去某个时刻发生的事，用一般过去时。汉语“自从……以来，……变化很大”没有时态标记，学生常把主句也写成一般过去时。主语 the way young people spend their free time 的核心是 the way，单数，所以用 has changed。正确：Ever since the first video-sharing websites appeared, the way young people spend their free time has changed dramatically.
focus: 现在完成时与一般过去时的选择

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: My grandfather, who ______ in a coal mine for over thirty years before he retired in 2005, still suffers from serious breathing problems.
options: works
has worked
has been working
worked
option_explanations: 错误：工作发生在 2005 年退休之前，是过去的事，不能用一般现在时。
错误：for over thirty years 容易让人想到现在完成时，但这段时间在 2005 年退休时已经结束，不延续到现在，不能用现在完成时。
错误：现在完成进行时表示动作持续到现在、可能还在进行，而祖父早已退休，自相矛盾。
正确：这段工作完全发生在过去（2005 年退休之前），用一般过去时 worked；主句 still suffers 说的是现在的状况，用一般现在时。
hints: 看 who 从句里的时间信息：这段工作从什么时候持续到什么时候？
for + 一段时间不一定要用现在完成时，关键看这段时间是否延续到现在。
before he retired in 2005 说明这段工作经历什么时候就结束了？
explanation: 现在完成时表示从过去延续到现在的时间段；如果这段时间在过去已经结束，即使有 for + 一段时间，也用一般过去时。祖父 2005 年退休前在煤矿工作了三十多年，这段经历早已结束，所以用 worked（用 had worked 强调“退休之前”也正确）。主句 still suffers 描述现在的状况，用一般现在时。中国学生常把“for + 时间段 = 现在完成时”当作公式，忽略了这段时间是否延续到现在。正确：My grandfather, who worked in a coal mine for over thirty years before he retired in 2005, still suffers from serious breathing problems.
focus: 现在完成时与一般过去时的选择

instruction: 下面的句子有一处动词错误（时态或动词形式），请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Nowadays, more and more parents allowed their children to watch cartoons during meals, which means that family members talk to each other less.
accepted: Nowadays, more and more parents allow their children to watch cartoons during meals, which means that family members talk to each other less.
Nowadays, more and more parents are allowing their children to watch cartoons during meals, which means that family members talk to each other less.
Nowadays, more and more parents let their children watch cartoons during meals, which means that family members talk to each other less.
criteria: nowadays 表示现在的普遍现象，后半句的 means、talk 也是一般现在时，前半句的 allowed 须改为一般现在时 allow（are allowing、let … watch 也可）。为求一致而把后半句也改成过去时（meant / talked）的判错，因为 nowadays 要求现在时。其他正确且不改变原意的改动可以接受。
hints: 注意句首的时间词 Nowadays，再找出句中所有的谓语动词。
描述现在的普遍现象用一般现在时；同一句中不应无理由地切换时态。
后半句的 means 和 talk 没有问题，问题在前半句。
explanation: Nowadays 表示“如今”，描述的是现在的普遍现象，应使用一般现在时；后半句 which means that family members talk to each other less 也是现在时，前后应一致。汉语动词没有时态变化，学生写作时常在现在时和过去时之间随意切换，尤其是 allowed、used、spent 这类常见的过去式。正确：Nowadays, more and more parents allow their children to watch cartoons during meals, which means that family members talk to each other less.
focus: 议论文观点句用一般现在时，避免无理由转用过去时

instruction: 阅读下面的段落，选出时态使用错误的一句。
content: (1) Many people argue that public libraries are no longer necessary in the digital age. (2) However, libraries still played a vital role in many communities. (3) When my local library extended its opening hours last year, the number of students using it doubled. (4) This suggests that young people value a quiet place to study outside the home.
options: 第 (1) 句
第 (2) 句
第 (3) 句
第 (4) 句
option_explanations: 不选：这句转述他人现在的观点，argue 和 are 都用一般现在时，正确。
应选（此句有错）：这是作者针对现在情况提出的反驳，still 也说明讲的是现状，应用一般现在时 play；played 把观点变成了过去的事，与上下文矛盾。
不选：这句举的是去年的具体事例，有明确的过去时间 last year，用一般过去时 extended 和 doubled 是正确的。
不选：从例子中得出现在仍然成立的结论，用一般现在时 suggests 和 value，正确。
hints: 区分段落中哪些句子在陈述观点，哪些句子在讲具体的过去事例。
陈述观点和普遍情况用一般现在时；只有带明确过去时间的具体事例才用过去时。
找出这样一句：它表达的是作者现在的观点，却用了过去时。
explanation: 议论文中，观点句、普遍事实和结论用一般现在时；有 last year 等过去时间的具体事例用一般过去时。第 (2) 句是作者对“图书馆已无必要”的反驳，still 表明讲的是现在的情况，应改为 However, libraries still play a vital role in many communities. 第 (3) 句是去年的事例，用过去时是正确的。中国学生常犯两种错：要么整段都用过去时，要么一看到过去时就认为是错的。关键是判断每句话讲的是“现在的观点”还是“过去的具体事件”。
focus: 议论文观点句用一般现在时，避免无理由转用过去时

instruction: 下面的句子有一处动词错误（时态或动词形式），请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Supporters of online learning point out that it allows students to study at their own pace, but in my view it also made it harder for teachers to notice when a student is struggling.
accepted: Supporters of online learning point out that it allows students to study at their own pace, but in my view it also makes it harder for teachers to notice when a student is struggling.
Supporters of online learning point out that it allows students to study at their own pace, but, in my view, it also makes it harder for teachers to notice when a student is struggling.
Supporters of online learning point out that it allows students to study at their own pace, but in my view it has also made it harder for teachers to notice when a student is struggling.
Supporters of online learning point out that it allows students to study at their own pace, but, in my view, it has also made it harder for teachers to notice when a student is struggling.
criteria: 全句在陈述作者对网课的现时观点（point out、allows、is struggling 都是现在时），句中没有过去时间，made 属于无理由的时态切换，须改为 makes（has also made 也可）。为求一致把 point out、allows 等改成过去时的判错。其他正确且不改变原意的改动（如在 in my view 前后加逗号）可以接受。
hints: 把整句的谓语动词都找出来，比较它们的时态。
转述他人观点和表达自己的看法都属于“现在的议论”，没有过去时间状语时不应改用过去时。
but 后面那个分句的谓语和句中其他动词不一致。
explanation: 议论文中转述他人观点（Supporters point out that it allows…）和表达自己的看法（in my view it also…）都用一般现在时。句中没有过去时间状语，句末的 is struggling 也说明讨论的是现在的情况，所以 made 应改为 makes；若强调网课出现以来已经造成的影响，也可用现在完成时 has also made。汉语“让老师更难发现”没有时态标记，学生常顺手写出 made。正确：Supporters of online learning point out that it allows students to study at their own pace, but in my view it also makes it harder for teachers to notice when a student is struggling.
focus: 议论文观点句用一般现在时，避免无理由转用过去时

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: When self-driving cars ______ common, many taxi drivers will need to find new jobs.
options: become
will become
became
would become
option_explanations: 正确：when 引导的时间状语从句用一般现在时表示将来，主句用 will。
错误：时间状语从句中不用 will 表示将来，这是把汉语“当……将会……”直译造成的常见错误。
错误：一般过去时表示过去，而这里说的是将来；主句 will need 也表明是将来。
错误：would 用于虚拟或过去将来，与主句 will need 不匹配；时间状语从句中也不用 would 表示将来。
hints: 这句话说的是过去、现在还是将来的事？从句由哪个词引导？
when、if、as soon as、unless 引导的时间或条件状语从句中，表示将来要用什么时态？
主句已经用了 will，从句里就不需要再出现表示将来的助动词。
explanation: when、if、as soon as、before、unless 等引导的时间或条件状语从句用一般现在时表示将来，只有主句用 will。汉语“当无人驾驶汽车将会普及时”把“将会”放进了从句，学生便写出 when … will become。正确：When self-driving cars become common, many taxi drivers will need to find new jobs.
focus: 时间/条件状语从句用一般现在时表将来

instruction: 下面的句子有一处动词错误（时态或动词形式），请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Unless people will change their eating habits in the next few years, the number of patients with type 2 diabetes will continue to rise, putting even more pressure on hospitals.
accepted: Unless people change their eating habits in the next few years, the number of patients with type 2 diabetes will continue to rise, putting even more pressure on hospitals.
If people do not change their eating habits in the next few years, the number of patients with type 2 diabetes will continue to rise, putting even more pressure on hospitals.
criteria: unless 引导条件状语从句，从句用一般现在时表示将来，须把 will change 改为 change，主句的 will continue 保留。改写为 If people do not change … 也可。改动主句 will continue 或把从句改成 changed 的判错。其他正确且不改变原意的改动可以接受。
hints: 这句话有两个 will，看看它们分别在主句还是从句中。
unless（= if … not）引导的条件状语从句中，表示将来要用什么时态？
主句的 will continue 没有问题，问题出在 unless 从句的谓语上。
explanation: unless 意为“除非；如果不”，引导条件状语从句。和 if、when 一样，从句用一般现在时表示将来，主句用 will。学生受汉语“除非人们将会改变……”的影响，或认为“讲将来就要用 will”，就在从句里也加了 will。正确：Unless people change their eating habits in the next few years, the number of patients with type 2 diabetes will continue to rise, putting even more pressure on hospitals.
focus: 时间/条件状语从句用一般现在时表将来

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: Budget airlines often charge extra fees when passengers bring ______.
options: too many luggages
too much luggages
too much luggage
too many luggage
option_explanations: 错误：luggage 是不可数名词，既不能加 -s，也不能用 many 修饰。
错误：much 用对了，但 luggage 不可数，没有复数形式 luggages。
正确：luggage 不可数，用 much 修饰且不加 -s：too much luggage。
错误：luggage 虽然没有加 -s，但 many 只修饰可数名词复数，不能修饰不可数名词。
hints: 空格里的关键名词是 luggage（行李），先判断它能不能数。
luggage 和 furniture、equipment 一样，是表示一类物品总称的名词。
这类名词不能加复数词尾，还要搭配专门修饰不可数名词的那个表示“多”的词。
explanation: luggage（行李）是不可数名词，指行李的总称，没有复数形式 luggages，也不能用 many 修饰。“太多行李”应说 too much luggage；需要计数时用 a piece of luggage、two suitcases。中文可以说“三件行李”，学生因此容易把 luggage 当成可数名词。正确：Budget airlines often charge extra fees when passengers bring too much luggage.
focus: 不可数名词误加 -s 或 a/an

instruction: 下面的句子有一处名词错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Reading novels from other countries helps young people gain knowledges about different cultures.
accepted: Reading novels from other countries helps young people gain knowledge about different cultures.
Reading novels from other countries helps young people gain knowledge of different cultures.
Reading novels from other countries helps young people to gain knowledge about different cultures.
criteria: knowledge 是不可数名词，必须把 knowledges 改为 knowledge（about 也可以改为 of）。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意都可以接受（如 gain a better knowledge of：knowledge 在“a + 形容词 + knowledge of”这一固定用法中可以带 a，但不能加 -s）；仍保留 -s 判错。
hints: 检查句中每个名词的形式，特别是 gain 后面的那个名词。
knowledge（知识）和 information、advice 属于同一类名词。
这类名词表示抽象概念的总称，没有复数形式。
explanation: knowledge（知识）是不可数名词，没有复数，不能写成 knowledges。中文常说“各种知识”“很多知识”，学生就以为要加 -s。正确：Reading novels from other countries helps young people gain knowledge about different cultures. 想表达“丰富的知识”，可以说 a wide range of knowledge 或 extensive knowledge。
focus: 不可数名词误加 -s 或 a/an

instruction: 下面的句子有一处名词错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Over the past twenty years, medical scientists have made a great progress in treating heart disease.
accepted: Over the past twenty years, medical scientists have made great progress in treating heart disease.
Over the past twenty years, medical scientists have made a lot of progress in treating heart disease.
Over the past twenty years, medical scientists have made a great deal of progress in treating heart disease.
Over the past twenty years, medical scientists have made much progress in treating heart disease.
criteria: progress 是不可数名词，不能和 a 连用：必须去掉 a（a great progress → great progress），或者改为 a great deal of progress、a lot of progress 等表达。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意都可以接受（如 significant progress）；改成 great progresses 判错。
hints: 看 have made 后面的名词短语。
progress（进步、进展）能数吗？能和 a/an 连用吗？
一般来说，不可数名词前不能用不定冠词，即使中间隔着形容词也一样。
explanation: progress（进步、进展）是不可数名词，不能加 a/an，也没有复数形式，make great progress 是固定搭配。学生常把“取得了一个很大的进步”直译成英语，或者类比 a great success、a great achievement（这两个词是可数的）。正确：Over the past twenty years, medical scientists have made great progress in treating heart disease.
focus: 不可数名词误加 -s 或 a/an

instruction: 选出名词单复数与可数性完全正确的一项。
options: Plastic waste causes serious damage to marine wildlife, and several species of seabird are now under threat.
Plastic waste causes serious damages to marine wildlife, and several species of seabird are now under threat.
Plastic waste causes serious damage to marine wildlifes, and several species of seabird are now under threat.
Plastic waste causes serious damage to marine wildlife, and several specie of seabird are now under threat.
option_explanations: 正确：damage 表示“损害”时不可数；wildlife 是不可数的集合名词；species 单复数同形，several species 正确。
错误：表示“损害”的 damage 不可数，复数 damages 专指法律上的“赔偿金”，不能说 cause serious damages to。
错误：wildlife（野生动物）是不可数的集合名词，不能加 -s，没有 wildlifes 这种形式。
错误：species（物种）单复数同形，“几个物种”是 several species；specie 是另一个词，意思是“硬币、铸币”。
hints: 逐一检查 damage、wildlife、species 这三个名词的形式。
有的名词表示总称，不可数；有的名词加 -s 后意思完全改变；还有的名词单复数同形。
想一想法律新闻里的 damages 指什么，以及英语里“一个物种”怎么说。
explanation: damage 表示“损害”时是不可数名词（cause serious damage to sth）。复数 damages 专指法庭判给的“赔偿金”。wildlife（野生动物）是不可数的集合名词，不能写成 wildlifes。species（物种）单复数同形：a species、several species；specie 的意思是“硬币、铸币”。学生受“很多损害”“很多物种”影响，喜欢给这些词加 -s 或去掉 -s。正确：Plastic waste causes serious damage to marine wildlife, and several species of seabird are now under threat.
focus: 不可数名词误加 -s 或 a/an

instruction: 下面的句子有一处名词错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Nowadays, many grandparent help to look after their grandchildren.
accepted: Nowadays, many grandparents help to look after their grandchildren.
Nowadays, many grandparents help look after their grandchildren.
criteria: many 后面的可数名词必须用复数：把 grandparent 改为 grandparents。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意都可以接受（如去掉 help 后面的 to）。
hints: 看 many 后面的名词。
many 修饰什么形式的名词？
句末的 their grandchildren 也说明主语指的是多个人。
explanation: many 后面必须接可数名词复数，所以 grandparent 应改为 grandparents。中文“很多爷爷奶奶”中名词形式不变，学生因此常漏写 -s。正确：Nowadays, many grandparents help to look after their grandchildren.
focus: 表示多个或泛指时漏掉复数 -s

instruction: 选出名词单复数完全正确的一项。
options: Many young athlete train for several hours a day, yet few of them become professional players.
Many young athletes train for several hour a day, yet few of them become professional players.
Many young athletes train for several hours a day, yet few of them become professional player.
Many young athletes train for several hours a day, yet few of them become professional players.
option_explanations: 错误：many 后面的可数名词要用复数，应为 many young athletes。
错误：several 表示“几个”，后接可数名词复数，应为 several hours。
错误：few of them 指多个人，他们成为的“职业运动员”也是多个，应用复数 professional players。
正确：many athletes、several hours、professional players 都用了复数。
hints: 每个选项有三个关键名词：athlete、hour、player。
many 和 several 后面接可数名词复数；主语指多个人时，表语名词通常也用复数。
“许多运动员”“几个小时”“职业运动员”都指不止一个，逐个检查它们有没有复数标记。
explanation: many、several 后面接可数名词复数：many young athletes、several hours。few of them 指多个人，表语也要用复数：become professional players。中文名词没有复数标记，学生容易漏掉 -s，尤其是句子后半部分的名词。正确：Many young athletes train for several hours a day, yet few of them become professional players.
focus: 表示多个或泛指时漏掉复数 -s

instruction: 下面的句子有一处名词错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Over the past two decades, a growing number of city have introduced congestion charges in order to reduce traffic in their busiest areas.
accepted: Over the past two decades, a growing number of cities have introduced congestion charges in order to reduce traffic in their busiest areas.
Over the past two decades, a growing number of cities have introduced congestion charges to reduce traffic in their busiest areas.
criteria: a (growing) number of 后面必须接可数名词复数：把 city 改为 cities。谓语 have 已经是复数，不需要修改；如果把 have 改成 has 判错。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意都可以接受。
hints: 看主语部分 a growing number of 后面的名词。
a number of / a growing number of 表示“越来越多的……”，后面接什么形式的名词？
谓语 have 和后面的 their 都说明主语指的是多个事物。
explanation: a number of / a growing number of（越来越多的）后面接可数名词复数，谓语也用复数：a growing number of cities have…。学生容易把 number 看成中心词而用单数名词，也受到中文“城市”没有复数形式的影响。正确：Over the past two decades, a growing number of cities have introduced congestion charges in order to reduce traffic in their busiest areas. 注意与 the number of + 复数名词 + 单数谓语区分：The number of cities with congestion charges has risen.
focus: 表示多个或泛指时漏掉复数 -s

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: Teenagers who get ______ sleep often find it hard to concentrate in class.
options: little
few
a few
many
option_explanations: 正确：sleep 表示“睡眠”时不可数，little 修饰不可数名词，意思是“很少，几乎没有”。
错误：few 修饰可数名词复数（few hours），不能修饰不可数名词 sleep。
错误：a few 修饰可数名词复数，sleep 在这里不可数。
错误：many 修饰可数名词复数，sleep 不可数。
hints: 先判断 sleep（睡眠）是可数名词还是不可数名词。
few、a few、many 和 little 中，有的修饰可数名词复数，有的修饰不可数名词。
sleep 没有用复数形式，说明它在这里是哪一类名词？
explanation: sleep（睡眠）在这里是不可数名词，“睡眠很少”说 little sleep；few、a few、many 只修饰可数名词复数。中文“很少”既可以说数量也可以说程度，所以学生容易把 few 和 little 混用。对比：few hours of sleep（hours 可数）。正确：Teenagers who get little sleep often find it hard to concentrate in class.
focus: 数量词与可数性不匹配

instruction: 下面的句子有一处名词搭配错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: If more people used public transport, there would be less cars on the roads during rush hour.
accepted: If more people used public transport, there would be fewer cars on the roads during rush hour.
If more people used public transport, there would be less traffic on the roads during rush hour.
If more people used public transport, there would not be as many cars on the roads during rush hour.
criteria: cars 是可数名词复数，要用 fewer 修饰：必须把 less 改为 fewer（或改为 less traffic、not as many cars 等正确表达）。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意都可以接受；保留 less cars 判错。
hints: 看 there would be 后面表示“更少”的词和它修饰的名词。
less 和 fewer 都表示“更少”，它们分别修饰什么样的名词？
cars 带了复数 -s，说明它是可数名词。
explanation: fewer 是 few 的比较级，修饰可数名词复数；less 是 little 的比较级，修饰不可数名词（less traffic, less pollution）。cars 是可数复数，正式写作中应说 fewer cars。学生常把 less 当成万能的“更少”；口语里虽然能听到 less cars，但在考试作文中会被判为错误。正确：If more people used public transport, there would be fewer cars on the roads during rush hour.
focus: 数量词与可数性不匹配

instruction: 下面的句子有一处名词搭配错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: In many developed countries, the amount of elderly people living alone has risen sharply in recent decades.
accepted: In many developed countries, the number of elderly people living alone has risen sharply in recent decades.
In many developed countries, the proportion of elderly people living alone has risen sharply in recent decades.
In many developed countries, the percentage of elderly people living alone has risen sharply in recent decades.
criteria: people 是可数名词复数，不能用 the amount of 表示数量：必须把 the amount of 改为 the number of（或 the proportion of、the percentage of 等能和可数复数连用的表达）。谓语 has 与 the number 一致，不需要修改；改成 have 判错。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意都可以接受。
hints: 看主语部分 the amount of 后面的名词。
amount 和 number 都表示“数量”，但它们搭配的名词类型不同。
people 是 person 的复数，属于可数名词。
explanation: the amount of 接不可数名词（the amount of money / waste），the number of 接可数名词复数（the number of people）。the number of… 作主语时中心词是 number，谓语用单数 has。中文“数量”一词通用，学生常用 amount 统称。正确：In many developed countries, the number of elderly people living alone has risen sharply in recent decades.
focus: 数量词与可数性不匹配

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: At our school, ______ is required to join at least one after-school club during the first year.
options: every students
every student
all student
each students
option_explanations: 错误：every 意思是“每一个”，后面只能接可数名词单数。
正确：every + 单数名词，谓语用单数 is：every student is required…
错误：all 修饰可数名词时要用复数（all students），而且谓语应该用 are。
错误：each 直接修饰名词时也只能接单数；表示“……中的每一个”要说 each of the students。
hints: 空格处是句子的主语，注意它后面的谓语 is。
every、each 和 all 对后面名词的单复数要求不同。
表示“每一个”的限定词是把成员一个一个地看，想想后面的名词应该用什么形式。
explanation: every 和 each 意思是“每一个”，后面接可数名词单数，谓语也用单数：every student is…；all 表示“全部”，后面接复数：all students are…。中文“每个学生”在概念上指全体学生，学生就误以为要加 -s。正确：At our school, every student is required to join at least one after-school club during the first year.
focus: 限定词决定名词单复数

instruction: 选出名词单复数完全正确的一项。
options: Each of the two news website we compared offers a free app, and both apps send an alert every time a major story breaks.
Each of the two news websites we compared offers a free app, and both app send an alert every time a major story breaks.
Each of the two news websites we compared offers a free app, and both apps send an alert every times a major story breaks.
Each of the two news websites we compared offers a free app, and both apps send an alert every time a major story breaks.
option_explanations: 错误：each of the 是“从一组中逐个挑出”，of 后面的名词必须是复数：each of the two news websites。
错误：both 意思是“两者都”，后面接复数名词：both apps。
错误：every 后面接单数名词，every time 是固定用法，不能说 every times。
正确：each of the + 复数名词 + 单数谓语 offers；both + 复数 apps；every + 单数 time。
hints: 注意 each of the、both、every 后面的三个名词。
有的限定词后面接单数名词，有的接复数名词；each 和 each of the 的要求也不一样。
each of the + 名词 是从一组事物中逐个挑出，这一组本身有多个成员；both 也指两个。
explanation: each 直接修饰名词时接单数（each website），each of the 后面接复数名词，谓语用单数（each of the two news websites… offers）。both 接复数（both apps），every 接单数（every time）。学生常因为 each 表示“每一个”，就把 each of the 后面的名词也写成单数；又因为 both 表示“两个”，却忘了给名词加 -s。正确：Each of the two news websites we compared offers a free app, and both apps send an alert every time a major story breaks.
focus: 限定词决定名词单复数

instruction: 下面的句子有一处名词形式错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Some companies are now testing a four-days working week to see whether employees become more productive.
accepted: Some companies are now testing a four-day working week to see whether employees become more productive.
Some companies are now testing a four-day work week to see whether employees become more productive.
Some companies are now testing a four-day week to see whether employees become more productive.
criteria: 数词与名词组成连字符复合形容词作前置定语时，名词用单数：必须把 four-days 改为 four-day。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意都可以接受（如 a four-day work week）；保留 days 判错。
hints: 看 working week 前面那个由数词和名词构成的修饰语。
“数词 + 名词”用连字符连成形容词放在另一个名词前时，其中的名词要不要变复数？
对比 The week has four days. 和 a ___ working week：前者是名词短语，后者是形容词。
explanation: 数词与名词用连字符组成复合形容词放在名词前面时，名词一律用单数：a four-day week、a ten-minute walk、a five-year plan。学生受“四天 = four days”影响，写成 four-days。对比：The new working week has four days.（这里是名词短语，用复数）。正确：Some companies are now testing a four-day working week to see whether employees become more productive.
focus: 数词-名词复合形容词中名词用单数

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: Before buying a new washing machine, many consumers check whether it comes with a ______.
options: two-years warranty
two-year warranty
two years warranty
two-year warranties
option_explanations: 错误：数词与名词组成的连字符复合形容词中，名词要用单数，不能写 two-years。
正确：two-year 作前置定语修饰 warranty，其中的 year 用单数；a 后接单数名词 warranty。
错误：two years 是名词短语，不能直接放在 a 和名词之间作定语，要写成连字符形容词。（英式英语可以说 two years' warranty，但前面不加 a。）
错误：a 后面只能接可数名词单数，warranties 是复数。
hints: 空格前有 a，空格里的“两年”是用来修饰 warranty（保修期）的。
数词和名词用连字符组合起来放在另一个名词前作定语时，其中的名词用什么形式？
最后检查一下 a 后面的中心名词与 a 是否一致。
explanation: 数词与名词组成复合形容词作前置定语时，名词用单数并加连字符：a two-year warranty、a three-hour exam、a ten-minute walk。学生受“两年 = two years”影响，写成 two-years 或 two years。对比：The warranty lasts two years.（名词短语，用复数）。正确：Before buying a new washing machine, many consumers check whether it comes with a two-year warranty.
focus: 数词-名词复合形容词中名词用单数

instruction: 下面的句子有一处名词错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Many natural phenomenons, such as rainbows and lightning, can be explained by basic physics.
accepted: Many natural phenomena, such as rainbows and lightning, can be explained by basic physics.
criteria: phenomenon 的复数是不规则形式 phenomena，必须把 phenomenons 改为 phenomena。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意都可以接受；改成 phenomenon（单数，与 many 冲突）或 phenomenas 判错。
hints: 检查 many natural 后面那个名词的复数形式。
不是所有名词都加 -s 变复数，有些来自拉丁语或希腊语的学术词汇保留了原来的复数形式。
想想 criterion 的复数怎么写，这个词的变化方式和它一样。
explanation: phenomenon（现象）来自希腊语，复数是 phenomena，不是 phenomenons。类似的词还有 criterion → criteria、analysis → analyses、crisis → crises。学生往往按规则加 -s，或者反过来把 phenomena 当单数用（✗ a phenomena）。正确：Many natural phenomena, such as rainbows and lightning, can be explained by basic physics.
focus: 不规则复数（外来学术词）

instruction: 选出名词单复数完全正确的一项。
options: The main criteria for admission to most universities is academic performance, but they also take several other criteria into account.
The main criterion for admission to most universities is academic performance, but they also take several other criterions into account.
The main criterion for admission to most universities is academic performance, but they also take several other criteria into account.
The main criterion for admission to most universities is academic performance, but they also take several other criterias into account.
option_explanations: 错误：criteria 是复数，这里只说一个主要标准，而且谓语是 is，应该用单数 criterion。
错误：前半句正确，但 criterion 的复数是不规则的 criteria，没有 criterions 这种形式。
正确：单数 the main criterion… is，复数 several other criteria。
错误：criteria 本身已经是复数，不能再加 -s。
hints: 注意句中两个位置的 criterion / criteria。
criterion（标准）来自希腊语，单数和复数形式不同，复数不是加 -s。
前半句的谓语是 is，后半句 several other 后面需要复数，分别检查两个位置。
explanation: criterion（标准）是单数，复数是 criteria，没有 criterions 或 criterias。the main criterion 只指一个标准，所以谓语用 is；several other 后接复数 criteria。学生常把 criteria 当单数用（这在母语者口语中也常见，但在学术写作中被视为错误），或者按规则再加 -s。正确：The main criterion for admission to most universities is academic performance, but they also take several other criteria into account.
focus: 不规则复数（外来学术词）

instruction: 下面的句子有一处冠词错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Reading before bed is good habit for children.
accepted: Reading before bed is a good habit for children.
criteria: habit（习惯）是可数名词单数，前面必须有限定词，应在 good habit 前加不定冠词 a（is a good habit）。改成 the good habit 不可接受（这里不是特指某个习惯）。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 找出句中的单数可数名词，看看它前面有没有限定词。
habit 是可数名词。可数名词单数前必须有 a/an、the、my 等限定词，不能“光着”出现。
问题出在 is 和 habit 之间。读者事先知道是哪一个习惯吗？
explanation: habit 是可数名词，单数时前面必须有限定词。这里是泛泛地说“睡前阅读是（一种）好习惯”，读者并不知道是哪一个特定的习惯，所以用不定冠词 a。正确：Reading before bed is a good habit for children. 中文说“是好习惯”不需要“一个”，所以中国学生很容易漏掉 a。children 是泛指复数，不需要冠词。
focus: 可数名词单数前漏冠词

instruction: 选出冠词使用完全正确的一项。
options: Online shopping has had huge impact on small local shops.
