Online shopping has had a huge impact on small local shops.
Online shopping has had the huge impact on small local shops.
The online shopping has had a huge impact on small local shops.
option_explanations: 错误：impact 表示“影响”时是可数名词，单数前必须有限定词，不能说 have huge impact。
正确：impact 是可数单数，这里第一次泛泛提到“巨大的影响”，用 a；online shopping 泛指“网购”，不可数，零冠词；small local shops 泛指复数，零冠词。
错误：the 表示读者已经知道的那个特定影响，但这里是第一次提到，并非特指，应用不定冠词。
错误：online shopping 在这里泛指“网购”这种行为，是不可数名词，泛指时不加 the。
hints: 比较四个选项：它们只在 online shopping 和 impact 前面的冠词上有区别。
impact 表示“影响”时是可数名词；第一次提到、读者不知道是哪一个时用不定冠词；泛指的不可数名词不加 the。
先排除把泛指的“网购”当成特指的选项，再看 impact 前面：有没有限定词？是不是特指？
explanation: impact（影响）是可数名词：have an impact / a huge impact on sth。这里是第一次泛泛地说“产生了巨大的影响”，用 a；online shopping 泛指“网购”，不可数，不加冠词；small local shops 泛指所有小商店，复数零冠词。正确：Online shopping has had a huge impact on small local shops. 中文“影响”是抽象概念且不带量词，学生常把 impact、effect、influence 当成不可数名词而漏掉 a。
focus: 可数名词单数前漏冠词

instruction: 下面的句子有一处冠词错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Although taxes on sugary drinks are designed to improve public health, critics argue that they can have negative effect on low-income families.
accepted: Although taxes on sugary drinks are designed to improve public health, critics argue that they can have a negative effect on low-income families.
Although taxes on sugary drinks are designed to improve public health, critics argue that they can have negative effects on low-income families.
criteria: effect（影响）是可数名词，单数前不能没有限定词。必须改为 have a negative effect on，或改成复数 have negative effects on。改成 the negative effect 不可接受（并非特指）。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 句子较长，先找出主句和从句中所有的名词，逐个检查前面的限定词。
effect 看起来是抽象概念，但表示“影响、效果”时是可数名词，单数前必须有限定词。
看 have 后面的名词短语：它是单数还是复数？前面有限定词吗？
explanation: effect（影响）是可数名词：have an effect / a negative effect on sth，也可以用复数 have negative effects on sth。这里是第一次泛泛地说“产生负面影响”，用不定冠词 a。正确：…critics argue that they can have a negative effect on low-income families. 其他名词没有问题：taxes、critics、low-income families 是泛指复数，public health 是不可数名词，都用零冠词。中国学生容易把 effect、impact、influence、role 这类表抽象意义的名词当作不可数名词而漏掉冠词。
focus: 可数名词单数前漏冠词

instruction: 下面的句子有一处冠词错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Nowadays, the people spend too much time looking at their phones.
accepted: Nowadays, people spend too much time looking at their phones.
Nowadays people spend too much time looking at their phones.
Nowadays, many people spend too much time looking at their phones.
Nowadays many people spend too much time looking at their phones.
criteria: people 在这里泛指“人们”，泛指的复数名词不加 the，必须删除 the（改为 many people 等也可）。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 看句子的主语以及它前面的词。
泛指一类人或事物时，复数名词前不加 the；只有读者知道是“哪一群”时才用 the。
这句话说的是一般意义上的人，还是上文提到过的某一群特定的人？
explanation: 泛指“人们”时用 people，不加 the。the people 指特定的一群人，例如 the people in my village、the people I work with。正确：Nowadays, people spend too much time looking at their phones. 中国学生常把 the 当成名词的“标志”随手加上，或把“这些人”的意思带进来，导致泛指复数前误加 the。their phones 中的 their 已经是限定词，没有问题。
focus: 泛指的复数/抽象名词前误加 the

instruction: 下面的句子有一处冠词错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Many teenagers believe that the success depends more on luck than on hard work.
accepted: Many teenagers believe that success depends more on luck than on hard work.
Many teenagers believe success depends more on luck than on hard work.
criteria: success 在这里泛指“成功”这一抽象概念，泛指的抽象名词不加 the，必须删除 the。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 检查 that 从句的主语。
泛指的抽象名词（如 happiness、health、education）不加 the；只有被限定、指某一件具体的、读者知道的事情时才用 the。
这里说的是“成功”这件事本身，还是某一次读者已经知道的成功？
explanation: success 表示“成功”这一抽象概念时，泛指不加 the：Success depends on hard work. 只有特指时才用 the，例如 the success of the project（这个项目的成功）。正确：Many teenagers believe that success depends more on luck than on hard work. luck 和 hard work 同样是泛指的抽象名词，零冠词。中国学生受“这个成功”“那种成功”的思维影响，常在抽象名词前乱加 the（the success, the happiness, the society）。
focus: 泛指的复数/抽象名词前误加 the

instruction: 选出冠词使用完全正确的一项。
options: In the coming decades, artificial intelligence is likely to transform the way the society views work and leisure.
In the coming decades, the artificial intelligence is likely to transform the way society views work and leisure.
In the coming decades, artificial intelligence is likely to transform way society views work and leisure.
In the coming decades, artificial intelligence is likely to transform the way society views work and leisure.
option_explanations: 错误：society 指“整个社会”时是泛指，不加 the；只有被限定、特指某个社会时才用 the（如 the society we live in）。
错误：artificial intelligence 泛指“人工智能”这一技术领域，是不可数名词，泛指时不加 the。
错误：way 是可数名词单数，前面必须有限定词；the way (that) sb does sth 中的 the 不能省。
正确：artificial intelligence、society、work 和 leisure 都是泛指的抽象名词，零冠词；way 被后面的从句 society views work and leisure 限定，用 the。
hints: 逐个检查 artificial intelligence、way、society 前面的冠词。
泛指的抽象名词（如 society、technology）不加 the；可数名词单数被从句限定、读者知道是哪一个时用 the。
四个选项中有的多了冠词，有的少了冠词。想一想：哪个名词指“整个社会/整个技术领域”，哪个名词被后面的从句限定？
explanation: society 表示“社会”这一整体概念时不加 the（✗ the society ✓ society）；artificial intelligence 泛指人工智能，也不加 the；而 way 是可数名词单数，被从句 society views work and leisure 限定，必须用 the：the way society views work。正确：In the coming decades, artificial intelligence is likely to transform the way society views work and leisure. 中国学生常把“这个社会”直译成 the society，又因为 way 表示“方式”这种抽象意思而漏掉 the。
focus: 泛指的复数/抽象名词前误加 the

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空（— 表示不填冠词）。
content: Before choosing ______ major, I asked my cousin for ______ advice.
options: a / an
the / an
option_explanations: 错误：major（专业）是可数名词，用 a 是对的；但 advice 是不可数名词，不能说 an advice。
错误：advice 前不加冠词是对的；但 major 是可数名词单数，前面必须有限定词，不能说 choosing major。
正确：major 是可数名词单数，这里泛指“一个专业”，用 a；advice 是不可数名词，不能加 a/an，用零冠词（也可以说 some advice）。
错误：这里不是特指读者已经知道的某个专业，不用 the；advice 不可数，也不能加 an。
hints: 两个空分别在 major 和 advice 前面，先判断这两个名词能不能数。
可数名词单数前必须有限定词；不可数名词前不能用 a/an。
中文说“一个建议”，但英语的 advice 和 information、homework 属于同一类名词。
explanation: major（专业）是可数名词，单数时前面必须有限定词：choose a major。advice 是不可数名词，不能加 a/an，也没有复数（✗ an advice ✗ advices）；可以用零冠词，或说 some advice、a piece of advice。正确：Before choosing a major, I asked my cousin for advice. 中文“一个建议”有量词，学生容易直接对应成 an advice。同类不可数名词：information、homework、equipment、evidence。
focus: 不可数名词前误用 a/an

instruction: 下面的句子有一处冠词错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Over the past two decades, many developing countries have made a great progress in reducing extreme poverty.
accepted: Over the past two decades, many developing countries have made great progress in reducing extreme poverty.
Over the past two decades many developing countries have made great progress in reducing extreme poverty.
Over the past two decades, many developing countries have made a great deal of progress in reducing extreme poverty.
Over the past two decades, many developing countries have made a lot of progress in reducing extreme poverty.
criteria: progress（进步、进展）是不可数名词，前面不能用 a，必须删除 a（have made great progress）；改为 a great deal of progress / a lot of progress 等正确说法也可。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 检查句中 a/an 后面的名词，判断它能不能数。
不可数名词前不能用 a/an；名词前面有形容词修饰时，这条规则同样适用。
问题出在 made 和 in 之间。中文说“取得了巨大的进步”，但英语里这个名词不能用“一个”来数。
explanation: progress（进步、进展）是不可数名词，不能加 a/an，也没有复数：✗ a great progress ✗ progresses。正确：Over the past two decades, many developing countries have made great progress in reducing extreme poverty. 想强调程度，可以说 a great deal of progress 或 significant progress。学生常以为“形容词 + 名词”前一定要加 a，还会受 a great success、a big step 等正确说法的影响（这里的 success 和 step 都可数），但 progress 不可数。extreme poverty 泛指，零冠词。
focus: 不可数名词前误用 a/an

instruction: 下面的句子有一处冠词错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: There is a growing evidence that long working hours increase the risk of heart disease, yet many companies still reward employees who stay late.
accepted: There is growing evidence that long working hours increase the risk of heart disease, yet many companies still reward employees who stay late.
There is a growing body of evidence that long working hours increase the risk of heart disease, yet many companies still reward employees who stay late.
There is a growing amount of evidence that long working hours increase the risk of heart disease, yet many companies still reward employees who stay late.
criteria: evidence（证据）是不可数名词，前面不能用 a，必须删除 a（There is growing evidence that…）；改为 a growing body of evidence / a growing amount of evidence 也正确。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 重点检查句首 There is… 后面的名词短语。
有些名词在英语里不可数（如 information、advice），即使前面有形容词修饰，也不能直接加 a/an。
问题出在 There is 和 that 之间。想一想：a growing concern 为什么可以说，而这个名词为什么不行？
explanation: evidence 是不可数名词，不能加 a/an，也不能加 -s：✗ a growing evidence ✗ evidences。正确：There is growing evidence that long working hours increase the risk of heart disease, yet many companies still reward employees who stay late. 如果想保留 a，可以加一个可数的量词名词：a growing body of evidence。对比：a growing concern 是正确的，因为 concern 表示“担忧”时可以作可数名词。学生常把 a growing… 当作固定搭配套用到所有名词上。句中 the risk of heart disease（被 of 短语限定用 the；heart disease 泛指疾病，零冠词）没有问题。
focus: 不可数名词前误用 a/an

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空（— 表示不填冠词）。
content: Plastic waste causes serious damage to ______ environment, especially to ______ marine life.
options: the / —
the / the
— / the
option_explanations: 正确：the environment 指人类共同生存的“自然环境”，读者都知道是哪一个，固定用 the；marine life 泛指海洋生物，不可数，零冠词。
错误：marine life 不加冠词是对的；但表示“（自然）环境”的 environment 要用 the，这和 nature 不加 the 正好相反。
错误：the environment 正确，但 marine life 泛指所有海洋生物，不可数名词泛指时不加 the。
错误：两处都弄反了：environment 表示自然环境时要加 the，marine life 泛指时不加 the。
hints: 两个空分别在 environment 和 marine life 前面，请分别判断。
有些名词表示我们共同生活的、独一无二的事物，前面固定用 the；泛指的不可数名词则不加冠词。
nature 不加 the，但另一个表示“自然环境”的词是否也一样？
explanation: environment 表示“（自然）环境”时，读者都知道指的是我们共同生活的那个环境，固定用 the：protect the environment, damage to the environment。注意它和 nature 不同：nature 不加 the。marine life 泛指海洋生物，不可数，零冠词。正确：Plastic waste causes serious damage to the environment, especially to marine life. 不少学生学了“抽象名词泛指不加 the”后矫枉过正，把 the environment 的 the 也删掉了。
focus: 特指或固定搭配中漏 the

instruction: 下面的句子有一处冠词错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Many people argue that teenagers who commit crimes should not receive same punishment as adults.
accepted: Many people argue that teenagers who commit crimes should not receive the same punishment as adults.
Many people argue that teenagers who commit crimes should not receive the same punishments as adults.
Many people argue that teenagers who commit crimes should not receive the same punishment as adults do.
criteria: same 表示“相同的”时前面必须加 the（the same … as …），应改为 receive the same punishment as adults。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 检查表示“相同”的那个词前面。
same 所指的东西是确定的（和 as 后面的对象一样）；表示确定的对象，英语要用哪一类冠词？
问题出在 receive 和 same 之间。
explanation: same 前面几乎总要加 the：the same punishment as adults, at the same time, at the same age。因为“相同的”东西是可以确定的（和成年人受到的那种一样），所以用 the。正确：Many people argue that teenagers who commit crimes should not receive the same punishment as adults. 中文“相同的”前面不需要任何词，学生常写出 have same opinion、same as 这类错误。teenagers 和 crimes 是泛指复数，零冠词，没有问题。
focus: 特指或固定搭配中漏 the

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空（— 表示不填冠词）。
content: Just as ______ invention of ______ printing press made ______ knowledge available to ordinary people, the Internet has opened up education to millions.
options: — / the / the
the / a / —
the / the / —
the / the / the
option_explanations: 错误：invention 被 of 短语限定，指“印刷机的发明”这一特定事件，必须用 the；knowledge 在这里泛指，不加 the。
错误：谈论某种发明本身（而不是某一台机器）时，用 the + 单数可数名词，即 the printing press；a printing press 指“一台印刷机”。
正确：the invention of… 被 of 短语限定；the printing press 用 the + 单数名词表示“印刷机”这一发明；knowledge 泛指知识，抽象名词零冠词。
错误：knowledge 在这里泛指一切知识，不是某种特定的知识，不加 the。
hints: 三个空分别在 invention、printing press、knowledge 前面，逐一判断。
被 of 短语限定的名词通常用 the；谈论某种发明或某类事物整体时，可以用 the + 单数可数名词；泛指的抽象名词不加冠词。
想一想：句子说的是某一台具体的机器，还是“印刷机”这一类发明？knowledge 指的是某种特定的知识吗？
explanation: the + 单数可数名词可以表示一类事物，常用于谈论发明、动物或乐器：the printing press, the smartphone, the tiger。这里说的是“印刷机”这项发明，而不是某一台印刷机，所以用 the printing press。invention 被 of 短语限定，用 the；knowledge 泛指，零冠词。正确：Just as the invention of the printing press made knowledge available to ordinary people, the Internet has opened up education to millions. 中国学生常以为“泛指就不用 the”，不知道 the + 单数名词也可以表示类别。
focus: 类指 the：the + 单数名词/形容词表一类

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: My brother wants to become ______ engineer, so he is taking ______ one-year course in computer science.
options: an / a
a / an
an / an
a / a
option_explanations: 正确：engineer 以元音音素 /e/ 开头，用 an；one-year 中的 one 读 /wʌn/，以辅音音素 /w/ 开头，用 a。
错误：两个都反了：engineer 以元音音素开头，要用 an；one 以辅音音素 /w/ 开头，要用 a。
错误：one 虽然以字母 o 开头，但读音 /wʌn/ 以辅音开头，应用 a。
错误：engineer 以元音音素 /e/ 开头，应用 an。
hints: 大声读出两个空格后面的单词，注意第一个音。
a / an 看读音而不是字母：元音音素前用 an，辅音音素前用 a。
one 的第一个音和 won、we 相同。
explanation: a / an 由后面单词的第一个音素决定：engineer /ˌendʒɪˈnɪə(r)/ 以元音开头，用 an；one-year 中 one 读 /wʌn/，以辅音 /w/ 开头，用 a。正确：My brother wants to become an engineer, so he is taking a one-year course in computer science. 学生常按字母判断，写成 an one-year course。同类：a useful tool, a uniform, an hour, an honest answer。
focus: a/an 按读音而不是字母选择

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: Pursuing ______ MBA after several years at ______ European firm can be ______ once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for ambitious employees.
options: a / an / an
an / an / a
a / a / an
an / a / a
option_explanations: 错误：三处都是按字母判断。MBA 按字母读 /ˌem biː ˈeɪ/，以元音音素开头，应用 an；European /ˌjʊərəˈpiːən/ 和 once /wʌns/ 以辅音音素开头，应用 a。
错误：European 虽以字母 E 开头，但第一个音是 /j/（和 you 相同），是辅音音素，应用 a。
错误：MBA 的第一个音是字母 M 的读音 /em/，以元音音素开头，应用 an；once 以 /w/ 开头，应用 a。
正确：an MBA（/em/，元音音素）、a European firm（/j/，辅音音素）、a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity（/w/，辅音音素）。
hints: 三个空后面的词都容易“看字母”出错，请读出它们的第一个音。
缩写词按字母的读音判断；以字母 E、O 开头的词不一定以元音音素开头。
把 MBA 一个字母一个字母地读出来；European 和 once 的第一个音分别和哪个常见单词相同？
explanation: a / an 由读音决定。缩写词按字母读：MBA 读 /ˌem biː ˈeɪ/，以元音音素开头，用 an（类似 an SUV, an X-ray）；European 以 /j/ 开头，once 以 /w/ 开头，都是辅音音素，用 a。正确：Pursuing an MBA after several years at a European firm can be a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for ambitious employees. 学生常按首字母判断，写成 a MBA、an European、an once-in-a-lifetime。
focus: a/an 按读音而不是字母选择

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空（— 表示不填冠词）。
content: ______ number of tourists visiting the old town has risen by ______ third since the new railway station opened.
options: A / a
The / a
The / the
The / —
option_explanations: 错误：a number of 意为“许多”（= many），谓语应用复数，而且“许多游客增长了三分之一”说不通；这里要说的是“游客的数量”。
正确：the number of… 表示“……的数量”，谓语用单数 has risen；分数“三分之一”说 a third（= one third）。
错误：the third 表示“第三（个）”，不表示分数“三分之一”；表示“增长了三分之一”不能用 the。
错误：third 作分数时是可数名词，单数前必须有限定词，不能说 by third。
hints: 第一个空注意谓语 has risen：增长的是什么？第二个空注意 third 在这里表示什么意思。
a number of 和 the number of 意思不同；英语分数“三分之一”中的 third 是可数名词，单数前必须有限定词。
“游客的数量”是一个可确定的具体数字；而 the third 通常表示“第三个”，不是分数。
explanation: the number of + 复数名词 =“……的数量”，谓语用单数：The number of tourists has risen. a number of + 复数名词 =“许多”，谓语用复数：A number of tourists have complained. 分数用 a/one + 序数词：a third（三分之一）、a quarter（四分之一）；the third 是“第三个”。正确：The number of tourists visiting the old town has risen by a third since the new railway station opened. 中文“数量”“三分之一”前都没有冠词，学生常写成 Number of tourists… 或 by third。
focus: 特指或固定搭配中漏 the

instruction: 下面的句子有一处冠词错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: In many ageing societies, governments must find ways to provide affordable care for elderly without placing too heavy a burden on taxpayers.
accepted: In many ageing societies, governments must find ways to provide affordable care for the elderly without placing too heavy a burden on taxpayers.
In many ageing societies, governments must find ways to provide affordable care for elderly people without placing too heavy a burden on taxpayers.
In many ageing societies, governments must find ways to provide affordable care for older people without placing too heavy a burden on taxpayers.
In many aging societies, governments must find ways to provide affordable care for the elderly without placing too heavy a burden on taxpayers.
In many aging societies, governments must find ways to provide affordable care for elderly people without placing too heavy a burden on taxpayers.
In many aging societies, governments must find ways to provide affordable care for older people without placing too heavy a burden on taxpayers.
criteria: elderly 是形容词，不能单独作名词使用；表示“老年人”这一群体要用 the + 形容词（the elderly），或改为 elderly people / older people。too heavy a burden 是正确结构，不需要改；ageing / aging 两种拼写均可。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 找一找句中表示“老年人”的词，判断它是名词还是形容词。
elderly 是形容词，不能单独作名词；英语有专门的结构可以让形容词表示“一类人”。
too heavy a burden 的语序是正确的，问题在 care for 后面。想想 the poor、the young 是怎么构成的。
explanation: elderly 是形容词，不能单独当名词用。表示“老年人”这一群体，要用 the + 形容词：the elderly（= elderly people，作主语时谓语用复数），类似 the poor、the young、the unemployed。也可以说 elderly people / older people。正确：In many ageing societies, governments must find ways to provide affordable care for the elderly without placing too heavy a burden on taxpayers. 注意 too heavy a burden（too + 形容词 + a + 名词）是正确的特殊语序，不要改。中文“老人”是名词，学生容易把 elderly 也当名词用而漏掉 the。
focus: 类指 the：the + 单数名词/形容词表一类

instruction: 选择正确的动词填空。
content: Eating too much sugar can ______ serious harm to children's teeth.
options: make
do
take
give
option_explanations: 错误：make 不和 harm 搭配。汉语“造成伤害”容易被直译成 make harm；make 常与 a mistake、a decision、progress 搭配。
正确：do harm / damage to sth 是固定搭配，意思是“对……造成伤害/损害”。
错误：take harm 不是英语搭配；take 常与 action、measures、a risk 搭配。
错误：give harm 是“给……带来伤害”的直译，英语不这样说。
hints: 空格后面是名词 harm，考的是“动词 + harm”的固定搭配。
harm、damage、good 这类表示“坏处/好处”的名词有固定的轻动词，不能按汉语“造成”“给”直译。
想一想 “Exercise ___ you good.”（锻炼对你有好处）这句话里填哪个动词，harm 和 good 用的是同一个。
explanation: 表示“对……造成伤害/损害”，英语用 do harm / damage to sth，反义说法是 do sb good；也可以说 cause harm to sth。汉语“造成伤害”“给……带来危害”常被直译成 make harm 或 give harm，这是母语迁移造成的动词搭配错误。正确句：Eating too much sugar can do serious harm to children's teeth.
focus: 轻动词 make / do / take 搭配混用

instruction: 句中有一处动词与名词搭配不当，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Children should never eat medicine without asking an adult first.
accepted: Children should never take medicine without asking an adult first.
Children should never take any medicine without asking an adult first.
Children should never take medication without asking an adult first.
Children should never take any medication without asking an adult first.
criteria: 必须把 eat medicine 改为地道搭配 take medicine（或 take medication）。其他部分可以不变；其他地道且语法正确的改法也接受。
hints: 注意句中的动词和它后面的名词 medicine。
汉语说“吃药”，但英语里和 medicine 搭配的动词不是“吃饭”的那个词。
想一想英语里“服用药片、维生素”（___ a pill / ___ vitamins）用的是哪个常见动词。
explanation: 汉语“吃药”不能直译成 eat medicine。英语中 eat 只用于食物，服药用 take：take medicine / take a pill / take vitamins。中国学生按“吃”字直接对应 eat，就会出错。正确句：Children should never take medicine without asking an adult first.
focus: 动宾搭配逐字直译

instruction: 选择最地道的词填空。
content: Many people avoid driving into the city centre because the traffic there is always ______.
options: big
crowded
heavy
large
option_explanations: 错误：traffic 不用 big 形容，“交通量大”直译成 big traffic 不地道。
错误：crowded 用来形容地方或交通工具（crowded streets / roads / buses），不能说 the traffic is crowded。
正确：heavy traffic / the traffic is heavy（车流量大、交通繁忙）是固定搭配。
错误：large 形容体积或数量（a large city, a large number），不直接修饰 traffic；可以说 a large volume of traffic。
hints: 空格描述的是名词 traffic，考的是“形容词 + 名词”的搭配。
汉语“交通量大”“路上很挤”里的“大”“挤”不能直译；crowded 通常描述地方，而不是 traffic。
英语里形容“车流量大”和“雨下得大”，用的是同一个形容词。
explanation: 英语说 heavy traffic 或 the traffic is heavy（车流量大），同样也说 heavy rain。汉语“交通很拥挤”“车流量大”容易被直译成 big traffic 或 the traffic is crowded；crowded 只形容地方，如 The roads are crowded. 正确句：Many people avoid driving into the city centre because the traffic there is always heavy.
focus: 形容词与名词搭配不当

instruction: 句中有一处动词与介词的搭配错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Many elderly people who live alone lack of companionship and emotional support.
accepted: Many elderly people who live alone lack companionship and emotional support.
Many elderly people who live alone suffer from a lack of companionship and emotional support.
Many elderly people who live alone experience a lack of companionship and emotional support.
criteria: 必须去掉动词 lack 后多余的 of（动词 lack 是及物动词，直接接宾语）；也可以改为名词结构，如 suffer from / experience a lack of。其他部分不变即可；其他地道且语法正确的改法也接受。
hints: 看主语后面的谓语动词和紧跟在它后面的那个词。
lack 既可以作动词，也可以作名词，两种词性的搭配方式不同。
作动词时，lack 和 need、have 一样直接接宾语；只有名词 a lack 后面才接介词。
explanation: lack 作动词时是及物动词：lack sth（缺少某物）；只有作名词时才接 of：a lack of sth。中国学生受汉语“缺乏……”和名词短语 a lack of 的影响，常把 lack of 直接当谓语用。正确句：Many elderly people who live alone lack companionship and emotional support. 也可以说 …suffer from a lack of companionship and emotional support.
focus: 及物动词后多加介词

instruction: 选择正确的动词填空。
content: Even small changes in our daily habits, such as carrying a reusable bag, can ______ a real difference to the environment.
options: bring
do
take
make
option_explanations: 错误：bring a difference 是“带来改变/不同”的直译，英语不这样说；要用 bring 时可以说 bring about a change。
错误：do 不和 difference 搭配。
错误：take a difference 不是英语搭配。
正确：make a difference (to sth) 是固定搭配，意思是“对……产生（积极）影响、起作用”。
hints: 空格后面是 a real difference，考的是“动词 + difference”的固定搭配。
汉语“带来改变”里的“带来”不能直译；difference 和一个常用轻动词固定搭配。
这个动词也用在 ___ progress、___ an effort、___ a decision 中。
explanation: make a difference (to sth) 表示“对……产生影响、起作用”，常说 make a big / real / huge difference。汉语“带来改变/不同”常被直译成 bring a difference；如果想用 bring，应说 bring about a change。正确句：Even small changes in our daily habits, such as carrying a reusable bag, can make a real difference to the environment.
focus: 轻动词 make / do / take 搭配混用

instruction: 句中有一处动词与名词搭配不当，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: In some remote villages, many children still do not have the chance to accept a proper education.
accepted: In some remote villages, many children still do not have the chance to receive a proper education.
In some remote villages, many children still do not have the chance to get a proper education.
In some remote villages, many children still do not have the chance to have a proper education.
In some remote villages, many children still do not have the chance to obtain a proper education.
In some remote villages, many children still do not have the chance of receiving a proper education.
In some remote villages, many children still do not have the chance to be properly educated.
criteria: 必须把 accept a proper education 改为地道搭配，如 receive / get / have a proper education，或改为 be properly educated。其他部分可以不变；其他地道且语法正确的改法也接受。
hints: 注意 to 后面的动词和 education 的搭配。
accept 表示主观上“同意接受”（邀请、建议、观点），而“受教育”在英语里用另一个动词。
想一想“收到一封信”“接受治疗”在英语里用的那个动词，它表示“得到”，而不是“同意”。
explanation: 汉语“接受教育”不能直译成 accept education。accept 指主动同意接受某样东西（accept an offer / an invitation / an idea），而“受教育”说 receive / get / have an education，也可以用被动 be educated。正确句：In some remote villages, many children still do not have the chance to receive a proper education.
focus: 动宾搭配逐字直译

instruction: 句中有一处形容词与名词搭配不当，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Smoking greatly increases the risk of heavy diseases such as lung cancer.
accepted: Smoking greatly increases the risk of serious diseases such as lung cancer.
Smoking greatly increases the risk of serious diseases, such as lung cancer.
Smoking greatly increases the risk of serious illnesses such as lung cancer.
Smoking greatly increases the risk of severe diseases such as lung cancer.
Smoking greatly increases the risk of major diseases such as lung cancer.
Smoking greatly increases the risk of deadly diseases such as lung cancer.
Smoking greatly increases the risk of fatal diseases such as lung cancer.
Smoking greatly increases the risk of life-threatening diseases such as lung cancer.
criteria: 必须把 heavy diseases 改为地道搭配，如 serious / severe / major / deadly / fatal / life-threatening diseases（或 illnesses）。其他部分可以不变；其他地道且语法正确的改法也接受。
hints: 注意修饰 diseases 的那个形容词。
汉语“重病”里的“重”不能直译；heavy 可以说 heavy smoker、heavy rain，但不用来表示疾病严重。
形容疾病“严重”，英语常用一个也能修饰 problem、injury、mistake 的形容词。
explanation: 汉语“重病”“严重的疾病”不能直译成 heavy disease。形容疾病严重用 serious / severe / major / life-threatening，如 a serious illness。heavy 的常见搭配是 heavy smoker、heavy rain、heavy traffic、heavy workload。正确句：Smoking greatly increases the risk of serious diseases such as lung cancer.
focus: 形容词与名词搭配不当

instruction: 句中有一处动词与介词的搭配错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Thanks to video calls, students who study abroad can contact with their families every day.
accepted: Thanks to video calls, students who study abroad can contact their families every day.
Thanks to video calls, students who study abroad can keep in touch with their families every day.
Thanks to video calls, students who study abroad can stay in touch with their families every day.
Thanks to video calls, students who study abroad can be in touch with their families every day.
Thanks to video calls, students who study abroad can keep in contact with their families every day.
Thanks to video calls, students who study abroad can stay in contact with their families every day.
Thanks to video calls, students who study abroad can be in contact with their families every day.
Thanks to video calls, students who study abroad can communicate with their families every day.
Thanks to video calls, students who study abroad can talk to their families every day.
Thanks to video calls, students who study abroad can talk with their families every day.
criteria: 必须去掉动词 contact 后多余的 with（动词 contact 直接接宾语），或改为 keep / stay / be in contact with、keep / stay / be in touch with 等结构。其他部分不变即可；其他地道且语法正确的改法也接受。
hints: 看情态动词 can 后面的动词和紧跟在它后面的词。
contact 作动词和作名词时搭配不同：名词可以说 be in contact with sb。
作动词时，contact 和 phone、email 一样，后面直接跟“人”。
explanation: contact 作动词是及物动词：contact sb（联系某人）；只有名词 contact 才和 with 搭配：be / keep in contact with sb，have contact with sb。汉语“和……联系”让学生习惯性地加上 with。正确句：Thanks to video calls, students who study abroad can contact their families every day. 也可以说 …can keep in touch with their families every day.
focus: 及物动词后多加介词

instruction: 选择正确的搭配填空。
content: Young athletes must learn to ______ the pressure of competing in front of large crowds.
options: cope with
cope
deal
face with
option_explanations: 正确：cope 表示“应对、对付”时必须带 with：cope with pressure / stress。
错误：cope 后面不能直接接宾语，漏掉了 with。
错误：deal 表示“处理、应对”时要说 deal with，不能直接接 the pressure。
错误：face 是及物动词，直接说 face the pressure，或用被动 be faced with；face with 多加了介词。
hints: 注意空格后面紧跟着宾语 the pressure。
有些动词必须借助介词才能接宾语，有些动词本身就能直接接宾语，不能再加介词。
逐个检查：哪个选项的动词本身需要介词，而且已经带上了正确的介词？
explanation: cope 和 deal 表示“应对、处理”时都必须带 with：cope with pressure，deal with problems。face 则是及物动词：face difficulties（或 be faced with difficulties），不能说 face with。汉语“应对压力”“处理问题”“面对困难”都是动词直接带宾语，所以学生常漏掉 with，或在 face 后乱加 with。正确句：Young athletes must learn to cope with the pressure of competing in front of large crowds.
focus: 不及物动词漏掉介词

instruction: 选择正确的介词填空。
content: Public libraries give people on low incomes free access ______ books, computers and the Internet.
options: of
for
to
with
option_explanations: 错误：access 后面不接 of；这是把汉语“……的使用权”里的“的”直译成 of。
错误：access for 后面接的是“获得使用权的人”（access for disabled people），而这里空格后是被使用的资源 books 等。
正确：access to sth（获得、使用某物的机会或权利）是固定搭配：have / give sb access to sth。
错误：access 不和 with 搭配。
hints: 空格前面是名词 access，考的是“名词 + 介词”的固定搭配。
介词由名词 access 决定，不能按汉语“……的”直译。
access 后面的介词与 the key ___ success、the answer ___ the question 中的介词相同。
explanation: access 表示“使用/获得……的机会或权利”时固定搭配 to：have access to sth，give sb access to sth，free access to the Internet。中国学生受汉语“……的”影响，常写成 access of。同类搭配还有 the key to、the solution to、the answer to、an approach to。正确句：Public libraries give people on low incomes free access to books, computers and the Internet.
focus: 名词后的介词搭配错误

instruction: 句中有一处动词与名词搭配不当，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Before the new vaccine can be approved, scientists need to make more research into its long-term side effects.
accepted: Before the new vaccine can be approved, scientists need to do more research into its long-term side effects.
Before the new vaccine can be approved, scientists need to conduct more research into its long-term side effects.
Before the new vaccine can be approved, scientists need to carry out more research into its long-term side effects.
Before the new vaccine can be approved, scientists need to undertake more research into its long-term side effects.
Before the new vaccine can be approved, scientists need to do more research on its long-term side effects.
Before the new vaccine can be approved, scientists need to conduct more research on its long-term side effects.
Before the new vaccine can be approved, scientists need to carry out more research on its long-term side effects.
Before the new vaccine can be approved, scientists need to undertake more research on its long-term side effects.
criteria: 必须把 make more research 改为地道搭配：do / conduct / carry out / undertake (more) research（into / on 均可）。其他部分可以不变；其他地道且语法正确的改法也接受。
hints: 注意 need to 后面的动词和名词 research 的搭配。
make 和 do 都可以对应汉语的“做”，但它们搭配的名词不同；research 属于“从事某项工作”的名词。
想一想 ___ homework、___ the housework 用的是哪个动词，research 和它们搭配方式相同；正式文体中还有更书面的动词可选。
explanation: research 和 do 搭配（do research），正式写作中常用 conduct / carry out / undertake research；make research 不地道。一般来说，make 侧重“产生结果”（make a decision, make progress, make a mistake），do 侧重“从事工作或活动”（do research, do homework, do business）。汉语“做研究”的“做”既像 make 又像 do，学生因此混用。另外 research 通常作不可数名词。正确句：Before the new vaccine can be approved, scientists need to do more research into its long-term side effects.
focus: 轻动词 make / do / take 搭配混用

instruction: 选择最地道的词填空。
content: Faced with ______ competition in the job market, many graduates now take extra online courses to make their CVs stand out.
options: violent
fierce
cruel
strict
option_explanations: 错误：violent 意为“暴力的、猛烈的”（violent crime, a violent storm），“激烈的竞争”不能直译成 violent competition。
正确：fierce competition 是地道搭配，也可以说 intense / stiff / keen competition。
错误：cruel 形容人或行为“残忍的”，不和 competition 搭配；“残酷的竞争”应说 fierce / intense competition 或 cut-throat competition。
错误：strict 形容规则、要求或人“严格的”（strict rules, a strict teacher），不能修饰 competition。
hints: 空格修饰名词 competition，考的是“形容词 + 名词”的搭配。
汉语“激烈的竞争”“残酷的竞争”不能逐字翻译；violent 多与犯罪、暴力有关。
这个形容词也常用来形容动物凶猛或战斗激烈，例如 a ___ dog、___ fighting。
explanation: competition 的地道形容词搭配是 fierce / intense / stiff / keen competition。汉语“激烈的竞争”中的“激烈”常被直译成 violent，“残酷的竞争”被直译成 cruel competition，都不地道。violent 用于 violent crime / a violent storm，strict 用于 strict rules。正确句：Faced with fierce competition in the job market, many graduates now take extra online courses to make their CVs stand out.
focus: 形容词与名词搭配不当

instruction: 选择正确的搭配填空。
content: Critics argue that the new law fails to ______ the root causes of youth crime, such as poverty and a lack of opportunities.
options: address to
deal
address on
address
option_explanations: 错误：address 表示“处理、着手解决（问题）”时是及物动词，后面不能加 to；address 和 to 连用的是 address a letter / a speech to sb（把信件、讲话写给/说给某人）这类用法，to 引出的是对象。
错误：deal 表示“处理”时必须说 deal with，不能直接接宾语。
错误：address 表示“处理、应对”时是及物动词，不能加 on（可能受 focus on 的影响）。
正确：address a problem / an issue / the root causes of sth 意为“处理、着手解决”，及物动词直接接宾语。
hints: 注意空格后面紧跟着宾语 the root causes of youth crime。
address 有多个意思；它和 to 一起出现时，通常是“把信件、讲话写给/说给某人”的意思，to 后面接的是对象，而不是要解决的问题。
表示“处理、应对（问题）”时，address 的用法和 tackle a problem 中的 tackle 一样。
explanation: address 表示“处理、着手解决（问题）”时是及物动词：address a problem / an issue / the root causes of crime，后面不加介词。address a letter / a speech to sb（把信件、讲话写给/说给某人）中的 to 引出的是对象，和“处理问题”的意思无关。deal 正相反，表示“处理”时必须说 deal with。中国学生受汉语“针对……”“着眼于……”的影响，常写成 address to / address on。正确句：Critics argue that the new law fails to address the root causes of youth crime, such as poverty and a lack of opportunities.
focus: 及物动词后多加介词

instruction: 句中有一处动词与介词的搭配错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: In many countries, online shopping now accounts nearly a third of all retail sales.
accepted: In many countries, online shopping now accounts for nearly a third of all retail sales.
In many countries, online shopping now accounts for nearly one third of all retail sales.
In many countries, online shopping now accounts for nearly one-third of all retail sales.
In many countries, online shopping now makes up nearly a third of all retail sales.
In many countries, online shopping now represents nearly a third of all retail sales.
In many countries, online shopping now constitutes nearly a third of all retail sales.
criteria: 必须在 accounts 后补上介词 for（account for 表示“占……比例”），也可以改用 make up / represent / constitute 等及物动词。其他部分可以不变；其他地道且语法正确的改法也接受。
hints: 注意谓语动词 accounts 和后面的比例表达之间是怎样连接的。
account 表示“占（多少比例）”时不能直接接宾语，必须借助一个介词。
这个介词和 look ___ a job、wait ___ the bus 中的介词相同。
explanation: account for 表示“占（比例）”，也可以表示“解释（原因）”，for 不能省略：Online shopping accounts for 30% of retail sales. 汉语“占……”是及物动词，可以直接带宾语，学生因此漏掉 for，或误用 occupy（✗ occupy 30%）。也可以改用及物动词 make up / represent / constitute。正确句：In many countries, online shopping now accounts for nearly a third of all retail sales.
focus: 不及物动词漏掉介词

instruction: 选择正确的动词填空。
content: If visitor numbers continue to grow at the current rate, mass tourism could ______ a serious threat to the fragile ecosystems of small islands.
options: pose
make
bring
give
option_explanations: 正确：pose a threat / risk / challenge to sth 是正式写作中的固定搭配，意为“对……构成威胁”。
错误：make a threat 指人“发出威胁、恐吓”（He made threats against his neighbour），主语应是人；这里要表达的是“构成威胁”。
错误：bring a threat 是“带来威胁”的直译，不是地道搭配。
错误：give a threat 是“给……带来威胁”的直译，英语不这样说。
hints: 空格后面是 a serious threat to…，考的是“动词 + threat”的搭配。
汉语“带来威胁”“构成威胁”不能直译；这里需要正式写作中表示“构成（威胁、风险、挑战）”的动词。
这个动词也常和 a risk、a challenge 搭配，还可以表示“提出（问题）”。
explanation: threat、risk、challenge、danger 在正式写作中常和 pose 搭配：pose a threat / risk / challenge to sth（对……构成威胁/风险/挑战），也可以用 represent / constitute a threat。make a threat 指人“发出威胁”。中国学生常把“带来威胁”直译成 bring a threat 或 give a threat。正确句：If visitor numbers continue to grow at the current rate, mass tourism could pose a serious threat to the fragile ecosystems of small islands.
focus: 动宾搭配逐字直译

instruction: 句中有一处名词与介词的搭配错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: A growing body of research suggests that excessive screen time can have a negative impact to young children's ability to concentrate.
accepted: A growing body of research suggests that excessive screen time can have a negative impact on young children's ability to concentrate.
A growing body of research suggests that excessive screen time can have a negative impact upon young children's ability to concentrate.
A growing body of research suggests that excessive screen time can have a negative effect on young children's ability to concentrate.
A growing body of research suggests that excessive screen time can have a negative influence on young children's ability to concentrate.
criteria: 必须把 impact 后的介词 to 改为 on（或正式的 upon）：have an impact / effect / influence on sth。其他部分可以不变；其他地道且语法正确的改法也接受。
hints: 检查名词 impact 和它后面那个介词的搭配。
介词由前面的名词决定；汉语“对……有影响”里的“对”不一定译成 to。
impact、effect、influence 后面接“受影响的对象”时，用的是同一个表示“作用在……之上”的介词。
explanation: impact / effect / influence 后面接受影响的对象时用 on：have a negative impact on sth，正式文体中也可以用 upon。汉语“对……有影响”中的“对”常被直译成 to，写成 impact to。注意不要和 damage / threat 混淆，它们后面才用 to（damage to the environment, a threat to health）。正确句：A growing body of research suggests that excessive screen time can have a negative impact on young children's ability to concentrate.
focus: 名词后的介词搭配错误

instruction: 选择能使句子保持平行结构的选项填空。
content: When they travel abroad, many families enjoy swimming, visiting museums and ______.
options: to try local food
try local food
trying local food
they try local food
option_explanations: 错误：enjoy 后面不能接 to do，而且 to try 与前面的 swimming、visiting 形式不一致。
错误：try 是动词原形，与前面两个 -ing 形式不平行；enjoy 后面也不能直接接动词原形。
正确：trying local food 与 swimming、visiting museums 都是 -ing 形式，三项都作 enjoy 的宾语。
错误：they try local food 是完整分句，不能和两个 -ing 短语并列。
hints: 先看空格前面两个并列项是什么形式。
and 连接的三项都是 enjoy 的宾语，形式必须相同；再想想 enjoy 后面习惯接什么形式。
把每个选项直接放在 enjoy 后面读一遍，再和 swimming、visiting museums 比较。
explanation: and 连接的并列成分必须形式一致。enjoy 后面只能接动名词（-ing），前两项 swimming、visiting museums 都是 -ing 形式，第三项也必须是 -ing。中国学生常受汉语“喜欢游泳、参观博物馆、尝当地美食”的影响，觉得动词不用变形，于是写出 to try 或 try，也有人把最后一项写成完整句 they try…。正确：When they travel abroad, many families enjoy swimming, visiting museums and trying local food.
focus: 列举中 to do / doing / 动词原形混用

instruction: 选择能使句子保持平行结构的选项填空。
content: Employers today want staff who are hard-working, flexible and ______.
options: creative
creativity
have creativity
they are creative
option_explanations: 正确：creative 是形容词，与 hard-working、flexible 一样，都作 are 的表语。
错误：creativity 是名词，与前面两个形容词词性不同，are creativity 也说不通。
错误：have creativity 是动词短语，放进由形容词组成的列举中，三项形式不一致；第三项应与 hard-working、flexible 一样用形容词。
错误：they are creative 是完整分句，不能放进由形容词组成的列举中。
hints: 看 hard-working、flexible 是什么词性。
and 连接的三项都接在 are 后面作表语，词性必须相同。
把每个选项单独接在 staff who are 后面读一读。
explanation: and 连接的三项都作 are 的表语，必须同为形容词：hard-working, flexible and creative。中国学生常混淆形容词和名词（creative / creativity、confident / confidence），或在列举末尾另起一句 they are…，因为汉语“勤奋、灵活、有创造力”中各项词性不需要统一。正确：Employers today want staff who are hard-working, flexible and creative.
focus: 并列项词性或结构不一致（形容词/名词/从句混用）

instruction: 四个句子都想表达“智能手机让人们能够随时联系家人、在线支付账单，并在陌生的城市里找到路”。选择平行结构正确的一句。
options: Smartphones allow people to contact their families at any time, pay bills online and they can find their way in unfamiliar cities.
Smartphones allow people to contact their families at any time, paying bills online and finding their way in unfamiliar cities.
Smartphones allow people to contact their families at any time, pay bills online and finding their way in unfamiliar cities.
Smartphones allow people to contact their families at any time, pay bills online and find their way in unfamiliar cities.
option_explanations: 错误：前两项是共用 to 的动词原形短语，第三项 they can find… 却是完整分句，破坏了平行。
错误：第一项是 to contact，后两项变成 -ing 形式，三项形式不一致。
错误：前两项是共用 to 的动词原形，第三项却是 finding，形式不一致。
正确：contact、pay、find 三项都是动词原形短语，共用 allow people to 中的 to。
hints: 找出 allow people to 后面列举的三件事。
三项都要接在同一个 to 后面，形式必须相同，不能中途变成 -ing 或完整句子。
依次把每个句子的第三项接到 allow people to 后面读一读。
explanation: allow sb to do 后面并列的三项都应是动词原形短语，共用一个 to：to contact…, pay… and find…。中国学生写列举时常在最后一项“另起一句”（they can find…），因为汉语可以用逗号把短语和小句连在一起；也常把后面的项改成 -ing。正确：Smartphones allow people to contact their families at any time, pay bills online and find their way in unfamiliar cities.
focus: 并列短语中混入完整分句

instruction: 选择能使比较结构两侧保持平行的选项填空。
content: For many teenagers, learning English through songs and films can be just as useful as ______ it from a textbook.
options: to learn
learning
learn
they learn
option_explanations: 错误：to learn 是不定式，与作主语的动名词短语 learning English… 形式不一致。
正确：learning it from a textbook 与主语 learning English through songs and films 都是动名词短语，比较对象形式一致。
错误：learn 是动词原形，不能与作主语的动名词短语相比较。
错误：they learn it… 是完整分句，而比较的另一方是动名词短语，两侧不对等。
hints: 找出 as…as 两侧被比较的两样东西。
比较结构两侧被比较的成分必须形式一致。
先看句子的主语用的是什么形式，再选同样形式的选项。
explanation: as…as 和 than 一样，两侧被比较的成分必须平行。句子主语是动名词短语 learning English through songs and films，所以第二个 as 后面也应是动名词。中国学生常受汉语“通过歌曲电影学英语和用课本学一样有用”的影响，动词不变形，随手写成 to learn 或 they learn。正确：For many teenagers, learning English through songs and films can be just as useful as learning it from a textbook.
focus: 比较结构两侧形式或对象不对等

instruction: 四个句子都想表达“居民可以把旧衣服捐给慈善机构，或者送到回收中心”。选择关联连词使用正确、两侧平行的一句。
options: Residents can either give their old clothes to charity or they can take them to a recycling centre.
Either residents can give their old clothes to charity or take them to a recycling centre.
Residents can either give their old clothes to charity or take them to a recycling centre.
Residents can give either their old clothes to charity or take them to a recycling centre.
option_explanations: 错误：either 后面是动词短语 give…，or 后面却是完整分句 they can take…，两侧不对称。
错误：either 后面是完整分句 residents can give…，or 后面只是动词短语 take…，两侧不对称。
正确：either 和 or 后面都是动词原形短语（give… / take…），共用 can，完全对称。
错误：either 放在 give 之后，后接名词短语 their old clothes，而 or 后接动词短语 take…，两侧不对称。
hints: 注意每个句子中 either 的位置。
either…or 是关联连词，紧跟 either 和紧跟 or 的成分必须是同一类。
把 either 后面的部分和 or 后面的部分分别抄下来，看看它们是不是同一种结构。
explanation: 关联连词 either…or 要紧贴在被选择的两个成分前面，两边成分必须同类。本句要选择的是两个动作 give… 和 take…，所以 either 应放在 can 之后、give 之前。中国学生受汉语“要么…要么…”位置灵活的影响，常把 either 放在句首或动词之后，或者在 or 后面重复主语。正确：Residents can either give their old clothes to charity or take them to a recycling centre.
focus: 关联连词位置不当导致两侧不对称

instruction: 选择能使句子语法完整、平行结构正确的选项填空。
content: Many industries ______ basic scientific research, so governments should continue to fund it.
options: depend on and benefit from
depend and benefit from
rely and benefit from
are dependent and benefit from
option_explanations: 正确：depend on 和 benefit from 各自带上了需要的介词，两个动词短语可以共用宾语 basic scientific research。
错误：depend 必须和 on 搭配，省略 on 后前半部分变成 depend basic scientific research，搭配残缺。
错误：rely 必须和 on 搭配，省略 on 后前半部分变成 rely basic scientific research，搭配残缺。
错误：dependent 需要与 on 搭配（be dependent on），省略 on 后，basic scientific research 无法同时接在两个部分后面。
hints: 把共用的宾语 basic scientific research 分别接在 and 前后两个部分后面读一读。
并列成分共用一个宾语时，每一部分都必须能和这个宾语直接搭配，各自需要的介词不能省。
想一想 depend、rely、dependent 后面通常要跟哪个介词。
explanation: 两个动词共用一个宾语时，每个动词都必须能单独与这个宾语搭配。depend on sth、benefit from sth 中的介词都不能省。如果写成 depend and benefit from，前半部分就成了 depend basic scientific research，搭配残缺。汉语说“依赖并受益于基础研究”，“依赖”后面不需要介词，因此学生容易漏掉 on。正确：Many industries depend on and benefit from basic scientific research, so governments should continue to fund it.（正式写作中也可加逗号：depend on, and benefit from, basic scientific research。）
focus: 省略共同成分导致搭配残缺

instruction: 四个句子都想表达“评判一篇新闻报道时，读者应考虑它的来源、发布日期以及作者的写作目的”。选择平行结构正确的一句。
options: When judging a news report, readers should consider its source, when it was published and the author's purpose.
When judging a news report, readers should consider its source, its publication date and why the author wrote it.
When judging a news report, readers should consider where it comes from, its publication date and the author's purpose.
When judging a news report, readers should consider its source, its publication date and the author's purpose.
option_explanations: 错误：第二项 when it was published 是从句，另外两项是名词短语，形式不一致。
错误：前两项是名词短语，第三项 why the author wrote it 是从句，破坏了平行。
错误：第一项 where it comes from 是从句，后两项是名词短语，形式不一致。
正确：its source、its publication date、the author's purpose 都是名词短语，三项形式统一。
hints: 找出 consider 后面列举的三个考虑因素。
列举中的每一项应该是同一种结构：要么都是名词短语，要么都是从句。
名词短语和以 wh- 词开头的从句不能混在同一个列举中。
explanation: consider 后面并列的三个宾语应采用同一种结构，最简洁的写法是三个名词短语：its source, its publication date and the author's purpose。把其中一项写成 when it was published、why the author wrote it 之类的从句，单看语法虽能成立，但列举形式不统一，在学术写作中属于平行结构错误。中国学生常按汉语思路“它的来源、什么时候发的、作者为什么写”逐项翻译，于是名词和从句混用。正确：When judging a news report, readers should consider its source, its publication date and the author's purpose.
focus: 并列项词性或结构不一致（形容词/名词/从句混用）

instruction: 四个句子都想表达“仅靠提高退休年龄，既无法填补养老金缺口，也无法减轻年轻劳动者的负担”。选择关联连词使用正确、两侧平行的一句。
options: Raising the retirement age alone will neither close the pension funding gap nor the burden on younger workers will be eased.
Raising the retirement age alone will neither close the pension funding gap nor ease the burden on younger workers.
Raising the retirement age alone will close neither the pension funding gap nor ease the burden on younger workers.
Raising the retirement age alone will neither close the pension funding gap nor easing the burden on younger workers.
option_explanations: 错误：neither 后是动词短语 close…，nor 后却是完整分句 the burden… will be eased，两侧不对称；而且 nor 引导分句时还必须倒装。
正确：neither 和 nor 后面都是动词原形短语（close… / ease…），共用 will，完全对称。
错误：neither 放在 close 之后，后接名词短语 the pension funding gap，而 nor 后接动词短语 ease…，两侧不对称。
错误：neither 后是动词原形 close，nor 后却是 -ing 形式 easing，形式不一致；will 后面也不能接 -ing。
hints: 分别找出 neither 和 nor 后面紧跟的成分。
neither…nor 两侧的成分必须属于同一类，而 neither 的位置决定了 nor 后面该接什么。
这里要否定的是两个动作，检查哪个句子的两侧都是同一形式的动作。
explanation: neither…nor 和 either…or 一样，两侧成分必须对称，neither 应紧贴在第一个被否定的成分前。本句否定的是两个动作 close the gap 和 ease the burden，所以 neither 放在 will 之后、close 之前。常见错误有三种：把 neither 放在动词之后，使两侧变成“名词短语 vs 动词短语”；在 nor 后另起一个完整分句；或把第二个动作改成 -ing。中国学生受“既不…也不…”结构位置灵活的影响，容易忽视英语关联连词的对称要求。正确：Raising the retirement age alone will neither close the pension funding gap nor ease the burden on younger workers.
focus: 关联连词位置不当导致两侧不对称

instruction: 句中有一处平行结构错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: In many families, grandparents help by cooking meals, cleaning the house and to look after the children.
accepted: In many families, grandparents help by cooking meals, cleaning the house and looking after the children.
In many families, grandparents help by cooking meals, cleaning the house, and looking after the children.
In many families, grandparents help by cooking meals, cleaning the house and taking care of the children.
In many families, grandparents help by cooking meals, cleaning the house, and taking care of the children.
In many families, grandparents help by cooking meals, by cleaning the house and by looking after the children.
In many families, grandparents help by cooking meals, by cleaning the house, and by looking after the children.
In many families, grandparents help to cook meals, clean the house and look after the children.
In many families, grandparents help to cook meals, clean the house, and look after the children.
In many families, grandparents help cook meals, clean the house and look after the children.
In many families, grandparents help cook meals, clean the house, and look after the children.
criteria: 介词 by 后面的三项必须都是 -ing 动名词短语：须把 to look after 改为 looking after（或 taking care of）；每项前都重复 by 也可以；是否使用牛津逗号均可。若整体改为 help (to) cook…, clean… and look after…，三项都用动词原形，也算正确。须保持原意；其他语法正确且平行的改法也接受。
hints: 找出介词 by 后面列举的三件事。
介词后面并列的每一项都必须使用同一种动词形式。
前两项是什么形式？第三项和它们一样吗？
explanation: 介词 by 后面要接动名词，并列的三项都必须是 -ing 形式：by cooking meals, cleaning the house and looking after the children。原句第三项用了不定式 to look after，与前两项不一致，而且介词 by 后面不能接 to do。中国学生写列举时常把最后一项换成 to do，因为汉语“做饭、打扫、照顾孩子”中动词没有形式变化。正确：In many families, grandparents help by cooking meals, cleaning the house and looking after the children.
focus: 列举中 to do / doing / 动词原形混用

instruction: 句中有一处平行结构错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Many commuters prefer trains to cars because trains are fast, comfortable and they are reliable.
accepted: Many commuters prefer trains to cars because trains are fast, comfortable and reliable.
Many commuters prefer trains to cars because trains are fast, comfortable, and reliable.
Many commuters prefer trains to cars because trains are fast, comfortable and also reliable.
Many commuters prefer trains to cars because trains are fast, comfortable, and also reliable.
Many commuters prefer trains to cars because trains are fast and comfortable, and they are reliable.
Many commuters prefer trains to cars because trains are fast and comfortable, and they are also reliable.
criteria: because 从句中 are 后面的三项必须都是形容词：须删去 they are，改为 fast, comfortable and reliable（可加牛津逗号或 also）；也可以先写 fast and comfortable，再用 “, and they are (also) reliable” 连接一个完整分句。须保持原意；其他语法正确且平行的改法也接受。
hints: 看 trains are 后面列举的三个特点。
列举中的三项要用同一种形式，不能前两项是形容词、最后一项变成句子。
最后一项比前两项多出了哪几个词？
explanation: and 连接的三项都是 are 后面的表语，应该都是形容词：trains are fast, comfortable and reliable。原句最后一项写成 they are reliable，变成了完整分句，破坏了平行。中国学生常这样写，因为汉语“火车快、舒适，而且它们很准时”可以在列举中自由加入小句。正确：Many commuters prefer trains to cars because trains are fast, comfortable and reliable.
focus: 并列短语中混入完整分句

instruction: 句中有一处平行结构错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Online shopping festivals encourage consumers to buy things they do not need, spend more than they planned and ignoring the environmental cost of fast delivery.
accepted: Online shopping festivals encourage consumers to buy things they do not need, spend more than they planned and ignore the environmental cost of fast delivery.
Online shopping festivals encourage consumers to buy things they do not need, spend more than they planned, and ignore the environmental cost of fast delivery.
Online shopping festivals encourage consumers to buy things they do not need, to spend more than they planned and to ignore the environmental cost of fast delivery.
Online shopping festivals encourage consumers to buy things they do not need, to spend more than they planned, and to ignore the environmental cost of fast delivery.
criteria: encourage consumers to 后面并列的三项必须形式一致：须把 ignoring 改为动词原形 ignore（共用前面的 to），或三项都写成 to buy…, to spend… and to ignore…。是否使用牛津逗号均可。须保持原意；其他语法正确且平行的改法也接受。
hints: 找出 encourage consumers to 后面列举的三种行为。
共用一个 to 的并列项都要用同一种动词形式。
比较第三项开头的动词和前两项开头的动词。
explanation: encourage sb to do 后面的三个并列动作共用一个 to，都应是动词原形：to buy…, spend… and ignore…。原句第三项写成 ignoring，与 buy、spend 不平行。这类错误在长句中特别常见：前面的项夹带了从句（they do not need / they planned），写到最后一项时学生已忘了开头的 to，加上汉语动词不变形，就随手用了 -ing。正确：Online shopping festivals encourage consumers to buy things they do not need, spend more than they planned and ignore the environmental cost of fast delivery.
focus: 列举中 to do / doing / 动词原形混用

instruction: 句中有一处平行结构错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Compared with short prison sentences, community service can make young offenders more responsible, more confidence and less likely to commit crimes again.
accepted: Compared with short prison sentences, community service can make young offenders more responsible, more confident and less likely to commit crimes again.
Compared with short prison sentences, community service can make young offenders more responsible, more confident, and less likely to commit crimes again.
Compared with short prison sentences, community service can make young offenders more responsible, more self-confident and less likely to commit crimes again.
Compared with short prison sentences, community service can make young offenders more responsible, more self-confident, and less likely to commit crimes again.
criteria: make young offenders 后面的三项都是宾语补足语，必须都是形容词（比较级）：须把名词 confidence 改为形容词 confident（或 self-confident）。是否使用牛津逗号均可。须保持原意；其他语法正确且平行的改法也接受。
hints: 找出 make young offenders 后面并列的三个变化。
三项都用来描述 young offenders 变成什么样，必须使用同一种词性。
检查第二项中的单词和 responsible、likely 是否属于同一词类。
explanation: make sb + 形容词 表示“使某人变得……”，三个并列的宾补 more responsible, more confident and less likely… 都必须是形容词。原句的 confidence 是名词，与 responsible、likely 词性不同，也不能说 make sb more confidence。中国学生常混淆 confident / confidence、patient / patience 这类形容词和名词，汉语“更有责任感、更自信”也看不出词性差别。正确：Compared with short prison sentences, community service can make young offenders more responsible, more confident and less likely to commit crimes again.
focus: 并列项词性或结构不一致（形容词/名词/从句混用）

instruction: 句中有一处比较结构的错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: In many countries, the salary of a professional footballer is far higher than a nurse.
accepted: In many countries, the salary of a professional footballer is far higher than that of a nurse.
In many countries, the salary of a professional footballer is far higher than the salary of a nurse.
In many countries, the salary of a professional footballer is far higher than a nurse's.
In many countries, the salary of a professional footballer is far higher than a nurse's salary.
In many countries, a professional footballer's salary is far higher than a nurse's.
In many countries, a professional footballer's salary is far higher than a nurse's salary.
In many countries, a professional footballer's salary is far higher than that of a nurse.
In many countries, a professional footballer's salary is far higher than the salary of a nurse.
In many countries, a professional footballer earns far more than a nurse.
In many countries, a professional footballer earns far more than a nurse does.
criteria: than 两侧比较的必须是同类事物（工资 vs 工资），不能拿“职业足球运动员的工资”和“护士”这个人比较：须把 than 后面改为 that of a nurse、the salary of a nurse 或 a nurse's (salary)；也可改写为 a professional footballer earns far more than a nurse (does)。须保持原意；其他语法正确的改法也接受。
hints: 找出 than 两边被比较的两样东西。
比较结构两侧必须是同一类事物，不能拿“某物”和“某人”比较。
想一想英语中用哪个代词可以代替前面的 the salary，避免重复，同时保留 of a nurse。
explanation: 比较时 than 两侧必须是同类事物。原句比较的是“职业足球运动员的工资”和“护士”，逻辑上不对等。应比较工资和工资：…far higher than that of a nurse（that 代替前面的单数名词 the salary；若是复数名词则用 those），也可以说 than a nurse's 或 than the salary of a nurse。中国学生受汉语“足球运动员的工资比护士高得多”的影响——汉语可以省略第二个“的工资”，英语却不行。正确：In many countries, the salary of a professional footballer is far higher than that of a nurse.
focus: 比较结构两侧形式或对象不对等

instruction: 句中有一处平行结构错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Medical research suggests that sitting for long periods can weaken the muscles, slow down the body's metabolism and it also raises the risk of heart disease in later life.
accepted: Medical research suggests that sitting for long periods can weaken the muscles, slow down the body's metabolism and raise the risk of heart disease in later life.
Medical research suggests that sitting for long periods can weaken the muscles, slow down the body's metabolism, and raise the risk of heart disease in later life.
Medical research suggests that sitting for long periods can weaken the muscles, slow down the body's metabolism and also raise the risk of heart disease in later life.
Medical research suggests that sitting for long periods can weaken the muscles, slow down the body's metabolism, and also raise the risk of heart disease in later life.
Medical research suggests that sitting for long periods can weaken the muscles, slow down the body's metabolism and increase the risk of heart disease in later life.
Medical research suggests that sitting for long periods can weaken the muscles, slow down the body's metabolism, and increase the risk of heart disease in later life.
Medical research suggests that sitting for long periods can weaken the muscles, slow down the body's metabolism and also increase the risk of heart disease in later life.
Medical research suggests that sitting for long periods can weaken the muscles, slow down the body's metabolism, and also increase the risk of heart disease in later life.
Medical research suggests that sitting for long periods can weaken the muscles and slow down the body's metabolism, and it also raises the risk of heart disease in later life.
Medical research suggests that sitting for long periods can weaken the muscles and slow down the body's metabolism; it also raises the risk of heart disease in later life.
Medical research suggests that sitting for long periods can weaken the muscles and slow down the body's metabolism. It also raises the risk of heart disease in later life.
criteria: can 后面并列的三项必须都是动词原形短语：须把 it also raises 改为 (also) raise 或 (also) increase，与 weaken、slow down 平行（牛津逗号可有可无）；或者先用 and 连接前两项，再用 “, and it also raises…”、分号或另起一句的方式接一个完整分句。须保持原意；其他语法正确且平行的改法也接受。
hints: 找出情态动词 can 后面列举的几个后果。
共用 can 的并列项都应该是动词原形短语，列举中不能突然出现一个带主语的分句。
注意最后一项开头的两个词，以及那个动词的词尾。
explanation: sitting for long periods can 后面列举了三个后果，三项都应是共用 can 的动词原形短语：can weaken…, slow down… and raise…。原句第三项写成 it also raises…，带了主语和第三人称单数动词，变成完整分句，与前两项不平行。中国学生在长句中常在最后一项“另起一句”，因为汉语“会削弱肌肉、减慢新陈代谢，它还会增加心脏病风险”中逗号可以连接短语和小句。正确：Medical research suggests that sitting for long periods can weaken the muscles, slow down the body's metabolism and raise the risk of heart disease in later life.
focus: 并列短语中混入完整分句

instruction: 句中关联连词的位置导致平行结构错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: At the age of eighteen, many talented young athletes either have to choose a professional sports career or a university degree.
accepted: At the age of eighteen, many talented young athletes have to choose either a professional sports career or a university degree.
At the age of eighteen, many talented young athletes have to choose between a professional sports career and a university degree.
criteria: either…or 后面的成分必须同类：被选择的是两个名词短语（a professional sports career / a university degree），须把 either 移到 choose 之后，写成 have to choose either … or …；改用 choose between … and … 也正确。须保持原意；其他语法正确且平行的改法也接受。
hints: 分别看 either 和 or 后面紧跟的是什么成分。
关联连词应紧挨在被选择的两个成分前面。
供运动员二选一的是两个名词短语，想一想 either 应该紧挨着哪一个。
explanation: 关联连词 either…or 必须紧贴在两个被选择的成分前面，并使两边成分同类。原句 either 后面是动词短语 have to choose…，or 后面却是名词短语 a university degree，两侧不对称。真正被选择的是两个名词短语，所以 either 应放在 choose 之后；也可以用 choose between A and B。中国学生受汉语“要么选择职业体育，要么读大学”的影响，常把 either 放在动词前面。正确：At the age of eighteen, many talented young athletes have to choose either a professional sports career or a university degree.
focus: 关联连词位置不当导致两侧不对称

instruction: 句中有一处因省略共同成分而造成的平行结构错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: The city's art museum has never and will never charge local residents an entrance fee because it believes that culture should be free for everyone.
accepted: The city's art museum has never charged and will never charge local residents an entrance fee because it believes that culture should be free for everyone.
The city's art museum has never charged, and will never charge, local residents an entrance fee because it believes that culture should be free for everyone.
The city's art museum has never charged local residents an entrance fee and never will, because it believes that culture should be free for everyone.
The city's art museum has never charged local residents an entrance fee and never will because it believes that culture should be free for everyone.
The city's art museum has never charged local residents an entrance fee, and it never will, because it believes that culture should be free for everyone.
The city's art museum has never charged local residents an entrance fee and will never do so because it believes that culture should be free for everyone.
criteria: has never 后面必须接过去分词 charged，will never 后面接动词原形 charge，两者不能共用一个 charge：须改为 has never charged and will never charge…（中间可加逗号），或改写为 has never charged … and never will / and it never will / and will never do so。须保持原意；其他语法正确的改法也接受。
hints: 看 has never 和 will never 后面分别需要什么动词形式。
两个助动词共用一个主要动词时，这个动词必须同时符合两边的语法要求，否则就要分别写出。
把句子拆开读：has never charge… 能成立吗？
explanation: 并列成分省略共同部分时，被省略的部分必须同时适用于每一项。原句 has never 和 will never 共用了 charge，但 has never 后面需要过去分词，只有 will never 后面能接原形 charge，所以 has never charge 语法残缺。应分别写出两个动词形式，或改成 …has never charged local residents an entrance fee and never will。中国学生受汉语“从来没有、也永远不会收费”的影响——汉语动词不变形，两个助动词自然可以共用一个动词。正确：The city's art museum has never charged and will never charge local residents an entrance fee because it believes that culture should be free for everyone.
focus: 省略共同成分导致搭配残缺

instruction: 两个句子之间是因果关系。选择合并正确的一项。
content: Fast food is cheap and quick. Many office workers eat it every day.
options: Because fast food is cheap and quick, so many office workers eat it every day.
Because fast food is cheap and quick, many office workers eat it every day.
Because of fast food is cheap and quick, many office workers eat it every day.
Although fast food is cheap and quick, many office workers eat it every day.
option_explanations: 错误：because 和 so 不能同时使用。这是汉语“因为……所以……”的迁移，英语中一个因果连接点只能用一个连词。
正确：because 引导原因状语从句，主句前不再加 so，语法和逻辑都正确。
错误：because of 是介词短语，后面只能接名词或动名词，不能接完整从句 fast food is cheap and quick；应改用连词 because，或写成 Because of the low cost and speed of fast food, …。
错误：语法没有问题，但 although 表示让步，与题目要求的因果关系不符。
hints: 先看每个选项在两个分句的连接处用了哪些词、用了几个。
英语表示因果时，because 和 so 都能单独连接两个分句，同一个连接点只需要其中一个；另外，有些表示原因的词组是介词，后面不能接完整句子。
先排除逻辑关系不对的选项，再排除“连接词多了一个”和“介词后面接了完整句子”的选项。
explanation: 表达因果关系可以用 Because A, B，也可以用 A, so B，两种写法只能选一种。汉语习惯说“因为……所以……”，直接迁移就会写出 because…so 的错误。because of 是介词短语，后面只能接名词（Because of the low cost and speed of fast food, …），不能接完整从句。正确句：Because fast food is cheap and quick, many office workers eat it every day.（也可写成 Fast food is cheap and quick, so many office workers eat it every day.）
focus: 因果/让步连接词叠用（because…so，although…but）

instruction: 选择把两个句子合并得语法正确、逻辑清楚的一项。
content: Electric cars produce no exhaust fumes on the road. The mining of metals for their batteries can seriously damage local ecosystems.
options: Even though electric cars produce no exhaust fumes on the road, but the mining of metals for their batteries can seriously damage local ecosystems.
Despite electric cars produce no exhaust fumes on the road, the mining of metals for their batteries can seriously damage local ecosystems.
Electric cars produce no exhaust fumes on the road, however, the mining of metals for their batteries can seriously damage local ecosystems.
Even though electric cars produce no exhaust fumes on the road, the mining of metals for their batteries can seriously damage local ecosystems.
option_explanations: 错误：even though 与 but 连用，属于“虽然……但是……”的迁移；同一个让步关系只能用一个连接词。
错误：despite 是介词，后面只能接名词或动名词，不能直接接完整从句；若要保留从句，应写成 Despite the fact that electric cars produce…，或改用 Even though。
错误：however 是连接副词，不是连词，不能只用逗号连接两个完整句子，应在 however 前改用分号。
正确：even though 引导让步状语从句，主句前不再加 but，逻辑与语法都正确。
hints: 两句之间是让步/转折关系，检查每个选项的连接处用了什么词、用了几个。
让步关系只需要一个连接词；同时注意每个连接词的词性：连词、介词和副词的用法各不相同。
能直接引导完整从句的只有连词；介词后面要接名词或动名词，副词不能单靠逗号连接两个句子。
explanation: 两句是让步关系：电动车行驶时没有尾气，但电池金属的开采会破坏生态。可以用 Even though / Although A, B，主句前不能再加 but，这是汉语“虽然……但是……”的迁移。despite 是介词，不能接从句；however 是连接副词，连接两个分句时前面要用分号或句号。正确句：Even though electric cars produce no exhaust fumes on the road, the mining of metals for their batteries can seriously damage local ecosystems.
focus: 因果/让步连接词叠用（because…so，although…but）

instruction: 把下面三个短句合并成一个句子：用 so 表示第1句和第2句之间的因果关系，用 although 或 even though 引出第3句的让步信息。保留所有信息。
content:
Train tickets are cheaper than plane tickets.
Many students travel home by train.
The journey takes much longer.
accepted: Train tickets are cheaper than plane tickets, so many students travel home by train even though the journey takes much longer.
Train tickets are cheaper than plane tickets, so many students travel home by train, although the journey takes much longer.
Train tickets are cheaper than plane tickets, so although the journey takes much longer, many students travel home by train.
criteria: 1）合并为一个句子；2）用 so 连接原因（火车票比机票便宜）和结果（很多学生坐火车回家），so 前用逗号；用了 so，原因前就不能再加 because / as / since（✗ Because train tickets are cheaper than plane tickets, so many students…）；3）用 although / even though 引出“路程时间长得多”，表达让步（路程更长，学生仍坐火车）；让步从句的主句前不能再加 but / yet（✗ …, so although the journey takes much longer, but many students…）；让步从句可放在句末、so 之后或句首；4）不得出现逗号粘连；5）保留全部信息：火车票比机票便宜、很多学生坐火车回家、路程时间长得多；6）语法正确。其他正确写法同样接受。
hints: 先判断：第1句和第2句，哪个是原因、哪个是结果？第3句和“学生坐火车回家”之间是什么关系？
so 本身就表示“所以”，although / even though 本身就包含“虽然……但是”的意思；每个逻辑连接点只用一个连接词。
先用 so 写出“票价便宜 → 学生坐火车”，再决定把让步从句放在句末，还是放在 so 后面。
explanation: 第1句是原因，第2句是结果，用 so 连接：Train tickets are cheaper than plane tickets, so many students travel home by train. 用了 so，原因前就不能再加 because，这是汉语“因为……所以……”的迁移。第3句与“坐火车回家”构成让步：路程长得多，学生仍然选择火车。用 although / even though 引导时，主句前不能再加 but，这是“虽然……但是……”的迁移。示例：Train tickets are cheaper than plane tickets, so many students travel home by train even though the journey takes much longer.
focus: 因果/让步连接词叠用（because…so，although…but）

instruction: 选择把两个句子合并得最正确的一项。
content: Tourists visited the old town. They took hundreds of photos of the ancient walls.
options: Visiting the old town, hundreds of photos of the ancient walls were taken by tourists.
Visited the old town, tourists took hundreds of photos of the ancient walls.
Visiting the old town, tourists took hundreds of photos of the ancient walls.
Tourists visited the old town, they took hundreds of photos of the ancient walls.
option_explanations: 错误：悬垂分词。主句主语变成了 hundreds of photos，句子意思成了“照片在参观古城”。
错误：游客“参观”是主动动作，分词应该用现在分词 visiting；过去分词 visited 表示被动。
正确：分词短语 Visiting the old town 的逻辑主语是主句主语 tourists，动作是主动的，用 -ing 形式。
错误：逗号粘连，两个完整句子只用逗号连接。
hints: 找出每个选项中“参观古城”这个动作是谁做的。
句首分词短语的逻辑主语必须是逗号后面的主语；主动关系用 -ing，被动关系用 -ed。
逐项问一问：逗号后面的主语能不能“参观古城”？分词的形式和这种主被动关系一致吗？
explanation: 两个主语相同的句子可以用分词短语合并：第一句变成分词短语，第二句保留为主句，而且主句主语必须是分词动作的执行者。游客是主动参观，所以用 Visiting，主句主语用 tourists：Visiting the old town, tourists took hundreds of photos of the ancient walls. 把主句改成被动（photos were taken）就会造成悬垂分词。汉语句子没有“分词主语必须一致”的限制，所以中国学生常出现这类错误。
focus: 悬垂分词与分词主被动

instruction: 选择合并得语法正确、逻辑清楚的一项。
content: Researchers analysed health data from 20,000 adults. They found that regular walking lowers the risk of heart disease.
options: Having analysed health data from 20,000 adults, researchers found that regular walking lowers the risk of heart disease.
Having analysed health data from 20,000 adults, it was found that regular walking lowers the risk of heart disease.
Having analysed health data from 20,000 adults, the conclusion was that regular walking lowers the risk of heart disease.
Analysed health data from 20,000 adults, researchers found that regular walking lowers the risk of heart disease.
option_explanations: 正确：Having analysed… 的逻辑主语就是主句主语 researchers；研究者先分析数据、再得出结论，完成式分词表示动作的先后，主动关系用 -ing。
错误：悬垂分词。主句主语是形式主语 it，它不能“分析数据”；这种写法在论文中常见，但属于典型的悬垂结构。
错误：悬垂分词。主句主语 the conclusion 不能“分析数据”。
错误：研究者“分析”是主动动作，应使用 having analysed 或 analysing；过去分词 analysed 表示被动，与后面的宾语 health data 冲突。
hints: 找出“分析数据”这个动作的执行者，看它是否出现在逗号后面的主语位置。
分词短语的逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致；形式主语 it 和抽象名词都不能执行“分析”这个动作。
逐个检查逗号后面的主语：它能不能 analyse data？再看分词的形式是否体现主动关系。
explanation: Having done 表示分词的动作发生在主句动作之前（先分析，后发现）。分词短语的逻辑主语必须是主句主语，所以主句要以 researchers 开头：Having analysed health data from 20,000 adults, researchers found that regular walking lowers the risk of heart disease. 为了显得“客观”而改用 it was found 或 the conclusion was，会让分词失去执行者，形成悬垂分词。汉语句子常省略主语或以话题开头，这是此类错误的迁移来源。
focus: 悬垂分词与分词主被动

instruction: 把下面三个短句合并成一个句子：用过去分词短语开头表达第1句的信息，并把第3句与 visitors 连接起来，保留所有信息。
content:
The city museum was renovated last year.
It now attracts twice as many visitors as before.
Most of these visitors are parents with young children.
accepted: Renovated last year, the city museum now attracts twice as many visitors as before, most of whom are parents with young children.
Renovated last year, the city museum now attracts twice as many visitors as before, most of them parents with young children.
Renovated last year, the city museum now attracts twice as many visitors as before, and most of them are parents with young children.
criteria: 1）合并为一个句子；2）必须以过去分词短语开头（如 Renovated last year,；Having been renovated last year, 也正确，可以接受，只是不如前者简洁）；逗号后的主语必须是 the city museum 或 the museum，不能是 visitors、twice as many visitors 等，否则构成悬垂分词；不能写成 Renovating last year（主被动错误）；3）第3句须与 visitors 相连，可用 most of whom are…、most of them + 名词短语（不带动词），或 and most of them are…；不能写成“, most of them are…”（逗号粘连），也不能写成 most of which（指人不用 which）；4）保留全部信息：去年翻修、游客数量是以前的两倍、大多数游客是带小孩的父母；5）语法正确。其他正确写法同样接受。
hints: 第1句的 was renovated 是被动语态，想一想变成分词短语时该用哪种分词；第3句的 these visitors 指第2句里的哪个词？
句首分词短语的逻辑主语必须是逗号后面的主语，被动含义用过去分词；第3句接在 visitors 后面时，不能只用逗号接一个完整句子。
先写好主干“博物馆现在吸引两倍的游客”，把翻修信息放在它前面，再用“most of + 关系代词”这样的结构把第3句挂在 visitors 后面（注意指人用哪个关系代词）。
explanation: 第1句是被动（博物馆被翻修），变成分词短语时用过去分词：Renovated last year,，而且逗号后的主语必须是被翻修的 the city museum，否则就是悬垂分词（如 Renovated last year, twice as many visitors…）。第3句可以用“most of whom + 谓语”接在 visitors 后面。中国学生受汉语“……，其中大多数是……”的影响，常写成“, most of them are…”，这是逗号粘连：要么改成 most of whom are，要么加 and，要么去掉 are，变成 most of them parents with young children。示例：Renovated last year, the city museum now attracts twice as many visitors as before, most of whom are parents with young children.
focus: 悬垂分词与分词主被动

instruction: 选择把两个短句合并得最正确的一项。
content: Our school has a new library. Students can study quietly there.
options: Our school has a new library where students can study quietly.
Our school has a new library which students can study quietly.
Our school has a new library where students can study quietly there.
Our school has a new library, students can study quietly there.
option_explanations: 正确：where 相当于 in which，在从句中作地点状语，代替了第二句的 there。
错误：which 是关系代词，必须在从句中作主语或宾语；study quietly 不需要宾语，从句里没有 which 的位置，应改为 where 或 in which。
错误：where 已经代替了 there，从句末尾再加 there 就重复了。
错误：逗号粘连，两个完整句子只用逗号连接。
hints: 第二句的 there 指的是第一句里的哪个名词？
关系副词本身就在从句中充当地点状语；关系代词则必须在从句中作主语或宾语。
在每个选项中数一数“表示地点”的词出现了几次，再看从句是缺成分还是多成分。
explanation: 第二句的 there 指 the library，合并时用关系副词 where（= in which）代替 there：Our school has a new library where students can study quietly. where 已经包含“在那里”的意思，从句中不能再写 there；which 只能在从句中作主语或宾语，而 study quietly 后面不需要宾语，所以不能用 which。学生合并时往往只是在原句前加一个关系词，却忘了删掉被替代的 there；汉语“学生可以安静学习的图书馆”没有关系词，也让学生难以判断该用 where 还是 which。
focus: 定语从句关系词误用（重复代词、where/which、whose）

instruction: 选择把两个句子合并得最正确的一项。
content: Some parents work night shifts. Their children often spend their evenings alone.
options: Children who their parents work night shifts often spend their evenings alone.
Children which parents work night shifts often spend their evenings alone.
Children whose parents work night shifts often spend their evenings alone.
Children whose their parents work night shifts often spend their evenings alone.
option_explanations: 错误：who 后面接了完整句子 their parents work night shifts，who 在从句中没有成分可充当；表示“……的父母”需要用表示所属的关系词。
错误：which 不能指人，也不能表示所属关系。
正确：whose 表示所属（这些孩子的父母），后面直接接名词 parents，从句 whose parents work night shifts 修饰 children。
错误：whose 本身就相当于 their，后面再加 their 就重复了。
hints: 两句话的关系是“孩子”和“孩子的父母”，找出能表示这种所属关系的关系词。
表示所属的关系词本身就相当于 their 这样的物主代词，后面直接接名词。
先排除不能指人的关系词，再排除关系词后面又出现 their 或接了完整句子的选项。
explanation: 合并后要说的是“父母上夜班的孩子”，即“孩子的父母”，所以用表示所属的关系代词 whose：Children whose parents work night shifts often spend their evenings alone. whose 相当于 their，所以后面不能再加 their；who 后面也不能直接接一个完整的句子。汉语“父母上夜班的孩子”中的“的”结构没有对应的关系词，学生常写成 who their parents…。
focus: 定语从句关系词误用（重复代词、where/which、whose）

instruction: 把下面三个短句合并成一个句子，至少使用一个定语从句，保留所有信息。
content:
Many workers live in suburbs.
Public transport is poor in these suburbs.
These workers have to drive to work every day.
accepted: Many workers who live in suburbs where public transport is poor have to drive to work every day.
Many workers live in suburbs where public transport is poor, so they have to drive to work every day.
Many workers live in suburbs in which public transport is poor, so they have to drive to work every day.
criteria: 1）合并为一个句子；2）至少使用一个定语从句：用 where / in which 修饰 suburbs，或用 who / that 修饰 workers；3）where 从句中不得再出现 there 或 in these suburbs，who 从句中不得再出现 they；不能写成 suburbs which public transport is poor（which 在从句中没有成分可充当）；4）第3句可作主句谓语，或用 so / and 等连接，不得出现逗号粘连（如“…, they have to drive…”），不得 because…so 连用；5）保留全部信息：工人住在郊区、郊区公共交通差、他们每天必须开车上班；6）语法正确。其他正确写法同样接受。
hints: 第2句的 these suburbs 和第3句的 These workers 分别指第1句中的哪个名词？
修饰地点名词、并在从句中作地点状语时用关系副词；修饰人时用 who / that。关系词已经代替了原句中的名词，不能再重复。
可以以 Many workers 为主语、have to drive 为谓语，把“住在哪里”“那里交通怎么样”两层信息依次挂在相应的名词后面。
explanation: 三句话共享两个名词：suburbs 和 workers。第2句修饰 suburbs，在从句里表示地点，用 where（= in which）：suburbs where public transport is poor；第1句可以变成修饰 workers 的 who 从句，第3句作主句：Many workers who live in suburbs where public transport is poor have to drive to work every day. where 已经代替了 in these suburbs，从句末尾不能再加 there；public transport is poor 已经是完整的句子，which 在其中没有位置，所以不能用 which。汉语把定语放在名词前（“公共交通差的郊区”），没有关系词，学生合并时常保留原句中的 there 或误用 which。
focus: 定语从句关系词误用（重复代词、where/which、whose）

instruction: 用 however 合并两个句子。选择标点和连接都正确的一项。
content: Plastic bags are convenient. They pollute rivers and oceans.
options: Plastic bags are convenient, however, they pollute rivers and oceans.
Plastic bags are convenient, but however, they pollute rivers and oceans.
Plastic bags are convenient, however they pollute rivers and oceans.
Plastic bags are convenient; however, they pollute rivers and oceans.
option_explanations: 错误：however 是副词，不是连词；前后只有逗号，两个完整句子之间仍然是逗号粘连。
错误：but 和 however 都表示转折，叠用属于“但是然而”式的重复，只能保留一个。
错误：去掉 however 后面的逗号并不能解决问题，两个完整句子之间仍然只有逗号。
正确：分号连接两个完整句子，however 后面加逗号，标点规范。
hints: 注意 however 的词性：它是连词还是副词？
副词不能把两个完整句子连成一句；两个独立分句之间需要连词，或者一个比逗号更“强”的标点。
看每个选项中 however 前面的标点能否分隔两个完整句子，同时排除两个转折词叠用的选项。
explanation: however 是连接副词，意思相当于“然而”，但在语法上不能像 but 那样连接两个句子。用 however 合并两个完整句子时，前面要用分号（或用句号分成两句），后面加逗号：Plastic bags are convenient; however, they pollute rivers and oceans. 中国学生常把 however 当作 but 使用，只在前面加逗号，造成逗号粘连；或写成 but however，重复表达转折。也可以改用连词：Plastic bags are convenient, but they pollute rivers and oceans.
focus: 连接副词当连词用（however/therefore 逗号粘连）

instruction: 两句之间是因果关系。选择合并成一个句子后语法正确的一项。
content: Several neighbourhoods have installed brighter street lighting. Reported burglaries in these areas have fallen considerably.
options: Several neighbourhoods have installed brighter street lighting, therefore reported burglaries in these areas have fallen considerably.
Several neighbourhoods have installed brighter street lighting, and reported burglaries in these areas have consequently fallen considerably.
Several neighbourhoods have installed brighter street lighting, as a result, reported burglaries in these areas have fallen considerably.
Several neighbourhoods have installed brighter street lighting, consequently, reported burglaries in these areas have fallen considerably.
option_explanations: 错误：therefore 是连接副词，不能单靠逗号连接两个完整句子，属于逗号粘连；应在它前面改用分号，或改用连词 so。
正确：连词 and 连接两个分句，副词 consequently 放在第二个分句中表示结果，结构完整。
错误：as a result 是副词性短语，不是连词，用逗号直接连接两个完整句子仍是逗号粘连。
错误：consequently 是连接副词，前后加逗号也不能代替连词，仍然是逗号粘连。
hints: 找出每个选项中真正能连接两个分句的词：它是连词，还是副词 / 副词短语？
therefore、as a result、consequently 只表示逻辑关系，不能单独把两个完整句子连起来；两个分句之间需要连词或分号。
把每个选项在第一个逗号处断开，问一问：把这两个完整句子连起来的，是一个真正的连词，还是只是一个表示“因此”的副词（短语）？
explanation: therefore、consequently、as a result 等是连接副词（短语），意思相当于“因此”，但不能像 and、so、but 那样连接两个句子。把它们放在两个完整句子之间、只用逗号隔开，就是逗号粘连。正确做法有三种：①分号 + 连接副词 + 逗号：…lighting; consequently, reported burglaries…；②连词 + 副词：…lighting, and reported burglaries in these areas have consequently fallen considerably；③直接用连词 so。汉语中“因此”可以直接跟在逗号后面，这是此类错误的迁移来源。
focus: 连接副词当连词用（however/therefore 逗号粘连）

instruction: 用 however 把下面两个句子合并成一个句子，注意标点。
content:
Professional footballers often earn extremely high salaries.
Most of them have to retire before the age of thirty-five.
accepted: Professional footballers often earn extremely high salaries; however, most of them have to retire before the age of thirty-five.
Professional footballers often earn extremely high salaries; most of them, however, have to retire before the age of thirty-five.
Professional footballers often earn extremely high salaries; however, the majority of them have to retire before the age of thirty-five.
criteria: 1）合并为一个句子；2）必须使用 however 表达转折；3）however 位于两个分句之间时，前面必须用分号（不能用逗号），后面加逗号；however 也可插在第二个分句中间并用两个逗号隔开（…; most of them, however, have to…），但两个分句之间仍须用分号；4）不得与 but 叠用（如 but however），不得出现逗号粘连；5）保留两条信息，语法正确。其他正确写法同样接受。
hints: 先确定 however 的词性：它能不能像 but 一样连接两个完整句子？
副词连接两个独立分句时，两个分句之间要用一个比逗号更“强”的标点。
在两个分句之间放上这个标点，再处理好 however 后面的标点。
explanation: however 是连接副词，不是连词。用它把两个完整句子合成一句时，格式是：分句1; however, 分句2。也可以把 however 插在第二个分句中间：…; most of them, however, have to retire… 如果只用逗号（…salaries, however, most of them…），就是逗号粘连，这是中国学生把 however 等同于“但是”而产生的典型错误。示例：Professional footballers often earn extremely high salaries; however, most of them have to retire before the age of thirty-five.
focus: 连接副词当连词用（however/therefore 逗号粘连）

instruction: 第二句的 This 指第一句整件事。选择合并正确的一项。
content: Many teenagers check their phones late at night. This affects the quality of their sleep.
options: Many teenagers check their phones late at night, this affects the quality of their sleep.
Many teenagers check their phones late at night, which affects the quality of their sleep.
Many teenagers check their phones late at night, which it affects the quality of their sleep.
Many teenagers check their phones late at night, that affects the quality of their sleep.
option_explanations: 错误：this 是代词，不是连接词，“, this affects…”仍是两个完整句子用逗号相连，构成逗号粘连。
正确：非限制性定语从句中的 which 可以指代前面整个分句（深夜看手机这件事），并在从句中作主语，谓语用单数 affects。
错误：which 已经是从句的主语，后面再加 it 就出现了两个主语。
错误：that 不能放在逗号后引导非限制性定语从句，也不能这样指代整个分句。
hints: This 不是连接词，而它前面只有一个逗号，想想这会造成什么问题。
能指代前面整个分句、同时又能起连接作用的，是逗号后面的某个关系代词。
排除逗号后直接用代词的选项、关系词后又出现主语的选项，以及不能用在逗号后的关系词。
explanation: 当第二句的 This / It 指前面整件事时，可以用“, which + 谓语”把它变成非限制性定语从句：Many teenagers check their phones late at night, which affects the quality of their sleep. which 指代整个分句，谓语用单数。this 只是代词，没有连接作用，“, this…”是逗号粘连，这是中国学生作文中最常见的粘连形式之一，因为汉语“……，这影响了……”用逗号完全正常。that 不能用在逗号后引导非限制性定语从句。也可以写成 …late at night, and this affects the quality of their sleep.
focus: “, this …”粘连与 which 指代整个分句

instruction: 把下面三个短句合并成一个句子，用非限制性定语从句 which 指代第1句的整件事，保留所有信息。
content:
Many supermarkets now offer self-service checkouts.
This shortens queues at busy times.
It also reduces the number of jobs for cashiers.
accepted: Many supermarkets now offer self-service checkouts, which shortens queues at busy times but also reduces the number of jobs for cashiers.
Many supermarkets now offer self-service checkouts, which shortens queues at busy times and also reduces the number of jobs for cashiers.
Many supermarkets now offer self-service checkouts, which shortens queues at busy times while also reducing the number of jobs for cashiers.
criteria: 1）合并为一个句子；2）必须用“, which + 谓语”连接第1句，which 前要有逗号；which 指代整件事时谓语用单数（shortens / reduces）；若写成复数 shorten / reduce（理解为指代 checkouts），意思仍通，也可接受，但两个谓语须保持一致；3）第2、3句的两个结果应放在同一个 which 从句中，用 and / but / while also 等连接；不得出现 which…it、“, this…”或“, it also…”等逗号粘连；4）保留全部信息：超市提供自助结账、高峰期排队缩短、收银员岗位减少；5）语法正确。其他正确写法同样接受。
hints: 第2句的 This 和第3句的 It 指的是什么？是 checkouts 这个词，还是“超市提供自助结账”这整件事？
逗号后的某个关系代词可以指代前面整个分句；它指代整件事时，从句谓语用单数。
把两个结果都放进同一个从句，用一个连词连接两个谓语，不要在第二个结果前再写 it。
explanation: 第2、3句的 This / It 都指第1句整件事（超市提供自助结账），可以用非限制性 which 指代整个分句，并让一个 which 带两个并列谓语：Many supermarkets now offer self-service checkouts, which shortens queues at busy times but also reduces the number of jobs for cashiers. 中国学生受汉语“……，这缩短了……，它也减少了……”的影响，常写成“…checkouts, this shortens queues…”或“…, it also reduces…”，都属于逗号粘连；which 后再加 it 则是重复主语。
focus: “, this …”粘连与 which 指代整个分句

instruction: 选择把两个句子合并得最正确的一项。
content: Many companies now allow employees to work four days a week. This arrangement was almost unthinkable twenty years ago.
options: Many companies now allow employees to work four days a week, this arrangement was almost unthinkable twenty years ago.
Many companies now allow employees to work four days a week, an arrangement was almost unthinkable twenty years ago.
Many companies now allow employees to work four days a week, an arrangement that it was almost unthinkable twenty years ago.
Many companies now allow employees to work four days a week, an arrangement that was almost unthinkable twenty years ago.
option_explanations: 错误：this arrangement was… 是一个完整句子，前面只有逗号，构成逗号粘连。
错误：an arrangement was almost unthinkable… 仍是有主语、有谓语的完整句子，用逗号连接同样是粘连；名词短语后面需要用 that / which 引出从句。
错误：that 已经在从句中作主语，后面再加 it 造成主语重复。
正确：an arrangement 是概括前面整个分句的同位语，后面接 that 定语从句说明它，全句只有一个主句，结构正确。
hints: 看逗号后面的部分：它是一个完整的句子，还是一个名词短语加修饰成分？
可以在逗号后用一个名词短语“总结”前面整件事，再用定语从句补充说明这个名词；这个名词短语本身不能带谓语。
逐项检查逗号后面的部分：有没有出现独立的谓语？关系代词后面有没有多余的主语？
explanation: 当第二句用 This arrangement / This trend 等指代前面整件事时，可以把它变成“概括性同位语”：在逗号后放一个总结性的名词短语，再用 that / which 从句修饰它：Many companies now allow employees to work four days a week, an arrangement that was almost unthinkable twenty years ago. 这样全句只有一个主句。汉语“……，这种安排在二十年前几乎无法想象”用逗号即可接续，学生容易直接译成“, this arrangement was…”，造成逗号粘连；去掉 this 但保留 was 仍然是完整句子。概括性同位语比 which 指代整句更清楚，是高分作文常用的合并手段。
focus: 同位语与概括性同位语

instruction: 把两个句子合并成一个句子：不要用“, which…”，而是在逗号后用一个概括第1句整件事的名词短语，再接定语从句（概括性同位语）。保留所有信息。
content:
Last year, the city closed its historic centre to private cars.
This decision initially angered many local shop owners.
accepted: Last year, the city closed its historic centre to private cars, a decision that initially angered many local shop owners.
Last year, the city closed its historic centre to private cars, a move that initially angered many local shop owners.
Last year, the city closed its historic centre to private cars, a measure which initially angered many local shop owners.
criteria: 1）合并为一个句子；2）必须使用概括性同位语：第1句后加逗号，接一个概括整件事的名词短语（a decision / a move / a measure / a policy 等，可加形容词，如 a controversial decision），再用 that / which 引导的定语从句说明它；3）不得写成“, this decision initially angered…”或“, a decision initially angered…”（名词短语后直接跟谓语，仍是逗号粘连），也不得写成 a decision that it initially angered…（重复主语）；4）不能只用“, which initially angered…”代替（题目要求用概括性同位语）；5）保留全部信息：去年、城市禁止私家车进入历史中心、这一决定起初激怒了许多本地店主（initially / at first 均可）；6）语法正确。其他正确写法同样接受。
hints: 第2句的 This decision 指的是第1句里的某个名词，还是第1句说的整件事？
可以在第1句后加逗号，用一个名词短语“总结”前面整件事；但如果这个名词短语后面直接跟谓语动词，它就又变成了一个完整的句子。
在概括性名词和 initially angered 之间补上一个能在从句中作主语的关系代词，并检查它后面没有多余的主语。
explanation: 第2句的 This decision 指第1句整件事（城市禁止私家车进入历史中心）。概括性同位语的做法是：在第1句后加逗号，放一个总结性的名词短语，再用 that / which 从句补充说明：Last year, the city closed its historic centre to private cars, a decision that initially angered many local shop owners. 全句只有一个主句，名词短语 a decision 本身不带谓语。常见错误有三种：直接写“, this decision initially angered…”（逗号粘连）；去掉 this，写成“, a decision initially angered…”（仍是完整句子）；在 that 后面再加 it。也可以写成 …, which initially angered…，但用 a decision 这样的概括性名词，读者能立刻明白指的是整件事，表达更精确，是高分作文常用的手段。
focus: 同位语与概括性同位语

instruction: 选择最简洁且意思不变的版本。
content: From my point of view, I think parents should limit their children's screen time.
options: As far as I am concerned, I think parents should limit their children's screen time.
I think parents should limit their children's screen time.
From my point of view, I personally think parents should limit their children's screen time.
I think parents should limit their screen time.
option_explanations: 冗余：As far as I am concerned 和 I think 都表示“我认为”。这个选项只是换了一个观点标记，仍然叠用两个。
正确：只保留一个观点标记 I think，“限制孩子的屏幕时间”这一信息完整。
更冗余：From my point of view、personally、I think 三处都在表达同一个意思。
错误：删掉了 children's，句子变成“父母应限制自己的屏幕时间”，意思改变。
hints: 先找出原句中表示“在我看来”的部分，一共有几处？
From my point of view、As far as I am concerned、personally、I think 作用相同，一句话里留一个就够了。
删完多余的观点标记后，再检查“限制谁的屏幕时间”是否仍然清楚。
explanation: 规则：一个观点句只需要一个观点标记。From my point of view、As far as I am concerned、personally、I think 都表示“我认为”，叠在一起只会重复。中文里“在我看来，我觉得……”“我个人认为……”很自然，直译成英语就成了冗余。但简洁不能删掉必要信息：children's 说明限制的是孩子的屏幕时间，不能省。正确句：I think parents should limit their children's screen time.
focus: 观点标记叠加与空洞套话开头

instruction: 选择最简洁且意思不变的版本。
content: Flats in city centres are small in size and expensive in price.
options: Flats in city centres are small in size and expensive.
Flats in city centres are expensive.
