hints: 比较四个句子：哪些词表示说话人对这件事有多确定？
学术写作表达可能性时，首选放在谓语里的情态动词，而不是句首口语副词或“我认为”。
找出既没有确定的 will 预测、又没有口语化表达的句子。
explanation: 中国学生常把“也许”“我觉得”直译为句首的 Maybe / I think。学术写作更规范的做法是把情态动词放进谓语：Free public transport may encourage more people to leave their cars at home. 注意 maybe 是副词（偏口语），may 是情态动词（正式）；I think 只表明主观看法，并不能让论断更严谨；surely 和 will 则把尚未实施的政策效果说成了必然。
focus: 口语化或主观化的限定表达

instruction: 选出语法正确、语气恰当的一句。
content: Topic: Technology and older people
options: Older people are tend to be less confident about using online banking.
Older people tend to being less confident about using online banking.
Older people tend to be less confident about using online banking.
option_explanations: tend 是实义动词，前面不能再加 be 动词；are tend to 是把“倾向于”误当成形容词结构（类似 be likely to）造成的典型错误。
tend to 中的 to 是不定式符号，后面要接动词原形，不能接 -ing 形式。
正确。tend to + 动词原形（tend to be）表示“往往、倾向于”，语法正确，又承认存在例外。
hints: 三个句子只在 tend 附近不同，仔细检查它前后的词形。
tend 是像 want、like 一样的普通动词；想一想普通动词前能不能再加 are，以及不定式 to 后面应该接什么形式。
类比一下：我们说 They want to go，而不说 They are want to go 或 They want to going。
explanation: tend to 是最常用的限定表达之一，结构是“主语 + tend(s) to + 动词原形”：Older people tend to be less confident about using online banking. 中国学生常见两种错误：① are tend to（受 be likely to 或中文“是……的”影响，把 tend 当形容词）；② tend to being（误把 to 当介词）。如果想用 be 结构，可以改用 Older people are likely to be less confident about using online banking.
focus: 限定表达的语法形式错误

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空，使句子语法正确、语气正式。
content: The decline in reading for pleasure among teenagers ______ partly explained by the rise of short-video apps, although other factors are also involved.
options: maybe
is maybe
may
may be
option_explanations: maybe 是副词（“也许”），不是动词；填入后句子缺少谓语，语法错误。这是 maybe 与 may be 混淆的典型错误。
is maybe 语法上勉强成立，但把 maybe 插在句中非常口语化，不符合学术语体；正式写作应写 may be 或 is possibly。
may 后面直接接过去分词 explained，缺少 be，被动语态不完整，语法错误。
正确。may be explained 是“情态动词 + be + 过去分词”的被动结构，表示“可能（部分）可以由……解释”，语法正确且语气正式。
hints: 先找出句子的主语，再判断空格处是否需要提供谓语动词。
explained 是过去分词，说明这里是被动语态；另外注意 maybe（一个词）和 may be（两个词）的词性不同。
“情态动词 + 被动语态”需要几个词才完整？检查哪个选项能让句子既完整又正式。
explanation: maybe（副词，“也许”，偏口语）和 may be（情态动词 may + be）是中国学生最容易混淆的一对，因为读音相同、中文都译作“可能”。本句主语是 The decline ...，空格必须提供谓语；explained 是过去分词，需要“may be + 过去分词”的被动结构：The decline in reading for pleasure among teenagers may be partly explained by the rise of short-video apps, although other factors are also involved. 句中 may 和 partly 两个限定手段配合，既承认短视频的影响，又不把它说成唯一原因。
focus: 限定表达的语法形式错误

instruction: 阅读下面的研究发现，选出与证据强度最相符的结论句。
content: Finding: A survey of 500 secondary school pupils found that those who played team sports had slightly higher exam scores, on average, than those who did not.
options: This suggests that playing team sports may be linked to better exam results.
This proves that playing team sports leads to better exam results.
This shows that playing team sports always leads to better exam results.
This means that playing team sports will lead to better exam results.
option_explanations: 正确。问卷调查只能说明二者“相关”，suggests 和 may be linked to 都准确反映了证据强度，没有断言因果。
proves 和 leads to 把相关关系说成了已被证明的因果关系；成绩较好也可能与家庭条件、时间管理等其他因素有关。
shows 语气偏强，always 更是绝对化表达，而调查结果只是“平均略高”。
This means 把调查结果直接等同于结论，will lead to 又把可能的联系说成了必然结果。
hints: 注意证据的类型（一次问卷调查）和结果的程度（平均“略高”）。
问卷调查只能说明两件事同时出现，不能证明一件事导致另一件事；报告动词和结论中的动词都要相应减弱。
找出既没有断言因果、也没有绝对化词语的选项。
explanation: 报告动词有强弱之分：prove / demonstrate > show > suggest / indicate。问卷调查只能揭示相关性（correlation），不能证明因果（causation），因此结论应写：This suggests that playing team sports may be linked to better exam results. 中国学生常把“说明”“证明”统一译为 prove / show，把“和……有关”写成 lead to，导致结论超出证据。表示相关可用 be linked to / be associated with。
focus: 报告动词与因果断言超出证据

instruction: 选择最合适的表达填空，使这个对未来的预测语气严谨。
content: Within the next twenty years, artificial intelligence ______ replace most human translators.
options: will definitely
is likely to
must
is bound to
option_explanations: will definitely 表示“肯定会”，对二十年后的事作出百分之百的预测，没有证据能支持。
正确。be likely to 表示“很可能”，既表达了作者的判断，又承认未来存在不确定性。
must 表示“必须”（义务）或对现状的肯定推断，不用来表示对未来的“一定会”；中国学生常把“一定会”直译成 must。
be bound to 意为“注定、必然会”，与 will definitely 一样过于绝对。
hints: 这是一个关于未来的预测，想一想：二十年后的事能百分之百确定吗？
对尚未发生的事，学术写作一般用表示“较大可能性”的表达，而不是表示“必然”或“义务”的表达。
排除三个分别表示“肯定”“必须”“注定”的选项。
explanation: 预测未来时，will definitely / be bound to / be sure to 都表示“必然”，很容易被反驳；更稳妥的表达有 be likely to, will probably, could, may。正确句子：Within the next twenty years, artificial intelligence is likely to replace most human translators. 中国学生常把“一定会”译成 must，但 must 表示义务（Students must wear uniforms）或对现状的推断（He must be tired），不表示对未来的预测。
focus: 确定性情态词与强化词使用过度

instruction: 阅读下面的段落。哪一句使用了不必要的限定语气，把有可靠来源的事实说得含糊不清？
content: (1) According to the city council's official figures, the number of registered electric cars may possibly have doubled between 2020 and 2023. (2) This growth is likely to be partly due to government subsidies for buyers. (3) However, the shortage of public charging points may slow further growth. (4) Some drivers also appear to be worried about battery performance in cold weather.
options: Sentence (1)
Sentence (2)
Sentence (3)
Sentence (4)
option_explanations: 正确。官方统计数据是可以核实的事实，引用来源后应直接陈述：... the number of registered electric cars doubled between 2020 and 2023. 加上 may possibly（两个同义限定词）反而让读者怀疑数据是否可靠。
增长的原因是作者的解释，可能还有油价、环保意识等其他因素，用 is likely to be partly due to 限定是恰当的。
充电桩不足是否会抑制增长是对未来的推测，用 may 恰当。
司机的担忧因人而异，用 Some drivers 和 appear to 限定是合理的。
hints: 区分每一句是“有来源的事实”、“作者的解释”还是“对未来的推测”。
限定语气应与证据强度相符：有可靠来源的数据可以直接陈述，解释和推测才需要限定。
看看哪一句已经向读者交代了信息来源，再判断这一句是否还需要表示“可能”的词。
explanation: 限定语气不是越多越安全。官方数据、已发表的统计结果等可核实的事实应直接陈述；需要限定的是作者自己的解释（原因）和推测（未来影响）。句(1) 引用了 official figures，却写 may possibly have doubled，既是不必要的限定，又叠加了两个同义限定词。应改为：According to the city council's official figures, the number of registered electric cars doubled between 2020 and 2023. 中国学生学了 hedging 后常常“处处加 may”，连事实都说得含糊，反而削弱可信度。
focus: 限定过度或对事实不必要的限定

instruction: 下面这句话过度概括。选出修改得最好的一项。
content: Nowadays, nobody reads printed newspapers any more because everyone gets their news from social media.
options: Nowadays, fewer people read printed newspapers, partly because many now get their news from social media.
Nowadays, nobody reads printed newspapers any more, perhaps because everyone gets their news from social media.
Nowadays, people may never read printed newspapers, because all of them get their news from social media.
Nowadays, it seems that nobody reads printed newspapers, since everyone may get their news from social media.
option_explanations: 正确。fewer people 把“没人读”改成“读的人变少”，many 替换了 everyone，partly 承认社交媒体只是原因之一。限定正好加在原句两个绝对化词上。
只在原因前加了 perhaps，nobody 和 everyone 原封不动，仍然一个反例就能推翻。
may never 语义矛盾、意思不清；all of them 仍然是过度概括。
it seems that 只限定了“说话人的判断”，nobody / everyone 仍在；在原因从句里加 may 也没有解决问题。
hints: 先圈出原句中让论断变得绝对的两个词。
限定要加在“过度概括”的地方；只在句子其他位置加 perhaps / may / it seems 并不能解决问题。
检查每个选项：原句的两个绝对化词是否都被替换掉了？
explanation: 过度概括的根源往往是 nobody / everyone / all / never 这类量词和频率词，修改时要直接替换它们（nobody → fewer people；everyone → many），并可用 partly 表示原因不唯一：Nowadays, fewer people read printed newspapers, partly because many now get their news from social media. 中国学生常保留“没有人”“人人都”的说法，只在别处加 perhaps 或 it seems，这种“限定错位”无法让论断变得严谨。
focus: 绝对化量词与频率词导致过度概括

instruction: 根据给出的研究背景，选出修改学生主题句的最佳方案。
content:
Background: Research has linked heavy social media use to anxiety in teenagers, but exam pressure, family problems and lack of sleep have also been found to play a role.
Student's topic sentence: Social media is the main cause of anxiety among teenagers.
options: Social media may be the single most important cause of anxiety among teenagers.
Social media appears to be one of several factors contributing to anxiety among teenagers.
Social media is undoubtedly one of the factors that cause anxiety in all teenagers.
It might perhaps be possible that social media could cause anxiety in some teenagers.
option_explanations: 只给原论断加了 may，却保留了“最主要原因”的核心说法；背景只说明社交媒体是相关因素之一，并没有证据表明它最重要。这是“加了限定词，但没有修正过度结论”的典型错误。
正确。one of several factors 与背景中“多种因素共同作用”一致，contributing to 表示“促成”而非“唯一导致”，appears to 适度降低确定性。
undoubtedly 是强化词，all teenagers 是过度概括；研究只发现了“关联”，既不能说“毫无疑问”，也不能推广到所有青少年。
It might perhaps be possible ... could 叠加了四个限定，观点几乎消失，读者看不出社交媒体的作用有多大。
hints: 对比背景和主题句：研究提到了几个因素？主题句又是怎么说的？
合格的修改既要调整“确定性”，也要调整“内容”：如果证据显示有多种原因，只加 may 是不够的。
逐一检查：每个选项对社交媒体作用大小的描述，是否与背景中“多种因素共同作用”一致？是否又叠加了太多限定？
explanation: hedging 不只是加 may：如果论断内容本身超出了证据（the main cause），只加 may 仍然是过度结论。背景指出焦虑有多种原因，因此应把“最主要原因”改为“若干因素之一”，并用 appears to / contributing to 适度限定：Social media appears to be one of several factors contributing to anxiety among teenagers. 中国学生常把“主要原因”写成 the main cause，又以为加上 may 就足够严谨；同时也要避免另一个极端——叠加 might perhaps possible could，让观点消失。
focus: 报告动词与因果断言超出证据

instruction: 下面哪一句用最恰当的学术语体表达了一个尚有争议的观点？
content: Topic: Is mass tourism good for small historic towns?
options: I guess mass tourism is probably more harmful than beneficial to small historic towns.
Maybe mass tourism is more harmful than beneficial to small historic towns.
In my personal opinion, I think mass tourism is more harmful than beneficial to small historic towns.
Mass tourism is arguably more harmful than beneficial to small historic towns.
option_explanations: I guess（我猜）是口语，会让读者觉得作者在随口猜测，而不是有依据地论证。
Maybe 放在句首是口语化的限定方式，学术写作中很少使用。
In my personal opinion 和 I think 意思重复，而且都偏主观、口语；这是把“我个人认为”逐字翻译后叠加的典型错误。
正确。arguably 意为“可以说、有理由认为”，表示作者有依据地提出一个可争论的观点，语气正式、简洁。
hints: 四个句子的观点相同，区别只在于表达“不确定 / 个人看法”的方式。
学术写作倾向于用不带“我”的正式副词或情态动词来限定论断，而不是用口语或重复的主观表达。
找出只用一个正式副词就完成限定的句子。
explanation: 中国学生常用 Maybe / I guess / In my personal opinion, I think 表达“我觉得、也许”，这些表达或口语化，或语义重复。学术写作中，arguably（可以说）、may、it could be argued that 更正式：Mass tourism is arguably more harmful than beneficial to small historic towns. 雅思议论文表明总体立场时可以用 I believe，但不要把 personal opinion 和 I think 叠用，也不要用 I guess / maybe。
focus: 口语化或主观化的限定表达

instruction: 用恰当的限定语气改写下面的句子（一句话），去掉过度概括，保留原意。不要用 maybe。
content: Children in big cities never play outside.
accepted: Many children in big cities rarely play outside.
Children in big cities tend to play outside less often than those in the countryside.
Children in big cities often have few chances to play outside.
criteria: 通过条件：1）必须替换绝对化的 never（可改为 rarely / seldom / less often / not often 等），也可同时用 many / some 等缩小人群范围；只把主语改为 many children 而保留 never 不通过；2）保留“城市儿童户外活动少”的核心意思，改成 sometimes / often play outside 等改变原意的写法不通过；3）不使用 maybe，不叠加三个或更多限定词；4）语法正确（如 tend to + 动词原形，rarely / seldom 放在实义动词之前）。其他正确、自然的改写同样可以接受。
hints: 找出原句中一个反例就能推翻整句话的词。
可以把“从不”换成表示“很少”的频率词，也可以同时缩小所指的人群范围。
想一想：城市里真的没有一个孩子在外面玩吗？用一个承认例外的频率表达代替原词。
explanation: never 和 always 一样是绝对化表达，只要找到一个在城市公园里玩耍的孩子，这句话就被推翻。改写时可降低频率（never → rarely / seldom / less often），也可缩小范围（many children），或二者结合：Many children in big cities rarely play outside. 中国学生常把“现在城里的孩子都不出去玩”直译为 Children never play outside，形成过度概括。
focus: 绝对化量词与频率词导致过度概括

instruction: 下面的句子把一项政策的效果说得过于肯定，其中有两处说过头：一处是确定性，一处是效果的程度。请用恰当的限定语气改写（一句话），保留“禁止电视垃圾食品广告”和“儿童肥胖”两个要素。
content: Banning junk food advertising on television will definitely solve the problem of childhood obesity.
accepted: Banning junk food advertising on television could help to reduce childhood obesity.
A ban on junk food advertising on television may help to reduce childhood obesity.
Banning junk food advertising on television is likely to contribute to lower rates of childhood obesity.
criteria: 通过条件：1）去掉 will definitely 的绝对确定语气，改用 may / could / can / is likely to / will probably 等；2）把 solve the problem（彻底解决）改为 help to reduce / contribute to lower rates of / reduce 等表示部分作用的表达；3）保留“禁止电视垃圾食品广告”与“儿童肥胖”两个要素；4）不使用 maybe，不叠加三个或更多限定词；5）语法正确（情态动词后接动词原形，help to reduce 或 help reduce 均可）。其他正确、自然的改写同样可以接受。
hints: 找出句中表示“肯定会”的词，以及表示“彻底”的动词短语。
一项措施通常只能部分缓解复杂的健康问题；预测政策效果时要用表示可能性的表达。
想一想：禁播广告后，肥胖问题会彻底消失，还是可能有所缓解？据此同时修改确定性和动词。
explanation: will definitely 把对政策效果的预测说成了必然，solve the problem 又夸大了效果的程度——儿童肥胖与饮食习惯、运动量、家庭环境等多种因素有关，单靠禁播广告不可能彻底解决。应同时降低确定性（could / may / is likely to）和效果程度（help to reduce）：Banning junk food advertising on television could help to reduce childhood obesity. 中国学生常把“一定能解决”直译为 will definitely solve，这是议论文中最常见的过度断言之一。
focus: 确定性情态词与强化词使用过度

instruction: 学生的结论超出了证据能支持的范围。请根据证据改写结论（一句话），使报告动词、效果程度和适用范围都与证据相符。
content:
Evidence: In a three-month study, 60 office workers at one company were given plants for their desks. Afterwards, they reported feeling less stressed than colleagues without plants.
Student's conclusion: This shows that indoor plants cure stress in all workers.
accepted: This suggests that desk plants may help to reduce stress among some office workers.
The study indicates that desk plants may be associated with lower levels of stress among office workers, although more research is needed.
These results suggest that indoor plants may help office workers feel less stressed.
criteria: 通过条件：1）不得用 shows / proves 得出推广性的结论，应换成 suggests / indicates 等较弱的报告动词（若保留 shows，只能用于如实复述研究对象的结果，如 The study shows that the workers who were given plants reported feeling less stressed，且不再推广到其他人）；2）把 cure（治愈）改为 help to reduce / be associated with lower stress / help ... feel less stressed 等表示缓解或相关的表达；3）不能再说 all workers，范围应与证据一致（如 office workers / some office workers / the employees in the study）；4）保留“桌上植物”与“压力减轻”的核心关系；5）不过度限定（主句中不叠加三个或更多限定词），语法正确、语域正式，不用 maybe。其他正确、自然的改写同样可以接受。
hints: 对比证据和结论：样本有多大、来自哪里？测量的是什么？结论又说了什么？
需要同时调整三处：报告动词的强度、cure 所表示的效果程度、all workers 的适用范围。
证据只是一家公司员工“自我感觉压力较小”，结论的每个部分都不能比这更强。
explanation: 一项只在一家公司进行、样本 60 人、依靠自我报告的三个月研究，只能说明桌上摆植物与“感觉压力较小”有关：不宜用 shows 得出推广性的结论，不能说 cure（治愈），更不能推广到 all workers。应写：This suggests that desk plants may help to reduce stress among some office workers. 中国学生常用 show / prove 表示“说明”，用 cure / solve 表示“改善”，并把小样本结论推广到“所有人”。
focus: 报告动词与因果断言超出证据

instruction: 下面这个 thesis statement 限定过度，读者看不出作者的立场。请改写成一句立场清楚、同时仍然严谨的 thesis（全句最多使用一到两个限定手段）。
content: It could perhaps be argued that, in some cases, zoos might possibly play a somewhat useful role in protecting certain endangered species to some extent.
accepted: Zoos can play a valuable role in protecting some endangered species.
Although they have limitations, zoos play an important role in protecting many endangered species.
Zoos can make an important contribution to protecting endangered species through breeding programmes.
criteria: 通过条件：1）删去大部分限定词（原句叠加了 could perhaps, in some cases, might possibly, somewhat, certain, to some extent），全句限定手段不超过两个（如 can + some / many；让步从句 Although ... 不计入）；2）明确表达“动物园对保护濒危物种有积极作用”的立场；3）不走向另一个极端：不能使用 always / all / definitely / the only way 等绝对化表达；4）语法正确、语域正式，不用 maybe。其他正确、自然的改写同样可以接受。
hints: 数一数原句一共用了多少个表示“可能 / 某种程度上 / 某些”的词或短语。
thesis 需要清晰的立场；一般保留一个情态动词或一个范围词就足够了。
先写出“动物园 + 发挥作用 + 保护濒危物种”这个核心句，再只加一个最需要的限定。
explanation: 学了 hedging 后，一些学生会走向另一个极端：could perhaps, might possibly, somewhat, to some extent 层层叠加，结果观点完全消失，考官会认为立场不清（IELTS Task Response 要求 a clear position）。好的 thesis 只保留一到两个限定：Zoos can play a valuable role in protecting some endangered species. 中国学生常以为“限定词越多越学术”，其实过度限定和过度绝对一样会削弱论证。
focus: 限定过度或对事实不必要的限定

instruction: 下面两句话使用了多个强化或绝对化的表达，读起来像武断的预言。请改写为 1-2 句话：保留作者“反对提高退休年龄”的立场和两个理由（对老年员工不利、影响年轻人就业），但让语气与证据相符。
content: Undoubtedly, raising the retirement age will force all older employees to stay in jobs they can no longer do well. It must also lead to higher youth unemployment, since older people will never leave their positions.
accepted: Raising the retirement age may force many older employees to stay in jobs they find increasingly difficult. It could also reduce job opportunities for young people, as fewer positions would become available.
Raising the retirement age is likely to keep some older employees in jobs they can no longer do well, and it may also make it harder for young people to find work.
A higher retirement age could leave many older workers in jobs that have become too demanding for them, and it might also slow the creation of openings for younger job seekers.
criteria: 通过条件：1）去掉或替换 undoubtedly、must、will force 等表示“毫无疑问 / 必然”的表达，改用 may / could / might / can / is likely to 等；2）把 all older employees 改为 many / some older employees 等；3）把 will never leave their positions 这一绝对化理由删去，或改为温和表达（如 fewer positions would become available）；4）保留“反对提高退休年龄”的立场以及两个理由（对老年员工不利、减少年轻人就业机会）；5）每个分句的限定手段不超过两个，观点仍然清楚；6）语法正确、语域正式，不用 maybe。其他正确、自然的改写同样可以接受。
hints: 把原文中所有表示“毫无疑问”“必然”“所有人”“绝不”的表达圈出来，一共有好几处。
预测政策后果时用表示可能性的情态动词；描述人群时用表示部分的范围词；理由中的绝对化说法也要一并修改。
每处修改都问自己“有没有反例”：有没有仍能胜任工作的老年员工？有没有会主动离职的老人？
explanation: 原文的 undoubtedly、will force all、must lead to、will never 都把对政策后果的推测说成了必然。事实上，很多老年员工仍能胜任工作，提高退休年龄是否会推高青年失业率在经济学界也有争议。改写时要逐一降低：undoubtedly → 删去；will force all → may force many；must lead to → could reduce；will never leave → fewer positions would become available。示例：Raising the retirement age may force many older employees to stay in jobs they find increasingly difficult. It could also reduce job opportunities for young people, as fewer positions would become available. 中国学生常用“毫无疑问”“必然”“绝不”增强气势，但在英语议论文中，缺乏证据的 boosters 反而会降低可信度。
focus: 确定性情态词与强化词使用过度

instruction: 下面的句子用了口语化的限定方式。请改写成一句正式的学术句子：用学术限定表达（如情态动词、tend to、arguably 等）代替口语表达，并保留原意。
content: I think maybe online shopping is kind of bad for small local shops.
accepted: Online shopping may harm small local shops.
Online shopping can have a negative impact on small local shops.
Online shopping is arguably harmful to small local shops.
criteria: 通过条件：1）删去 I think、maybe、kind of 三个口语化 / 主观表达；2）使用一个正式的限定手段（may / can / could / tend to / arguably / is likely to 等）；3）把口语化的 bad for 换成更正式的表达（如 harm, have a negative impact on, be harmful to, threaten）；4）保留“网购对本地小店不利”的原意；5）语法正确，限定手段不超过两个。其他正确、自然的改写同样可以接受。
hints: 找出原句中三个让语气变得口语化、随意的表达。
学术写作通常把“可能”放进谓语里（情态动词或正式副词），而不是用“我觉得 / 也许 / 有点”。
删去这三个表达后，再为“对……不好”找一个更正式的动词或短语，并只加一个正式的限定手段。
explanation: I think、maybe、kind of 都是口语中表示不确定的方式，叠在一起既不正式，又显得作者没有把握。学术写作用情态动词（may / can）、正式副词（arguably）或 tend to 表示谨慎：Online shopping may harm small local shops. 同时把口语化的 bad for 换成 harm / have a negative impact on。中国学生常把“我觉得可能有点……”逐字翻译，造成口语化的多重限定。
focus: 口语化或主观化的限定表达

instruction: 下面的句子有一处连接词错误，请改正并写出完整的句子。
content: Because many parents work long hours, so their children spend a lot of time alone at home.
accepted: Because many parents work long hours, their children spend a lot of time alone at home.
As many parents work long hours, their children spend a lot of time alone at home.
Since many parents work long hours, their children spend a lot of time alone at home.
Many parents work long hours, so their children spend a lot of time alone at home.
Many parents work long hours, and so their children spend a lot of time alone at home.
Many parents work long hours; therefore, their children spend a lot of time alone at home.
Many parents work long hours; therefore their children spend a lot of time alone at home.
Many parents work long hours. Therefore, their children spend a lot of time alone at home.
Many parents work long hours. Therefore their children spend a lot of time alone at home.
Many parents work long hours; as a result, their children spend a lot of time alone at home.
Many parents work long hours. As a result, their children spend a lot of time alone at home.
Many parents work long hours; consequently, their children spend a lot of time alone at home.
Many parents work long hours. Consequently, their children spend a lot of time alone at home.
Many parents work long hours, and as a result, their children spend a lot of time alone at home.
Many parents work long hours, and as a result their children spend a lot of time alone at home.
Many parents work long hours; thus, their children spend a lot of time alone at home.
Many parents work long hours. Because of this, their children spend a lot of time alone at home.
Due to the fact that many parents work long hours, their children spend a lot of time alone at home.
criteria: 必须改掉 because 和 so 同时使用的错误，只保留一个：删除 so（Because / As / Since many parents work long hours, their children ...），或删除 because（Many parents work long hours, so their children ...）。也接受 Due to the fact that ...，或用 ; therefore, / . Therefore, / ; as a result, / . As a result, / ; consequently, / ; thus, / . Because of this, / , and as a result 等方式连接两个句子。不能出现新的逗号粘连（如“..., therefore, their children ...”）。其他不改变原意、语法正确的改动也可接受。
hints: 数一数这个句子里有几个表示因果关系的连接词。
英语里 because 和 so 不能在同一个句子里成对使用，一个因果关系只用一个连接词。
保留表示“原因”的词，或者保留表示“结果”的词，删掉另一个，再检查逗号是否正确。
explanation: 中文常说“因为……所以……”，但英语里 because 和 so 只能二选一：Because A, B. 或 A, so B. 两个同时出现就是连接词重复，这是母语直译造成的典型错误。正确：Because many parents work long hours, their children spend a lot of time alone at home. 或 Many parents work long hours, so their children spend a lot of time alone at home. 如果用 therefore / as a result，要记住它们是副词，前面用分号或句号：Many parents work long hours; therefore, their children spend a lot of time alone at home.
focus: 连接词叠用（because…so / but however）

instruction: 下面哪一句的连接词使用正确？
options: Although self-service checkouts shorten queues in supermarkets, but they also put many cashiers out of work.
Self-service checkouts shorten queues in supermarkets, but however, they also put many cashiers out of work.
Although self-service checkouts shorten queues in supermarkets, they also put many cashiers out of work.
Although self-service checkouts shorten queues in supermarkets, however, they also put many cashiers out of work.
option_explanations: 错误。although 和 but 不能同时使用，这是把中文“虽然……但是……”直译成英语造成的重复，应删掉其中一个。
错误。but 和 however 都表示转折，叠用 but however 属于重复，只保留 but（..., but they also ...）即可。
正确。although 引导让步从句，主句前不需要再加任何转折词，逗号后直接接主句 they also put many cashiers out of work。
错误。although 引导的让步从句后面，主句前不能再加 however。这同样是“虽然……但是……”式的重复；而且 however 是副词，不能用来连接从句和主句。
hints: 数一数每个选项中表示“转折/让步”的连接词有几个。
英语里一个让步或转折关系只需要一个连接词：用了 although 引导从句，主句前就不能再加 but 或 however。
三个以 Although 开头的选项只差在逗号后面有没有多一个词；再检查不以 Although 开头的那一项用了几个转折词。
explanation: 汉语“虽然……但是……”要成对使用，英语只能用一个：Although A, B. 或 A, but B. although ... but、although ... however、but however 都是重复连接，是中国学生按母语框架直译的常见错误。正确：Although self-service checkouts shorten queues in supermarkets, they also put many cashiers out of work. 也可以写成：Self-service checkouts shorten queues in supermarkets, but they also put many cashiers out of work. 或 ...in supermarkets; however, they also put many cashiers out of work.
focus: 连接词叠用（because…so / but however）

instruction: 下面的句子有一处连接词用法（标点）错误，请改正并写出完整的句子。
content: Many teenagers stay up late playing games on their phones, therefore they often feel sleepy in class the next day.
accepted: Many teenagers stay up late playing games on their phones; therefore, they often feel sleepy in class the next day.
Many teenagers stay up late playing games on their phones; therefore they often feel sleepy in class the next day.
Many teenagers stay up late playing games on their phones. Therefore, they often feel sleepy in class the next day.
Many teenagers stay up late playing games on their phones. Therefore they often feel sleepy in class the next day.
Many teenagers stay up late playing games on their phones, so they often feel sleepy in class the next day.
Many teenagers stay up late playing games on their phones, and therefore they often feel sleepy in class the next day.
Many teenagers stay up late playing games on their phones, and, therefore, they often feel sleepy in class the next day.
Many teenagers stay up late playing games on their phones; as a result, they often feel sleepy in class the next day.
Many teenagers stay up late playing games on their phones. As a result, they often feel sleepy in class the next day.
Many teenagers stay up late playing games on their phones; consequently, they often feel sleepy in class the next day.
Many teenagers stay up late playing games on their phones. Consequently, they often feel sleepy in class the next day.
Because many teenagers stay up late playing games on their phones, they often feel sleepy in class the next day.
Since many teenagers stay up late playing games on their phones, they often feel sleepy in class the next day.
Many teenagers stay up late playing games on their phones, and as a result, they often feel sleepy in class the next day.
Many teenagers stay up late playing games on their phones; thus, they often feel sleepy in class the next day.
Many teenagers stay up late playing games on their phones. Because of this, they often feel sleepy in class the next day.
criteria: 必须改正逗号粘连：therefore 是副词，不能用逗号连接两个完整的句子。可以改为 ; therefore, 或 . Therefore,（therefore 后的逗号可以省略），也可以改用 , so / , and therefore / , and as a result，或用 ; as a result, / ; consequently, / ; thus, / . Because of this, 连接，或改成 Because / Since ..., they ... 的主从句。不能保留“, therefore”的写法，也不能换成 however 等其他副词后仍只用逗号。其他不改变原意、语法正确的改动也可接受。
hints: 看 therefore 前后：两边各是一个完整的句子吗？
therefore 和 however 一样是副词，不是 and / but / so 这样的并列连词，不能只靠逗号连接两个句子。
要么把 therefore 前面的逗号换成更“强”的标点，要么换成一个可以直接跟在逗号后面的并列连词。
explanation: therefore、however、moreover、as a result 等连接副词只表示逻辑关系，在语法上不能把两个句子连成一句。中文里“……，因此……”一逗到底很常见，所以学生容易写出逗号粘连（comma splice）。正确：Many teenagers stay up late playing games on their phones; therefore, they often feel sleepy in class the next day. 也可以用并列连词：Many teenagers stay up late playing games on their phones, so they often feel sleepy in class the next day.
focus: 连接副词误作连词造成逗号粘连

instruction: 选择能正确填入空格的词。注意空格前的标点。
content: Electric cars produce no exhaust fumes on the road, ______ the electricity that powers them often comes from coal-fired power stations.
options: however
but
nevertheless
therefore
option_explanations: 逻辑上是转折，但 however 是副词，放在逗号后连接两个完整的句子会造成逗号粘连，应写成 ...on the road; however, the electricity ...。
正确。but 是并列连词，可以用逗号连接两个完整的句子，表达“路上不排尾气”和“电可能来自燃煤电厂”之间的转折。
nevertheless 在意思上可以表示让步转折，但它也是副词，不能直接用逗号连接两个句子。
therefore 表示结果，逻辑不通（电来自燃煤电厂并不是“不排尾气”的结果）；而且它也是副词，不能用逗号连接两个句子。
hints: 先判断两句的逻辑关系，再看空格前用的是什么标点。
逗号后面要连接一个完整的句子时，只能用 and / but / so 这一类并列连词，不能用连接副词。
有两个选项意思对，但词性不对；找出意思对、词性也对的那一个。
explanation: 两句之间是转折关系（不排尾气 vs 电力可能来自燃煤电厂）。空格前只有逗号，所以只能用并列连词 but（或 yet）。however 和 nevertheless 意思虽然对，但它们是副词，必须写成 ...on the road; however, the electricity ... 或 ...on the road. Nevertheless, the electricity ...。中国学生常把 however 当作“但是”直接放在逗号后，这就是逗号粘连。正确：Electric cars produce no exhaust fumes on the road, but the electricity that powers them often comes from coal-fired power stations.
focus: 连接副词误作连词造成逗号粘连

instruction: 选择最合适的连接词填空。
content: Some drinks that look healthy actually contain a lot of sugar. ______, a small bottle of orange juice can have as much sugar as a can of cola.
options: For example
However
As a result
On the other hand
option_explanations: 正确。第二句的“橙汁”是第一句中“看起来健康却含很多糖的饮料”的具体例子，用 For example 引出例子。
However 表示转折，但第二句并没有和第一句相反，而是在支持第一句。
As a result 表示结果，但橙汁含糖多并不是第一句造成的结果。
On the other hand 用来引出相反的一面，而这两句意思方向一致。
hints: 第二句里的“橙汁”和第一句里“看起来健康的饮料”是什么关系？
后一句给出前一句观点的具体实例时，要用表示“举例”的连接词。
排除表示转折、结果和对比的选项。
explanation: 选连接词前先判断逻辑关系：第一句提出一般性观点（有些看似健康的饮料含糖很多），第二句给出具体实例（一小瓶橙汁的含糖量相当于一罐可乐），所以用 For example / For instance。学生常把连接词当装饰，不看关系就用 However 或 As a result。正确：Some drinks that look healthy actually contain a lot of sugar. For example, a small bottle of orange juice can have as much sugar as a can of cola. 注意 for example 后面接完整的句子，such as 后面接名词：drinks such as orange juice。
focus: 逻辑关系误判（因果/转折/举例选错）

instruction: 选择最符合逻辑的选项填空。注意哪一句是原因、哪一句是结果。
content: Far fewer young people in our city own cars today than ten years ago. ______ the new metro lines make it quick and cheap to travel almost anywhere.
options: As a result,
This is partly because
This is partly why
In spite of this,
option_explanations: As a result 引出结果，但“新地铁线路又快又便宜”并不是“年轻人买车少”造成的结果，因果方向写反了。
正确。第二句说明第一句现象的原因：地铁快捷便宜，所以年轻人买车少。This is (partly) because 用来补充前一句的原因。
This is why 的意思是“这就是……的原因”，后面接结果。这里第二句是原因，用 This is why 会把因果方向颠倒。
In spite of this 表示让步（尽管如此），但两句之间没有冲突，而是因果关系。
hints: 两个句子中，哪一个是原因，哪一个是结果？
第二句在解释第一句“为什么会这样”时，要用引出原因的表达；引出结果的表达方向正好相反。
比较 this is why 和 this is because：哪一个后面接的是原因？
explanation: 第二句（新地铁线路让出行又快又便宜）解释的是第一句现象（年轻人买车变少）的原因，所以用 This is (partly) because。This is why、As a result、Therefore 都引出结果，用在这里会把因果方向颠倒。中国学生常把“这是因为”和“这就是为什么”混用。正确：Far fewer young people in our city own cars today than ten years ago. This is partly because the new metro lines make it quick and cheap to travel almost anywhere. 如果想用 As a result，就要调换两句的顺序：The new metro lines make it quick and cheap to travel almost anywhere. As a result, far fewer young people in our city own cars today than ten years ago.
focus: 逻辑关系误判（因果/转折/举例选错）

instruction: 下面的两句话中有一个连接词逻辑关系用错了。请改正并写出完整的两句话。
content: Several hospitals have begun sending patients a text-message reminder the day before each appointment. However, the number of missed appointments at these hospitals has fallen noticeably.
accepted: Several hospitals have begun sending patients a text-message reminder the day before each appointment. As a result, the number of missed appointments at these hospitals has fallen noticeably.
Several hospitals have begun sending patients a text-message reminder the day before each appointment. Consequently, the number of missed appointments at these hospitals has fallen noticeably.
Several hospitals have begun sending patients a text-message reminder the day before each appointment. As a consequence, the number of missed appointments at these hospitals has fallen noticeably.
Several hospitals have begun sending patients a text-message reminder the day before each appointment. Because of this, the number of missed appointments at these hospitals has fallen noticeably.
Several hospitals have begun sending patients a text-message reminder the day before each appointment. Therefore, the number of missed appointments at these hospitals has fallen noticeably.
Several hospitals have begun sending patients a text-message reminder the day before each appointment. Thus, the number of missed appointments at these hospitals has fallen noticeably.
Several hospitals have begun sending patients a text-message reminder the day before each appointment. Thanks to this, the number of missed appointments at these hospitals has fallen noticeably.
Several hospitals have begun sending patients a text-message reminder the day before each appointment. Since then, the number of missed appointments at these hospitals has fallen noticeably.
Several hospitals have begun sending patients a text-message reminder the day before each appointment; as a result, the number of missed appointments at these hospitals has fallen noticeably.
Several hospitals have begun sending patients a text-message reminder the day before each appointment; consequently, the number of missed appointments at these hospitals has fallen noticeably.
Several hospitals have begun sending patients a text-message reminder the day before each appointment, so the number of missed appointments at these hospitals has fallen noticeably.
Several hospitals have begun sending patients a text-message reminder the day before each appointment, and as a result the number of missed appointments at these hospitals has fallen noticeably.
Several hospitals have begun sending patients a text-message reminder the day before each appointment. The number of missed appointments at these hospitals has fallen noticeably.
criteria: 必须把 However 改成表示结果的连接词（As a result / Consequently / As a consequence / Because of this / Therefore / Thus / Thanks to this 等），因为“错过预约的人数下降”是“医院提前发短信提醒”带来的结果，两句之间没有转折。也接受表示时间先后的 Since then、用 , so 合并两句，或直接删掉 However、不加连接词。不能换成 Nevertheless / In contrast / On the other hand 等仍表示转折或对比的词；用 therefore / consequently 时不能只用逗号连接两句（逗号粘连）。其余内容不应改变；其他语法正确、意思不变的改动也可接受。
hints: 第二句描述的情况和第一句是相反的吗？
However 只用于转折或对比；如果后一句是前一句带来的后果，要用表示因果的连接词。
问自己：错过预约的人变少了，和医院提前发短信提醒是什么关系？
explanation: 第一句是措施（医院在每次预约前一天发短信提醒病人），第二句是这项措施带来的结果（错过预约的人数明显下降），两句是因果关系，应该用 As a result / Consequently。However 表示转折，读者看到它会期待“提醒了，情况却没有改善”之类的相反内容，结果下一句说的却是好结果，逻辑不通。很多学生把 However 当成段落中“接着说下一句”的万能开头，这是常见误用。正确：Several hospitals have begun sending patients a text-message reminder the day before each appointment. As a result, the number of missed appointments at these hospitals has fallen noticeably.
focus: 逻辑关系误判（因果/转折/举例选错）

instruction: 下面哪一句的连接词使用正确？注意每个词后面接的是完整的句子还是名词短语。
options: Despite the city museum is free on Sundays, few local families visit it.
Although free entry on Sundays, few local families visit the city museum.
Despite of free entry on Sundays, few local families visit the city museum.
Despite free entry on Sundays, few local families visit the city museum.
option_explanations: 错误。despite 是介词，后面只能接名词短语或动名词，不能接有主语和谓语的句子 the city museum is free on Sundays。可改为 Although the city museum is free on Sundays, ...。
错误。although 是连词，后面要接从句（如 Although entry is free on Sundays），不能直接接名词短语 free entry on Sundays。
错误。despite 本身就是介词，不能写成 despite of；可以说 despite 或 in spite of。
正确。介词 despite 后接名词短语 free entry on Sundays，表示让步：尽管周日免费入场，却很少有本地家庭去参观。
hints: 先看每个选项中 despite / although 后面接的是什么：有主语和谓语动词的句子，还是名词短语？
表示“尽管”时，连词后面接句子，介词后面接名词；还要注意 despite 和 in spite of 的固定写法。
排除“介词 + 句子”和“连词 + 名词”的选项，再检查剩下两项中介词的写法。
explanation: 表示“尽管”有两种语法形式：连词 although / even though + 从句；介词 despite / in spite of + 名词（短语）或动名词。because 与 because of / due to 的区别也一样。中文“尽管”后面句子和名词都能接，所以学生容易写出 despite + 句子、although + 名词，还常把 despite 和 in spite of 混成 despite of。正确：Despite free entry on Sundays, few local families visit the city museum. 也可以写成：Although entry to the city museum is free on Sundays, few local families visit it.
focus: 介词短语与连词混用（despite/due to + 从句）

instruction: 下面的句子有一处连接词错误（连接词与后面所接成分不匹配），请改正并写出完整的句子。
content: Due to a growing number of employees now work from home for part of the week, demand for office space in city centres has fallen sharply.
accepted: Because a growing number of employees now work from home for part of the week, demand for office space in city centres has fallen sharply.
As a growing number of employees now work from home for part of the week, demand for office space in city centres has fallen sharply.
Since a growing number of employees now work from home for part of the week, demand for office space in city centres has fallen sharply.
Due to the fact that a growing number of employees now work from home for part of the week, demand for office space in city centres has fallen sharply.
Owing to the fact that a growing number of employees now work from home for part of the week, demand for office space in city centres has fallen sharply.
Because of the fact that a growing number of employees now work from home for part of the week, demand for office space in city centres has fallen sharply.
Due to a growing number of employees now working from home for part of the week, demand for office space in city centres has fallen sharply.
Owing to a growing number of employees now working from home for part of the week, demand for office space in city centres has fallen sharply.
Because of a growing number of employees now working from home for part of the week, demand for office space in city centres has fallen sharply.
With a growing number of employees now working from home for part of the week, demand for office space in city centres has fallen sharply.
Now that a growing number of employees work from home for part of the week, demand for office space in city centres has fallen sharply.
A growing number of employees now work from home for part of the week, so demand for office space in city centres has fallen sharply.
A growing number of employees now work from home for part of the week; as a result, demand for office space in city centres has fallen sharply.
A growing number of employees now work from home for part of the week. As a result, demand for office space in city centres has fallen sharply.
criteria: 必须改正 due to 后面直接接完整从句的错误：due to 是介词短语，只能接名词（短语）或动名词。可以把 Due to 改为连词 Because / As / Since / Now that；或改为 Due to the fact that / Owing to the fact that；或把 work 改为 working（Due to / Owing to / Because of / With a growing number of employees now working ...）；也接受改为 ..., so demand ... / ...; as a result, demand ... 等结构。其余部分不应改变原意；其他语法正确的改动也可接受。
hints: 看句首的 Due to 后面接的是什么：名词短语，还是有谓语动词的完整句子？
due to / because of 是介词短语，只能接名词或动名词；because / as / since 才能接完整的句子。
要么换掉句首的连接词，要么改动从句中的谓语动词，让它能和 due to 搭配。
explanation: due to、because of、owing to 是介词（短语），后面接名词、名词短语或动名词，例如 due to the rise of remote working。because、as、since 是连词，后面接完整的从句。原句中 a growing number of employees now work ... 有谓语 work，是完整的句子，所以要把 Due to 改成 Because（或 As / Since），或改成 Due to the fact that；也可以保留 Due to，把 work 改成 working。中文“由于”后面句子和名词都能接，所以学生常写出 due to + 句子。正确：Because a growing number of employees now work from home for part of the week, demand for office space in city centres has fallen sharply.
focus: 介词短语与连词混用（despite/due to + 从句）

instruction: 选择最恰当的连接词填空。
content: ______ every pupil were given a free tablet computer, many would still need a teacher's guidance to use it effectively for learning.
options: Even if
Even though
Despite
Because
option_explanations: 正确。even if 引出假设条件（“即使……也……”），和 were given ... would ... 的虚拟语气搭配：即使每个学生都得到免费平板电脑，很多人仍然需要老师指导。
even though 表示“尽管（事实如此）”，后面接已经发生或确实存在的事实，不能和 were ... would 这种假设语气搭配。
despite 是介词，后面不能接完整的从句 every pupil were given ...。
because 表示原因，但“得到免费平板”不会导致“仍需要指导”；而且 still 说明这里是让步关系。
hints: 看从句中的 were 和主句中的 would：这句话描述的是事实，还是假设？
even though 和 even if 都可以译成“即使/尽管”，但一个用于真实情况，一个用于假设情况。
先排除不能接从句的介词，再在两个以 even 开头的选项中选出能和虚拟语气搭配的那一个。
explanation: even though = although，表示对事实的让步：Even though the school gives every pupil a tablet, many pupils still need guidance.（学校确实发了平板）。even if 表示对假设条件的让步，常和 were / would 连用：Even if every pupil were given a free tablet computer, many would still need a teacher's guidance to use it effectively for learning.（假设真的发了，也……）。本句用了 were given ... would ...，是假设，所以选 Even if。中文“即使”和“尽管”常常混用，学生容易把 even if 和 even though 当成同一个词。
focus: 近义对比让步词辨析（on the contrary / even if）

instruction: 选择最恰当的连接词填空。注意几个表示“相反/对比”的表达在用法上的区别。
content: Growing up with two languages does not appear to delay children's cognitive development. ______, several studies suggest that bilingual children are often better at switching their attention between tasks.
options: In contrast
Nevertheless
On the contrary
On the other hand
option_explanations: In contrast 用于比较两个不同对象的差异（如“A 学校……In contrast, B 学校……”）。这里两句说的是同一件事（在双语环境中成长），第二句并不是在和另一个对象比较。
Nevertheless 表示让步：承认前一句，但后一句与它形成冲突或出乎意料。这里两句都在说明双语对孩子无害甚至有益，没有冲突。
正确。前一句否定了“双语会延迟认知发展”的担忧，后一句提出与这种担忧正好相反的事实（双语儿童反而更善于切换注意力）。On the contrary 就是用在否定句之后，引出“恰恰相反”的事实。
On the other hand 用来引出问题的另一面（通常与前一面方向相反）。这里第二句与第一句方向一致、层层加强，不是“另一方面”。
hints: 注意第一句是肯定句还是否定句，它否定了一种什么样的担忧？
四个选项都和“相反/对比”有关：有的用来比较两个不同的事物，有的用来否定前文的说法、提出相反的事实。
第二句并没有和第一句冲突，而是从反面进一步加强了第一句的观点。
explanation: On the contrary 用在否定一个说法之后，引出“事实恰恰相反”的内容，常跟在否定句后：It does not delay development. On the contrary, it may improve certain skills. In contrast 用于比较两个不同对象，On the other hand 引出问题的另一面，Nevertheless 表示让步。正确：Growing up with two languages does not appear to delay children's cognitive development. On the contrary, several studies suggest that bilingual children are often better at switching their attention between tasks. 中文“相反地”可以对应多个英文表达，学生容易按中文意思混用。
focus: 近义对比让步词辨析（on the contrary / even if）

instruction: 下面的两句话中有一个对比连接词用得不恰当。请改正并写出完整的两句话。
content: Older shoppers tend to remain loyal to brands they have trusted for decades. On the contrary, younger consumers are far more willing to switch to a new product after reading a few positive online reviews.
accepted: Older shoppers tend to remain loyal to brands they have trusted for decades. In contrast, younger consumers are far more willing to switch to a new product after reading a few positive online reviews.

Older shoppers tend to remain loyal to brands they have trusted for decades. By contrast, younger consumers are far more willing to switch to a new product after reading a few positive online reviews.

Older shoppers tend to remain loyal to brands they have trusted for decades. On the other hand, younger consumers are far more willing to switch to a new product after reading a few positive online reviews.
Older shoppers tend to remain loyal to brands they have trusted for decades. However, younger consumers are far more willing to switch to a new product after reading a few positive online reviews.
Older shoppers tend to remain loyal to brands they have trusted for decades. Conversely, younger consumers are far more willing to switch to a new product after reading a few positive online reviews.

Older shoppers tend to remain loyal to brands they have trusted for decades; in contrast, younger consumers are far more willing to switch to a new product after reading a few positive online reviews.

Older shoppers tend to remain loyal to brands they have trusted for decades; by contrast, younger consumers are far more willing to switch to a new product after reading a few positive online reviews.
Older shoppers tend to remain loyal to brands they have trusted for decades; however, younger consumers are far more willing to switch to a new product after reading a few positive online reviews.

Older shoppers tend to remain loyal to brands they have trusted for decades. Younger consumers, in contrast, are far more willing to switch to a new product after reading a few positive online reviews.

Older shoppers tend to remain loyal to brands they have trusted for decades. Younger consumers, by contrast, are far more willing to switch to a new product after reading a few positive online reviews.

Older shoppers tend to remain loyal to brands they have trusted for decades. Younger consumers, on the other hand, are far more willing to switch to a new product after reading a few positive online reviews.
Older shoppers tend to remain loyal to brands they have trusted for decades. Younger consumers, however, are far more willing to switch to a new product after reading a few positive online reviews.
Older shoppers tend to remain loyal to brands they have trusted for decades, whereas younger consumers are far more willing to switch to a new product after reading a few positive online reviews.
Older shoppers tend to remain loyal to brands they have trusted for decades, while younger consumers are far more willing to switch to a new product after reading a few positive online reviews.
Older shoppers tend to remain loyal to brands they have trusted for decades, but younger consumers are far more willing to switch to a new product after reading a few positive online reviews.
criteria: 必须把 On the contrary 改成用于比较两个不同群体的对比连接词：In contrast / By contrast / On the other hand / However / Conversely 等（可放在句首，也可放在 younger consumers 之后，或用分号连接）；也接受用 , whereas / , while / , but 合并两句。On the contrary 只用于否定前面的说法、提出相反的事实，不能用来比较老年顾客和年轻消费者。用 however / in contrast 等副词合并两句时不能只用逗号（逗号粘连）。其余内容不应改变；其他语法正确、意思不变的改动也可接受。
hints: 这两句话是在否定前一句的说法，还是在比较两个不同的群体？
On the contrary 用于否定前文（常跟在否定句后）；比较两个不同对象的差异，要用另一类对比表达。
前一句并没有被否定（老年顾客确实忠于品牌），第二句只是描述另一群人的不同做法。
explanation: 本段比较两个不同的群体：老年顾客忠于老品牌，年轻消费者更容易换新产品。比较两个对象的差异要用 In contrast / By contrast / On the other hand，或用 whereas 合并两句。On the contrary 的意思是“恰恰相反（前面的说法不对）”，只用于否定前面的说法后提出相反的事实，例如：Online reviews do not always make shoppers more careful. On the contrary, they often encourage impulse buying. 中文“相反”既可以表示“对比”，也可以表示“反驳”，所以学生常把 on the contrary 当作万能的“相反地”。正确：Older shoppers tend to remain loyal to brands they have trusted for decades. In contrast, younger consumers are far more willing to switch to a new product after reading a few positive online reviews.
focus: 近义对比让步词辨析（on the contrary / even if）

instruction: 下面五个句子来自同一个论证段落，顺序被打乱了。请根据连接词和内容把它们排成正确的顺序。
sentences: Schools should give students at least one hour of physical exercise every day.
First, regular exercise keeps young people fit and lowers their risk of obesity.
In addition, team sports teach students how to cooperate with others.
For example, football players must communicate and support each other in order to win a match.
For these reasons, daily exercise should be part of every school timetable.
hints: 先找出提出观点的主题句，以及总结全段的句子。
First 和 In addition 表示论点的先后；For example 要紧跟在它举例说明的那个论点后面。
想一想：踢足球要互相沟通，这个例子说明的是“保持健康”还是“学会合作”？
explanation: 议论段的常见结构：主题句（Schools should give ...）→ 第一个理由（First, ...）→ 第二个理由（In addition, ...）→ 例子（For example, ...，紧跟它说明的合作能力）→ 总结（For these reasons, ...）。For these reasons 回指前面所有理由，只能放在最后。中文段落多靠意合，学生常把例子随意放置；例子必须紧跟它支持的论点，否则读者会以为足球的例子在说明健康问题。
focus: 依据连接词与指代确定段落句序

instruction: 下面五个句子组成一个“让步—反驳”段落，顺序被打乱了。请根据连接词和指代关系排出正确的顺序。
sentences: Some people claim that printed newspapers will soon disappear completely.
Admittedly, online news is published far more quickly and is often free of charge.
However, this speed often comes at the cost of accuracy.
This is because news websites, competing to publish stories first, sometimes skip careful fact-checking.
Printed newspapers, in contrast, usually have several editors check each article before it is published.
hints: 先找出转述“有人认为……”的句子，它通常是让步—反驳段落的开头。
Admittedly 表示先承认对方的理由，However 引出作者的反驳；this speed 必须回指前文提到“快”的那一句。
This is because 要紧跟它所解释的那句话；in contrast 要放在描述网站做法的句子之后。
explanation: 这是典型的“让步—反驳”段落：对方观点（Some people claim ...）→ 让步（Admittedly, 网络新闻发布更快，而且常常免费）→ 转折反驳（However, this speed ...，this speed 回指“发布更快”）→ 解释原因（This is because ...）→ 对比（Printed newspapers, in contrast, ...）。Admittedly / It is true that 用于让步，后面必须用 However 等转折词把论证拉回作者的立场，否则读者会以为作者支持对方。中国学生写让步段时常漏掉这个转折，或者把让步内容写得比反驳还长。
focus: 依据连接词与指代确定段落句序

instruction: 下面五个句子组成一个描述因果链的段落，顺序被打乱了。请根据连接词和指代词排出正确的顺序。
sentences: Many cities have replaced parks and trees with concrete buildings and car parks.
Unlike vegetation, these hard surfaces absorb heat during the day and release it slowly at night.
As a result, urban areas can be several degrees warmer than the surrounding countryside.
This extra heat, in turn, increases the amount of electricity used for air conditioning in summer.
Since much of this electricity is still generated from fossil fuels, the result is even higher greenhouse gas emissions.
hints: 找出不依赖前文、可以独立开头的句子，其他句子都含有回指前文的词。
注意 these hard surfaces、This extra heat、this electricity 分别回指哪一句提到的内容。
这是一条因果链：每一句的结果都成为下一句的原因。
explanation: 因果链段落靠“指代 + 因果连接词”串起来：concrete buildings and car parks → these hard surfaces（回指）→ As a result（结果：城市更热）→ This extra heat, in turn（回指“更热”；in turn 表示这个结果又引发新的结果）→ this electricity（回指空调用电）→ 温室气体排放增加。in turn 意为“进而”，表示链条的下一环。学生写因果链时常只用 so 连接，缺少 this + 名词 的回指，读者就难以跟上逻辑。
focus: 依据连接词与指代确定段落句序

instruction: 下面五个句子组成一篇议论文的引言段，顺序被打乱了。请根据连接词和指代关系排出正确的顺序。
sentences: Across much of the world, the proportion of people over the age of sixty-five is rising rapidly.
This demographic shift is placing growing pressure on families and on the care workers who look after elderly people.
In response, some governments and technology companies have begun to invest in robots designed to help older people with daily tasks at home.
Critics, however, warn that such machines could leave vulnerable people even more isolated than before.
While such concerns deserve serious attention, this essay argues that care robots, if used to support rather than replace human carers, could greatly improve older people's quality of life.
hints: 引言通常从宽泛的背景开始，以作者的论点（thesis）结束。
This demographic shift、such machines、such concerns 都在回指前一句的内容，找出它们分别指向哪一句。
In response 回应的是一个“问题或压力”；however 引出的是对前一句所述做法的反对意见。
explanation: 引言的常见顺序：背景（老年人口比例上升）→ 带来的问题（This demographic shift 回指人口变化）→ 应对措施（In response, 投资护理机器人）→ 反对意见（Critics, however, ...，such machines 回指机器人）→ 作者立场（While such concerns ..., this essay argues ...，先让步再提出论点）。this/such + 名词 的回指和 In response / however / While 等连接词共同决定了唯一的顺序。注意 While 在这里表示让步（相当于 although），主句前不能再加 but，否则又会犯“虽然……但是……”式的重复错误。
focus: 依据连接词与指代确定段落句序

instruction: 选择最合适的一项填空，使第二句清楚地指代第一句描述的做法。
content: Many families now switch off the television during dinner. ______ gives parents and children more time to talk to each other.
options: It
Which
This habit
These habits
option_explanations: It 是单数，与 gives 一致，但读者通常会把 it 和前面最近的单数名词联系起来，这里就是 the television（或 dinner），句子像在说“电视让家人有更多时间交谈”，意思不通。要回指“吃饭时关电视”这整件事，应该用 this + 概括名词。
Which 是关系词，只能接在逗号后面修饰前文，不能在句号后单独开头；Which gives ... 是一个不完整的句子（句子碎片）。
正确。This habit 用“this + 概括名词”回指“吃饭时关掉电视”这一习惯，单数主语与 gives 一致，指代清楚。
These habits 是复数，与单数动词 gives 不一致；前一句也只描述了一种习惯。
hints: 先看空格后面的动词 gives：主语应该是单数还是复数？
如果填 It，读者会先把它和前一句里哪个单数名词联系起来？那样意思通吗？
选一个单数的、能直接告诉读者“指的是哪种做法”的名词短语。
explanation: 回指前一句描述的整件事（吃饭时关掉电视）时，用“this + 概括名词”最清楚，如 this habit / this practice / this rule，并且要与动词单复数一致：Many families now switch off the television during dinner. This habit gives parents and children more time to talk to each other. 如果用 It，读者通常会先把它和最近的单数名词 the television 联系起来，意思就变得奇怪；Which 是关系词，不能在句号后独立开头。中文说“这样能让家人有更多时间聊天”，“这样”可以泛指前文，所以学生容易直接写 It 或 Which。
focus: 模糊的 it / which 回指整句 → this + 概括名词

instruction: 选择正确的一项填空（注意指示词、名词和动词的单复数一致）。
content: Some cities now fine people who drop litter in the street. ______ encourage residents to keep public spaces clean.
options: These rules
This rule
This rules
These rule
option_explanations: 正确。These 与复数名词 rules 一致，复数主语 These rules 又与没有加 -s 的动词 encourage 一致；复数也符合前一句“一些城市”各自制定的规定。
This rule 本身搭配正确，但它是单数主语，动词应为 encourages，与 encourage 不一致。
This 只能修饰单数名词，不能接复数 rules（应为 this rule 或 these rules）。
These 必须修饰复数名词，不能接单数 rule（应为 these rules）。
hints: 空格后面的动词 encourage 没有加 -s，这说明主语是单数还是复数？
this 接单数名词，these 接复数名词；整个主语还必须和动词的单复数一致。
先排除指示词和名词本身就不搭配的两个选项，再根据动词在剩下的两个中做选择。
explanation: 指示词、名词、动词三者的单复数必须一致：this rule encourages / these rules encourage。中文“这”“这些”后面的名词没有单复数变化，动词也不变，所以学生常写出 this rules、these rule 或 This rule encourage 这样的错误。本题动词 encourage 是复数形式，前文又是多个城市的规定，因此是：Some cities now fine people who drop litter in the street. These rules encourage residents to keep public spaces clean.
focus: 指代短语的单复数与冠词一致

instruction: 选择能准确概括第一句内容的名词短语填空。
content: Over the past twenty years, the number of people living alone has risen sharply in many large cities. ______ has increased demand for small flats, but it has also made loneliness a growing concern for local governments.
options: This policy
This opinion
This solution
This trend
option_explanations: 前一句描述的是独居人数的变化，并没有提到任何政府或机构制定的政策，policy 类别不对。
opinion 指“观点”，而前一句陈述的是一个客观的变化，不是某人的看法。
solution 指“解决办法”，前一句既没有提出问题，也没有提出对策，类别不对。
正确。“过去二十年许多大城市独居人数急剧上升”是一种随时间发生的变化，trend 准确概括了这一内容，单数也与 has increased 一致。
hints: 第一句描述的是一项政策、一种观点、一个办法，还是一种随时间发生的变化？
概括名词要给前文内容“贴对标签”：做法用 policy / measure，问题用 problem / issue，变化则要用另一类词。
注意第一句中的 over the past twenty years 和 has risen sharply 这两个表达。
explanation: 四个选项都是单数，与 has 一致，区别在于概括名词的类别。前一句描述的是“过去二十年许多大城市独居人数急剧上升”，属于随时间发生的变化，应该用 trend（也可用 this increase / this rise / this growth）。学生常凭感觉选 policy、problem 等熟悉的词，没有先判断前文内容属于哪一类。正确句子：Over the past twenty years, the number of people living alone has risen sharply in many large cities. This trend has increased demand for small flats, but it has also made loneliness a growing concern for local governments.
focus: 概括名词类别准确

instruction: 作者想表达“健康网站上的信息往往不够可靠”。选择最恰当的一项填空，使读者不会把句意误解为“药剂师不够可靠”。
content: Many patients now get medical advice from health websites rather than from pharmacists, even though ______ are often less reliable.
options: they
these websites
the latter
those
option_explanations: they 前面有 patients、health websites、pharmacists 三个复数名词，离它最近的是 pharmacists，读者很可能理解为“药剂师往往不够可靠”，与作者的意思相反。
正确。these websites 用名词明确回指 health websites，读者不需要猜测，也不会误解为药剂师。
the latter 指“后者”，即两项中后提到的 pharmacists，句意变成“药剂师不够可靠”，与作者的意思相反。
those 单独作主语时和 they 一样不清楚指什么，读者仍然需要猜测是网站还是药剂师。
hints: 数一数空格前有几个复数名词，读者可能把空格理解为其中哪一个？
读者通常把代词理解为离它最近的、单复数一致的名词；可能的先行词不止一个时，应该换成名词。
先确认 the latter 实际指的是哪一项，再找一个不需要读者推理就能看懂的表达。
explanation: 代词必须有唯一、明确的先行词。本句中 they 前面有 patients、health websites、pharmacists 三个复数名词，最近的是 pharmacists，读者很容易误读为“药剂师不够可靠”。中文靠语境就能理解“它们”，所以学生常放心地用 they；英语读者则倾向于把代词和最近的同数名词联系起来。最稳妥的做法是重复或换用名词：Many patients now get medical advice from health websites rather than from pharmacists, even though these websites are often less reliable. 另外注意：the former 指前者，the latter 指后者，不能用反；本句即使用 the former，读者也要回头数一遍，不如直接用名词清楚。
focus: 多个可能先行词时改用名词

instruction: 选择正确的一项填空。
content: In several countries, universities now award credit for online courses that students complete on external platforms. ______ is likely to become more widespread as employers grow more accepting of digital qualifications.
options: Such approach
Such approaches
Such an approach
A such approach
option_explanations: approach 是单数可数名词，such 后面接单数可数名词时必须加不定冠词：such an approach。漏掉冠词是中国学生非常常见的错误。
Such approaches 是复数，与单数动词 is 不一致（应为 Such approaches are）。
正确。such + an + 单数可数名词，Such an approach 与单数动词 is 一致，并恰当地概括了“大学承认外部在线课程学分”这一做法。
语序错误：不定冠词要放在 such 后面，说 such an approach，不说 a such approach。
hints: 看空格后面的动词 is：主语应该是单数还是复数？
such 修饰单数可数名词时，名词前还需要一个成分，而且这个成分的位置是固定的。
比较三个单数选项：有没有冠词？冠词放在 such 的前面还是后面？
explanation: such 常用来概括前文提到的一类做法，但结构要正确：such + a/an + 单数可数名词（such an approach），such + 复数名词（such approaches），such + 不可数名词（such information）。中文“这种做法”没有冠词，学生常写成 such approach，或按“a + 形容词 + 名词”的习惯写成 a such approach。本题动词 is 是单数，因此是：Such an approach is likely to become more widespread as employers grow more accepting of digital qualifications.
focus: 指代短语的单复数与冠词一致

instruction: 选择最准确概括第一句内容的名词短语填空。
content: A recent study found that people who sleep fewer than six hours a night are more likely to catch colds. ______ suggests that sleep plays a more important role in the immune system than many people assume.
options: This finding
This opinion
This assumption
This recommendation
option_explanations: 正确。前一句介绍的是研究得出的结果（A recent study found that ...），finding 准确概括了这一内容，并且与 suggests 搭配自然。
opinion 指个人看法，而研究结果以数据为依据，不是观点，类别不对。
assumption 指未经证实的假设，而研究已经“发现”了这一结果；而且后半句说 than many people assume，用 assumption 会让逻辑混乱。
recommendation 指“建议”，前一句并没有提出任何建议（例如“应该多睡觉”），类别不对。
hints: 第一句以 A recent study found that ... 开头：它介绍的是一种观点、一个假设、一条建议，还是别的什么？
概括名词必须与前文内容的性质一致：个人看法、未经证实的假设、建议和研究得出的结果，各有不同的名词。
注意后半句的 than many people assume：如果选一个与 assume 意思相近的词，逻辑上会出什么问题？再看剩下的选项中哪个能描述研究“发现”的东西。
explanation: 概括名词要准确反映前文内容的性质：研究得出的结果用 finding / result / evidence，个人看法用 opinion / view，未经证实的想法用 assumption，建议用 recommendation。学生常只注意语法，随手选一个熟悉的名词，导致类别错误。前一句以 A recent study found that ... 开头，是研究结果，因此是：This finding suggests that sleep plays a more important role in the immune system than many people assume.
focus: 概括名词类别准确

instruction: 选择既能避免重复、又能让读者清楚知道所指对象的一项填空。
content: Shared electric scooters have spread rapidly through many European cities in recent years. Supporters claim that the scooters offer a cheap and clean way to travel short distances, whereas critics complain that ______ are often left blocking busy pavements.
options: shared electric scooters
they
these cars
these vehicles
option_explanations: 语法正确，但这是第三次提到滑板车，而且又用回了完整名称，属于机械重复，不符合题目“避免重复”的要求。
they 前面最近的复数名词是 critics（还有 supporters、distances），读者可能理解为“批评者被留在人行道上挡路”，指代不清。
滑板车不是汽车，cars 类别错误，读者还会以为文章转而谈论另一种交通工具。
正确。vehicles 是 scooters 的上位词，既避免了重复，又清楚地指向前面的滑板车，形成 shared electric scooters → the scooters → these vehicles 的词汇链。
hints: 空格指的是什么事物？这个事物在前文已经用什么方式出现过两次？
第二次以后提到同一事物，可以用代词、同义词或上位词，但所用的词既要类别正确，又不能被误认为指附近的其他名词。
逐个检查：哪个选项会被误认为指人，哪个把事物归错了类，哪个只是简单重复？
explanation: 词汇链是让段落连贯的重要手段：第一次用全称 shared electric scooters，之后用 the scooters、these vehicles 等。上位词（用 vehicles 概括 scooters）既能避免重复，又能保持指代清楚。用 they 则要特别小心：空格前最近的复数名词是 critics，读者会误解。中国学生常常要么不敢替换、一直重复全称，要么一律换成 they，造成歧义。正确句子：..., whereas critics complain that these vehicles are often left blocking busy pavements.
focus: 用代词、同义词、上位词避免机械重复

instruction: 选择最恰当的一项填空，使第二句清楚地指代第一句描述的整个变化。
content: Many banks are closing their branches in small towns and moving most of their services online. ______ can make everyday life harder for elderly residents who are not confident using the internet.
options: It
This shift
These branches
Which
option_explanations: 前一句没有能让 it 指代的单数名词（banks、branches、towns、services 都是复数），读者不知道 it 指什么。
正确。shift（转变）准确概括了“关闭小镇网点、把服务转到网上”这一整体变化，读者一看就知道第二句评价的是什么。
These branches 指的是银行网点本身，但给老年人带来困难的是“关闭网点、把服务转到网上”这一变化，而不是网点，指代对象错了。
Which 是关系词，只能接在逗号后面修饰前文，不能在句号后单独开头；Which can make ... 是一个不完整的句子（句子碎片）。
hints: 第二句评价的是前一句里的某个名词，还是前一句描述的整个变化？
关系词不能在句号后独立开头成句；代词需要一个具体的先行名词。
想一想：让老年人生活更困难的是“网点”本身，还是银行做出的改变？
explanation: 回指前一句描述的整个变化时，用“this + 概括名词”（this shift / this change）最清楚。It 需要一个具体的单数先行词；Which 是关系词，只能用在逗号之后（..., which can make ...），不能在句号后独立成句——中国学生常把“这就会……”译成以 Which 开头的独立句子，形成句子碎片；These branches 则指错了对象。正确句子：Many banks are closing their branches in small towns and moving most of their services online. This shift can make everyday life harder for elderly residents who are not confident using the internet.
focus: 模糊的 it / which 回指整句 → this + 概括名词

instruction: 第二句以 Which 开头，是一个不完整的句子（句子碎片），读者也不清楚 Which 指什么。请改写第二句：用“this / such + 恰当的概括名词”作主语，回指第一句描述的做法。只写出改写后的第二句。
content: Many parents read stories to their children every night before bed. Which improves the children's vocabulary and helps them sleep better.
accepted: This habit improves the children's vocabulary and helps them sleep better.
This bedtime routine improves the children's vocabulary and helps them sleep better.
This practice improves children's vocabulary and helps them sleep better.
criteria: 通过条件：1）去掉句首的 Which，改用 this / these / such + 概括名词作主语，名词要准确概括“父母每晚睡前给孩子读故事”这一做法（如 habit, routine, bedtime routine, practice, ritual）；不接受 thing、problem 等不准确的名词，也不接受 story / stories 等指错对象的名词；只写 This、That 或 It 不通过；2）主谓单复数一致（This habit improves / Such routines improve）；3）保留“提高孩子的词汇量”和“帮助他们睡得更好”两层意思；4）语法正确，是一个完整的句子。the children's 可改为 children's，也可以加 can、tends to 等限定语。如果学生把两句合并成 ..., which improves ...，这种合并本身语法正确，但没有按题目要求使用概括名词，判为不通过，并在反馈中说明这一点。
hints: 第二句有主句吗？Which 在英语里通常出现在什么位置？
Which 不能在句号后独立开头；要回指前一句的整个做法，可以用“this + 概括名词”作主语。
想一个表示“每天固定做的事”的名词放在 This 后面，再检查动词是否需要加 -s。
explanation: Which 是关系代词，只能接在逗号后面引导从句（..., which improves ...）；在句号后单独用 Which 开头，就成了没有主句的句子碎片，而且读者要自己猜 Which 指什么。中文“这能提高孩子的词汇量”里的“这”可以泛指前文，学生常直接译成 Which 或 It。更清楚的做法是用“this + 概括名词”说出指的是什么：This habit improves the children's vocabulary and helps them sleep better.（也可以用 This bedtime routine / This practice）。另一种改法是把两句合并：Many parents read stories to their children every night before bed, which improves the children's vocabulary and helps them sleep better. 本题练习的是第一种写法。
focus: 模糊的 it / which 回指整句 → this + 概括名词

instruction: 句中的 it 可能指 the city council、the bus station 或 the shopping centre。作者想说的是“购物中心变得热闹多了”。请改写整句，消除歧义。
content: The city council moved the bus station next to the shopping centre, and since then it has become much busier.
accepted: The city council moved the bus station next to the shopping centre, and since then the shopping centre has become much busier.
The city council moved the bus station next to the shopping centre, and since then the centre has become much busier.
Since the city council moved the bus station next to the shopping centre, the shopping centre has become much busier.
criteria: 通过条件：1）把 it 换成明确指购物中心的名词短语（the shopping centre / the centre / this shopping centre 等），或调整句子结构，使“变得更热闹”的主语明确是购物中心；2）读者不可能把它理解为公交站或市议会；3）保留“市议会把公交站搬到购物中心旁边”以及“此后变得热闹得多”的意思和时间关系；4）语法正确（since then 或 Since 从句之后用现在完成时）。
hints: 在 it 之前一共出现了几个单数名词？其中哪些都可能“变得更热闹”？
当代词前面有几个单复数一致的名词时，代词就不再可靠，应该改用名词。
让“变得更热闹”的主语一眼就能看出是哪个地方：可以用完整名称，也可以用它的简短形式。
explanation: 英语读者通常把代词理解为离它最近或作主语的、单复数一致的名词。本句 it 前面有 the city council、the bus station、the shopping centre 三个单数名词，其中公交站和购物中心都可能“变得更热闹”，句子有歧义。中文里“它”的指代常靠语境推断，学生因此觉得没有问题。修改方法是把代词换成名词：The city council moved the bus station next to the shopping centre, and since then the shopping centre has become much busier.（也可以用 the centre）
focus: 多个可能先行词时改用名词

instruction: 下面的短文把 food delivery riders 重复了四次。请改写全文，使 food delivery riders 这一完整说法只出现一次，其余用代词、同义词或“the / these + 名词”来衔接，并保留全部信息。
content: Food delivery riders now work in almost every large city. Food delivery riders often ride very fast in order to complete more orders, and food delivery riders are sometimes injured in accidents. For this reason, many customers believe that food delivery riders should receive better safety training.
accepted: Food delivery riders now work in almost every large city. They often ride very fast in order to complete more orders and are sometimes injured in accidents. For this reason, many customers believe that these workers should receive better safety training.

Food delivery riders now work in almost every large city, where they often ride very fast in order to complete more orders and are sometimes injured in accidents. For this reason, many customers believe that the riders should receive better safety training.

Food delivery riders now work in almost every large city. These workers often ride very fast in order to complete more orders, and they are sometimes injured in accidents. For this reason, many customers believe that such riders should receive better safety training.
criteria: 通过条件：1）food delivery riders 这一完整说法只出现一次（之后可以用 they、the riders、these workers、such riders 等）；2）至少使用两种不同的衔接手段（代词；同义词或上位词如 workers；“the / these / such + 名词”；合并分句省略主语；where 从句等）；3）最后一句 believe that 后面不能用 they 指骑手，因为前面有 customers，they 会被理解为顾客，必须用名词短语；4）保留全部信息：几乎每个大城市都有外卖骑手、他们为了多接单骑得很快、有时在事故中受伤、因此很多顾客认为他们应接受更好的安全培训；5）语法正确，每个代词都有清楚的先行词。
hints: 先找出 food delivery riders 出现的四个位置，想想哪几处可以换掉。
第二次以后提到同一群人，可以用代词、同义词或上位词，也可以合并两个分句来省略主语。
最后一句里 customers 也是复数名词：如果在 believe that 后面用 they，读者会以为谁应该接受培训？
explanation: 同一名词在短文中反复出现会显得生硬，衔接的基本方法是“第一次用全称，之后换用代词、同义词或上位词”：food delivery riders → they → these workers / the riders。但每次替换都要检查代词会不会指错：最后一句前面出现了 customers，如果写 many customers believe that they should receive ...，they 会被理解为顾客，所以这里必须用名词短语。示例：Food delivery riders now work in almost every large city. They often ride very fast in order to complete more orders and are sometimes injured in accidents. For this reason, many customers believe that these workers should receive better safety training. 中国学生写作时要么不敢替换、一个名词重复到底，要么一律换成 they，两种做法都会损害连贯性。
focus: 用代词、同义词、上位词避免机械重复

instruction: 第二句开头的指代短语不能准确概括第一句的内容。请改写第二句，换用一个准确的概括名词，其余内容保持不变。只写出改写后的第二句。
content: Opponents of sugar taxes argue that such levies do little to reduce obesity, since consumers simply get their sugar from other products instead. This problem, however, overlooks evidence from several countries where people's total sugar intake fell after a tax was introduced.
accepted: This argument, however, overlooks evidence from several countries where people's total sugar intake fell after a tax was introduced.
This view, however, overlooks evidence from several countries where people's total sugar intake fell after a tax was introduced.
This claim, however, overlooks evidence from several countries where people's total sugar intake fell after a tax was introduced.
criteria: 通过条件：1）把 This problem 换成能概括“反对者的观点 / 论点”的名词，如 argument、view、claim、position、objection、reasoning、line of argument；也可用 Such an argument，或复数 Such arguments / These claims，但用复数时动词必须改为 overlook；2）不接受 problem、issue、trend、measure、policy、situation、thing 等类别不符的名词，也不接受单独的 This 或 It；3）其余内容意思不变（保留 however 的转折、被忽视的证据、征税后人们的总糖摄入量下降）；4）语法正确。
hints: 看第一句的主要动词 argue：第一句介绍的是一个问题、一项措施，还是某些人的一种说法？
概括名词必须与前文内容属于同一类别，还要能与后面的谓语 overlooks evidence 搭配：“问题”不会“忽视证据”。
能“忽视证据”的只能是某种主张或推理，换一个指这类内容的名词。
explanation: 概括名词要准确说明前文内容的类别。第一句用 argue 介绍反对者的观点，所以应称为 this argument / this view / this claim；problem 指“问题”，既不符合前文的性质，也不能与 overlooks evidence 搭配（问题不会忽视证据）。学生常把 problem 当作万能的概括名词，看到前文有负面内容就写 This problem。正确句子：This argument, however, overlooks evidence from several countries where people's total sugar intake fell after a tax was introduced.（总糖摄入量下降，说明消费者并没有简单地从其他食品中补回糖分，正好反驳了对方的理由。）另外，第一句用 such levies 回指 sugar taxes，也是一种很好的同义替换。
focus: 概括名词类别准确

instruction: 把下列句子排成一个连贯的段落。提示：注意每个指代词（this、it、they 等）指的是前面哪一句中的内容。
sentences: Many schools have decided to stop giving homework to younger pupils.
This decision is usually made to give children more time to play and rest.
However, it can leave some parents unsure about how their children are progressing.
Without regular homework, they have fewer chances to see what their children are learning in class.
hints: 先找出没有任何指代词、可以独立开头的句子。
带“this + 名词”、it、they 的句子必须排在它们所指的内容后面；However 表示与前一句形成对比。
they 指的是一群有自己孩子的人，那么紧挨在它前面的一句必须提到谁？
explanation: 排序依据：第 1 句提出话题（很多学校决定不再给低年级学生布置作业），没有任何指代词，适合开头；第 2 句的 This decision 把第 1 句的 have decided 概括为“这一决定”，必须紧跟第 1 句；第 3 句的 However 与第 2 句给出的理由（让孩子有更多时间玩和休息）形成转折，it 指 this decision；第 4 句的 they 指第 3 句中的 some parents（they 不可能指 children，因为后面说的是 their children）。每个指代词都必须排在它所指的内容之后，这就是“已知信息在前、新信息在后”的衔接原则。中国学生排序时常只看内容大意，而忽略指代词提供的线索。
focus: 根据指代线索确定句序

instruction: 把下列句子排成一个连贯的段落。
sentences: Many people now replace their smartphones every year or two, even when their old phones still work perfectly well.
This habit comes at a hidden cost to the environment.
Making a single phone, for example, requires metals such as cobalt, which are often mined in ways that pollute rivers and destroy forests.
On top of this damage, most old phones end up forgotten in drawers or buried in landfill sites rather than being recycled.
Such waste could be greatly reduced if manufacturers made phones that were easier to repair and upgrade.
hints: 哪一句没有任何指代词或连接词，能独立地引出话题？
for example 要放在它所举例说明的概括性说法之后；“this / such + 名词”要放在它所概括的内容之后。
This habit、this damage 和 Such waste 分别概括的是哪一句的内容？
explanation: 排序依据：第 1 句描述现象（很多人一两年就换一部手机，即使旧手机还能用），没有指代词，是开头；第 2 句用 This habit 概括这一现象，并提出观点“对环境有隐性代价”；第 3 句用 for example 举例说明这一代价（制造手机需要开采钴等金属，污染河流、破坏森林）；第 4 句的 this damage 回指第 3 句的环境破坏，并用 On top of 补充第二个代价（旧手机被闲置或填埋，而不是被回收）；第 5 句的 Such waste 概括第 4 句的浪费并提出解决办法。“this / such + 概括名词”总是指向前文，所以它们所在的句子一定排在被概括的内容之后。
focus: 根据指代线索确定句序

instruction: 下面五个句子是一篇议论文的引言，请把它们排成正确的顺序。
sentences: Over the past few decades, space exploration has developed rapidly.
Today, this field involves not only national space agencies but also private companies, some of which are planning crewed missions to the Moon and even to Mars.
However, such missions are extremely expensive, often costing billions of dollars.
For this reason, some people argue that the money would be better spent on problems closer to home, such as poverty and disease.
This essay will argue that, although this view is understandable, space research brings practical benefits that justify its cost.
hints: 引言通常从最宽泛的背景开始，到作者的观点结束。
this field、such missions、the money、this view 都在回指前文：先弄清它们各自指什么。
this view 指的是谁的什么看法？这种看法是在哪一句中提出的？
explanation: 议论文引言的常见结构是“背景 → 具体情况 → 争议 → 作者观点”。第 1 句给出宽泛背景（太空探索发展迅速）；第 2 句的 this field 回指 space exploration，并提到私营公司正在计划载人登月、登火星的任务；第 3 句的 such missions 概括第 2 句的这些任务，并用 However 引出“花费巨大”；第 4 句的 For this reason 承接“昂贵”，the money 指第 3 句的数十亿美元；第 5 句是论点句，this view 回指第 4 句中一些人的看法。指代词和“this / such + 名词”就像箭头，指向前一句的内容，可以帮助确定唯一的顺序。
focus: 根据指代线索确定句序

instruction: 把下列六个句子排成一个连贯的段落。
sentences: Advertisers have long recognised that children are a valuable market.
Not only do children spend their own pocket money, but they also influence many of the purchases their parents make.
This influence has grown considerably with the rise of video-sharing platforms, where advertisements are often disguised as entertainment.
Because such content rarely looks like traditional advertising, young viewers often fail to realise that they are being persuaded to buy something.
To protect them from such persuasion, several countries now require sponsored videos to be clearly labelled.
Whether these labels actually work, however, remains open to debate, since many younger children cannot read them.
hints: 找出唯一一个不依赖前文、能概括全段话题的句子。
把前一句的动词变成“this + 名词”来回指（名词化回指），以及“such + 名词”，都要求紧跟在它们所概括的内容之后。
This influence 中的 influence 在哪一句里以动词形式出现过？such persuasion 又呼应哪一句中的哪个词？
explanation: 排序线索：第 1 句提出总话题（儿童是有价值的市场）；第 2 句用 Not only ... but also 解释原因，其中的动词 influence 在第 3 句被名词化为 This influence，这是学术写作中常用的回指方式；第 3 句引出视频平台上伪装成娱乐内容的广告，第 4 句的 such content 回指这种广告；第 4 句提到孩子在不知不觉中被说服（being persuaded），第 5 句的 such persuasion 和 them 分别回指这一点和 young viewers；第 6 句的 these labels 回指第 5 句的标注要求，however 引出质疑。名词化回指（influence → this influence，persuaded → such persuasion）是高分作文常见的衔接手段，中国学生较少使用，往往只会用 it 或 this。
focus: 根据指代线索确定句序

instruction: 根据主题句，下面哪一句与本段中心无关，应该从段落中删除？
content: Topic sentence: Keeping a pet can help older people stay healthy.
options: Walking a dog every day gives older people regular exercise.
Stroking a cat or a dog can lower a person's blood pressure.
People have kept dogs as companions for thousands of years.
Older pet owners often feel less lonely and less stressed.
option_explanations: 每天遛狗让老人有规律地运动，直接说明养宠物有益健康，支持主题句。
抚摸宠物能降低血压，是具体的健康好处，支持主题句。
正确（应删除）。人类养狗的历史只是与“宠物”话题沾边的背景知识，不能说明养宠物让老人更健康。
孤独感和压力减轻属于心理健康，同样支持“帮助老人保持健康”这一观点。
hints: 先圈出主题句的关键词：本段要证明的是“宠物”本身，还是宠物给老人带来的某种结果？
段落一致性要求每句话都在证明主题句的中心观点，只和话题有关是不够的。
把每个选项放在主题句后面，问一句“这对老人的健康有什么帮助？”，答不上来的就是要删的。
explanation: 主题句的 controlling idea 是 help older people stay healthy（帮助老人保持健康）。遛狗运动、降低血压、减少孤独和压力，都是健康方面的好处。People have kept dogs as companions for thousands of years. 讲的是养狗的历史，只与“宠物”这个话题有关，属于背景知识。中国学生常把自己知道的“相关知识”写进段落，以为能让内容更丰富，但它不能证明论点，反而打断论证，应删除。如需补充，可换成真正支持中心的句子，如 Caring for a pet also gives older people a reason to stay active.
focus: 与话题沾边的背景知识或题外话

instruction: 选出最适合作为本段结尾句的一项（保持段落一致性）。
content: Children should start learning a second language at primary school. Young children copy new sounds easily, so they often develop a more natural accent than adults. They are also less afraid of making mistakes when they speak. ______
options: Language is a bridge between people, so let us all learn languages and love the world!
Starting early therefore gives children a clear advantage in pronunciation and confidence.
However, many primary schools do not have enough qualified language teachers.
English is now spoken as a first or second language in many countries.
option_explanations: 空洞的口号。“语言是桥梁、让我们热爱世界”没有回扣“早学外语的好处（口音、自信）”，是中国学生常见的“升华”式结尾。
正确。用 therefore 总结前两句的两个理由（发音自然、敢于开口），回扣主题句“应从小学开始学外语”。
这是反方观点（师资不足），放在段末又没有回应，会削弱本段论证并偏离中心。
英语的使用范围是背景知识，既没有总结本段，也不能证明“应从小学开始学”。
hints: 先找出前两句支持句分别讲了早学外语的哪两个好处。
好的结尾句应回扣主题句、概括本段理由，而不是引入新话题、反方观点或口号。
看看哪个选项能同时概括前面两个理由。
explanation: 结尾句（concluding sentence）也必须服从段落一致性：它应回扣主题句的中心观点，概括本段理由。本段的理由是“口音更自然”和“不怕犯错”，Starting early therefore gives children a clear advantage in pronunciation and confidence. 正好总结了这两点。中国学生受中文作文“升华主题”的习惯影响，常在段末写 Language is a bridge... let us all... 之类的口号；英语议论文中这类句子空洞，与本段论证脱节。反方观点（师资不足）和背景知识（英语的使用范围）也都不能作为本段结尾。
focus: 段末口号或偏离中心的结尾句

instruction: 阅读下面的段落，选出对它最准确的评价。
content: Buying second-hand clothes is a good way to save money. In charity shops, a used jacket often costs less than a quarter of its original price. Many websites also sell nearly new clothes at very low prices. In addition, buying second-hand clothes reduces the amount of clothing that ends up in landfill. For a student on a tight budget, this means that a whole winter wardrobe can cost the same as one new coat.
options: 段落是一致的：每一句都在讲买二手衣服的好处。
关于网站的那一句偏离主题，因为主题句只谈实体店。
最后一句只举了学生的例子，范围太窄，应删除。
关于垃圾填埋的那一句讲的是环保，不是省钱，应删除或移到别段。
option_explanations: “都是好处”只是话题层面的相关。主题句的 controlling idea 是“省钱”，减少垃圾填埋属于另一个好处。
主题句并没有限定实体店；网上低价买近乎全新的衣服同样说明能省钱，支持主题句。
学生预算紧张的例子把“省钱”具体化，是很好的收束句，支持主题句。
正确。减少垃圾填埋是环保方面的好处，虽然支持“应该买二手衣服”的整体立场，却不支持本段“省钱”这一中心，应删除或放到讲环保的段落。
hints: 主题句说买二手衣服是一种做什么的好方法？把这个关键词圈出来。
一句话即使也在说二手衣服的“好处”，如果不是主题句说的那种好处，也会破坏一致性。
注意最后一句的 this 应该指代什么，再找出让 this 指代不清的那一句。
explanation: 本段的中心是 save money（省钱）：慈善店价格低、网站价格低、学生用一件新外套的钱买齐冬装，都在证明这一点。In addition, buying second-hand clothes reduces the amount of clothing that ends up in landfill. 讲的是环保，是支持全文立场的另一个分论点。中国学生常把想到的所有好处塞进同一段，觉得“都支持我的观点”就没问题；但英语段落要求紧扣本段的 controlling idea。删除这句后，this means... 能直接承接前面的价格信息，段落更连贯；环保好处可以单独写一段。
focus: 另一分论点混入本段

instruction: 阅读段落，找出与主题句不一致、应该删除的句子。
content: (1) Cycling to work has many benefits. (2) Cyclists get exercise every day without going to a gym. (3) Riding a bike in heavy rain is very unpleasant. (4) Cyclists do not have to pay for petrol or parking. (5) They also rarely get stuck in traffic jams.
options: Sentence (2)
Sentence (3)
Sentence (4)
Sentence (5)
option_explanations: (2) 不用去健身房也能每天锻炼，是骑车上班的好处，支持主题句。
正确。(3) 讲雨天骑车很难受，是骑车的缺点，与主题句“好处很多”方向相反，又没有任何回应，应删除。
(4) 省下油费和停车费，是骑车上班的经济好处，支持主题句。
(5) 很少堵车、节省时间，是另一个好处，用 also 自然衔接，支持主题句。
hints: 主题句说骑车上班有什么？先确定本段的方向。
一段中突然出现与主题句方向相反、而作者又没有回应的观点，就会破坏一致性。
逐句判断：这句话说的是好处，还是别的？
explanation: 主题句的 controlling idea 是 many benefits（很多好处）。(2)(4)(5) 分别讲锻炼、省钱、不堵车，都是好处；(3) Riding a bike in heavy rain is very unpleasant. 却讲缺点。中国学生常“想到什么写什么”，在讲优点的段落里顺手加一句缺点，以为显得全面，其实打乱了段落方向。缺点应放在单独的段落；如果一定要在本段提到，必须写成让步后反驳，例如 Although cycling in heavy rain can be unpleasant, good waterproof clothing solves most of the problem.
focus: 混入未处理的相反观点

instruction: 阅读下面的段落，选出对它最准确的评价。
content: Artificial intelligence can help doctors detect diseases at an earlier stage. Computer programs trained on thousands of X-ray images can spot tiny signs of lung cancer that a tired doctor might miss. The idea of thinking machines has appeared in science fiction for more than a century. Other systems can identify patients at high risk of heart disease by analysing their medical records. Because these conditions are detected sooner, patients can begin treatment when it is most likely to succeed.
options: 关于科幻小说的那一句是背景知识，不能证明本段观点，应删除。
关于 X 光片的那一句太技术化，不适合放进议论文。
最后一句讲治疗，超出了“诊断”的范围，属于跑题。
段落是一致的：每一句都与人工智能有关。
option_explanations: 正确。主题句讲人工智能帮助医生“更早发现疾病”，“思考机器”在科幻小说中出现的历史与此无关，还挡住了 X 光片程序与 Other systems 之间的衔接。
用 X 光片识别早期肺癌迹象是支持主题句的具体例子；具体、可信的例子正是议论文需要的。
最后一句说明“发现得早 → 治疗更有效”，解释了早期诊断的意义，是对主题句的自然收束，没有跑题。
只与“人工智能”这一话题相关还不够；科幻小说那一句并不支持“帮助早期诊断”这一观点。
hints: 先确定主题句的 controlling idea：是“人工智能”本身，还是它在医疗中的某种作用？
逐句问：这句话能证明医生借助人工智能更早发现疾病吗？
留意 Other systems 中的 Other 是在和前面哪种程序对比，中间有没有句子挡住了这种衔接。
explanation: 本段的中心是 help doctors detect diseases at an earlier stage。X 光片识别肺癌、病历分析找出心脏病高风险患者、早发现早治疗，构成了完整的论证。The idea of thinking machines has appeared in science fiction for more than a century. 只是关于人工智能的背景知识，与“早期诊断”无关。中国学生写科技类话题时常先介绍“历史/定义”，但在主体段中这类句子不提供论据，会破坏一致性，应删除。删除后，Other systems... 直接承接 Computer programs trained on thousands of X-ray images...，衔接更自然。
focus: 与话题沾边的背景知识或题外话

instruction: 阅读下面的段落，选出对它最准确的评价。
content: Tourism can bring real economic benefits to small coastal towns. Visitors spend money in local hotels, restaurants and shops, which creates jobs for residents. Some families also earn extra income by renting out rooms or selling handmade souvenirs. Unfortunately, large crowds of tourists often leave rubbish on the beaches. Furthermore, the taxes paid by tourism businesses can be used to improve local roads and schools.
options: 段落是一致的：每一句都与海边小镇的旅游业有关。
最后一句谈道路和学校，属于另一个话题，应删除。
关于海滩垃圾的那一句引入了相反观点，又没有回应，偏离了本段中心。
段落的主要问题是缺少具体数据，而不是一致性。
option_explanations: 话题相同不等于观点一致。主题句的观点是“经济好处”，海滩垃圾讲的是旅游的负面影响。
旅游企业缴纳的税收用于改善道路和学校，仍然是旅游带来的经济好处，支持主题句。
正确。Unfortunately 之后转向旅游的缺点（环境问题），与“经济好处”方向相反，作者又没有反驳或回应，打断了“游客消费 → 居民增收 → 税收改善设施”的论证链。
增加数据可以让论证更有说服力，但这不是本段最突出的问题；即使加了数据，垃圾那一句仍然偏题。
hints: 先确定主题句的 controlling idea：旅游给小镇带来的是哪一方面的影响？
一段中突然出现与主题句方向相反、又没有被回应的观点，会破坏一致性；话题相同并不够。
留意段中表示态度转折的词，再问：去掉它所在的句子，前后关于“钱”的内容能否直接连上？
explanation: 本段的中心是 economic benefits。游客消费创造就业、家庭出租房间增收、税收用于改善道路和学校，都在证明这一点。Unfortunately, large crowds of tourists often leave rubbish on the beaches. 突然转向环境问题，而且只抛出、不处理。中国学生常认为“提一下缺点显得客观”，但在英语议论文中，相反观点要么放到单独的段落，要么以“让步 + 反驳”的形式出现并服务于本段中心，例如 Although large crowds can leave rubbish on the beaches, the income they bring allows towns to pay for regular cleaning. 否则就会破坏段落一致性。删除这一句后，Furthermore 就能直接承接前面关于居民收入的内容。
focus: 混入未处理的相反观点

instruction: 下面四个句子都支持“实行四天工作制”。根据主题句，哪一句放进本段会破坏段落一致性？
content: Topic sentence: A four-day working week could make employees more productive.
options: When people know that a longer weekend is coming, they tend to waste less time during working hours.
Meetings become shorter and more focused, since there is less time available for them.
Employees would have an extra day each week to spend with their families and friends.
In one trial, staff completed as much work in four days as they had previously done in five.
option_explanations: 员工知道周末更长，工作时就更少浪费时间，直接说明了生产率提高，支持主题句。
会议因时间有限而变得更短、更集中，说明工作效率提高，支持主题句。
正确（不应放进本段）。多陪家人朋友是四天工作制的另一个好处（生活质量），虽然支持全文立场，却不能证明“员工生产率更高”，应放到别的段落。
四天完成以前五天的工作量，是“生产率提高”的直接证据，支持主题句。
hints: 主题句要证明的不是笼统的“四天工作制有好处”，而是哪一个具体的好处？
四个选项都支持四天工作制；但支持全文立场，不等于支持本段的 controlling idea。
对每个选项问：这句话能说明员工“工作效率提高”了吗？
explanation: 段落一致性要求紧扣主题句的 controlling idea——这里是 more productive（生产率更高），而不是笼统的“四天工作制有好处”。少浪费时间、会议更高效、试点中四天完成五天的工作量，都在证明生产率。Employees would have an extra day each week to spend with their families and friends. 讲的是员工的生活质量，是另一个分论点：它同样支持实行四天工作制，但应放在讨论工作与生活平衡的段落。中国学生常只问“这句是否支持我的立场”，而忘了问“这句是否支持本段主题句”。
focus: 另一分论点混入本段

instruction: 阅读下面的段落，选出对它最准确的评价。
content: Secondary schools should teach students how to manage money. Many young people leave school without knowing how to plan a budget or how interest on a loan works. As a result, some quickly fall into debt when they start using credit cards or borrowing money for the first time. Lessons in basic money management would prepare students to avoid such mistakes. In a word, money is not everything, and happiness is the most important thing in life.
options: 第二句关于年轻人不会做预算、不懂贷款利息的说法缺少证据，应删除。
最后一句是空洞的人生道理，没有回扣“学校应该教理财”的中心。
第四句谈理财课的作用，偏离了本段关于年轻人负债的中心。
段落是一致的：最后一句升华了主题，使结尾更有力。
option_explanations: 第二句是本段的核心理由（很多年轻人离校时不会做预算、不懂贷款利息），删除它会使论证失去基础。缺少证据可以补充，但这不是一致性问题。
正确。“钱不是一切，幸福才是人生最重要的事”是空泛的人生道理，既没有总结“为什么学校应该教理财”，还削弱了本段强调理财重要性的论证；In a word 后面也没有真正概括前文。
第四句说明理财课能帮助学生避免这类错误，正是在说明学校为什么应该开这门课，支持主题句；本段的中心是“学校应教理财”，而不只是“年轻人负债”。
这正是中国学生常见的误区：英语议论文的结尾句应回扣本段观点，而不是用宏大道理“升华”。
hints: 先确定主题句的观点，再特别检查最后一句。
结尾句应总结本段理由并回扣主题句，而不是转向泛泛的人生道理。
问自己：只读最后一句，读者能否知道作者主张学校应该做什么？
explanation: 本段的论证链是：很多年轻人离校时不会做预算、不懂利息 → 初次使用信用卡或借钱时容易负债 → 理财课能帮助他们避免这类错误，所以学校应该教理财。最后一句 In a word, money is not everything, and happiness is the most important thing in life. 是空洞的人生道理，既没有提到学校或理财课，也没有回扣主题句，甚至削弱了本段强调理财重要性的论证。这种结尾源于中文作文“升华主题”的习惯。可改为 For these reasons, basic money management should be a compulsory part of the secondary school curriculum.
focus: 段末口号或偏离中心的结尾句

instruction: 阅读段落。为了恢复段落一致性，应删除哪些句子？
content: (1) Volunteering helps teenagers develop skills that will be useful in their future careers. (2) For example, organising a charity event teaches them how to plan ahead and work in a team. (3) Volunteers in charity shops also learn to handle money and deal politely with customers. (4) Many charity shops send their profits to local hospitals. (5) Hospitals in many areas are short of modern equipment. (6) As a result, patients sometimes have to wait months for an operation.
options: Sentence (4) only
Sentences (4), (5) and (6)
Sentences (5) and (6)
Sentence (6) only
option_explanations: 只删 (4) 不够：(5)(6) 讲医院设备不足和手术等待时间，同样与“青少年培养技能”无关。
正确。从 (4) 开始，段落由“慈善商店”滑向“医院”，再滑向“手术等待”，每句只和上一句有联系，却都不再证明主题句，应全部删除。
(4) 讲慈善商店把利润交给医院，也没有说明青少年学到了什么技能，同样偏离主题；只删 (5)(6) 会留下跑题句。
只删最后一句不够：(4)(5) 同样偏离了“培养技能”这一中心。
hints: 先找出主题句的 controlling idea，然后逐句对照它检查，而不只是看相邻两句是否连贯。
“链式偏题”是指每句话都和上一句有关，但整体越走越远；一旦开始偏离，后面的句子通常也要一起处理。
找到第一句不再讲“青少年学到什么”的句子，再看它后面的句子有没有回到主题。
explanation: 主题句的中心是“志愿服务帮助青少年培养对未来职业有用的技能”。(2)(3) 分别举了策划活动、团队合作、管钱和接待顾客的例子。从 (4) 开始，作者顺着“慈善商店 → 利润给医院 → 医院缺设备 → 病人等手术”一路写下去，每句都与前一句相关，但已完全离开主题。这是中国学生常见的“链式偏题”（想到哪写到哪），检查时要拿每一句和主题句比，而不是只和上一句比。删除 (4)(5)(6) 后，可补充一个关于技能的例子，如 Helping at a food bank can also teach teenagers to stay calm under pressure.
focus: 链式偏题（逐句联想越写越远）

instruction: 阅读下面的段落，选出对它最准确的评价。
content: Free entry encourages more people to visit museums. When there is no ticket price, families on low incomes can visit as often as they like. Students can also drop in for an hour after school instead of saving up for an expensive day out. Many national museums are housed in beautiful old buildings that were once royal palaces. In countries that have removed entrance fees, visitor numbers have often risen sharply, especially among young people.
options: 第三句关于学生放学后参观的内容太随意，不适合议论文。
最后一句提到其他国家，偏离了本段的中心。
段落缺少主题句，读者无法判断本段要证明什么。
关于王宫建筑的那一句是背景知识，与免费入场无关。
option_explanations: 学生放学后能随时进去看一小时，是“免费吸引更多人参观”的具体例子，支持主题句；表达口语化不等于偏题。
取消门票后参观人数大幅上升，正是支持主题句的证据，并没有偏离中心。
第一句 Free entry encourages more people to visit museums. 就是清楚的主题句。
正确。博物馆建筑曾是王宫，只是与“博物馆”话题有关的背景知识，不能说明免费入场吸引了更多参观者，应删除。
hints: 先找到主题句，弄清本段要证明的因果关系是什么。
逐句问：这句话能说明“免费”让更多人来参观吗？
注意哪一句的内容即使门票照收也同样成立。
explanation: 本段的中心是“免费入场让更多人参观博物馆”：低收入家庭可以常去、学生可以放学后随时进去、取消门票的国家参观人数上升，都在证明这一点。Many national museums are housed in beautiful old buildings that were once royal palaces. 无论收不收门票都成立，与论点无关，属于背景知识。中国学生写文化类话题时常喜欢介绍历史或建筑，以显示知识面，但这类内容放进论证段会破坏一致性。删除后，最后一句的证据能直接承接前面两个例子。
focus: 与话题沾边的背景知识或题外话

instruction: 阅读段落，找出破坏段落一致性、应该删除的句子。
content: (1) Improving street lighting can significantly reduce crime in residential areas. (2) Well-lit streets increase the chance that offenders will be seen and recognised, which discourages burglary and vandalism. (3) Admittedly, lighting alone cannot remove the social causes of crime; nevertheless, it reduces the opportunities on which many offenders rely. (4) Bright lights at night can also disturb residents' sleep and confuse migrating birds. (5) Several studies of urban neighbourhoods have recorded noticeable falls in reported crime after lighting was upgraded.
options: Sentence (2)
Sentence (3)
Sentence (4)
Sentence (5)
option_explanations: (2) 说明照明让犯罪者更容易被看见和认出，从而减少入室盗窃和破坏行为，是主题句的核心理由。
