There is considerable debate about whether students should delay university for a year to gain experience of work or travel, or move directly from school to higher education.
criteria: 合格条件：(1) 写 1 句（最多 2 句）；(2) 同时包含两种观点：上大学前先用一年时间工作或旅行 vs. 中学毕业后直接上大学；(3) 不照抄题目：不能出现与题目连续相同的长片段（如 students should take a year off to work or travel），要换用不同的词或句式；保留 university、students 等关键词可以接受；(4) 不改变原意：不能把 some people 绝对化为 everyone，不能只写一方，也不能把话题换成“是否应该上大学”等；(5) 不表明自己的立场（不出现 I think / I believe 等）；(6) 语法正确、表达自然。
hints: 先找出题目中的两种观点分别是什么。
改写要换词、换句式，但保留原意和双方观点；可以考虑 Opinion is divided on whether... 或 While some argue that..., others believe that... 这类结构。
检查：有没有连续照抄题目中的长片段？有没有漏掉其中一方？有没有写 I think？
explanation: 背景句改写题目时要做到：①换词（take a year off → spend a year working or travelling / a gap year；go straight to university → begin their degrees as soon as they leave school）；②换句式（Some people think... Others believe... → Opinion is divided on whether... or ...）；③保留双方观点和原意。中国学生常照抄题目，是因为担心改写后意思不准确，但雅思中照抄的部分不计入字数。示例：Opinion is divided on whether young people should spend a year working or travelling before university, or begin their degrees as soon as they leave school.
focus: 背景句照抄或歪曲题目

instruction: 下面的 hook 从“远古”讲起，离题目太远。请为这道题重写一个 hook（只写一句），直接引向题目的具体焦点。
content:
Prompt: Some people believe that robots and artificial intelligence will replace most teachers in the future. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Weak hook: Since ancient times, human beings have invented new tools to make their lives easier.
accepted: From apps that mark homework to chatbots that answer students' questions, artificial intelligence is already finding its way into the classroom.
As AI tutors learn to explain maths problems and correct essays within seconds, some people wonder whether human teachers will still be needed.
Many students today ask a chatbot for help with their homework before they ask their teacher.
criteria: 合格条件：(1) 只写一句；(2) 必须同时涉及“技术”（AI、机器人、学习软件、聊天机器人等）和“教学/学习/教师”，直接引向“AI 是否会取代教师”这一焦点；(3) 不从远古、人类历史或“科技很重要”这类宽泛陈述讲起，不使用 With the development of... 等套话；(4) 不编造精确的统计数字；(5) 不必表明立场；(6) 语法正确、表达自然。
hints: 题目真正讨论的是什么？是“人类发明工具”，还是机器人和人工智能会不会取代教师？
好的 hook 要从一个与题目焦点直接相关的当下现象写起，而不是从人类历史讲起。
想想现在学生和老师是怎样使用 AI 或学习软件的，用一句话描述这个现象。
explanation: “自古以来”式开头（Since ancient times...）与汉语作文“自古以来”“纵观历史”的开头习惯有关，学生觉得这样显得有深度，但它离题目焦点（AI 是否会取代教师）太远，读者读完第一句仍不知道文章要讨论什么。好的 hook 应从当下与题目直接相关的现象写起，例如：From apps that mark homework to chatbots that answer students' questions, artificial intelligence is already finding its way into the classroom.
focus: hook 过宽或离题（定义式、自古以来）

instruction: 下面的开头段已经写好了 hook 和背景句。请为它写 thesis（开头段最后一句，最多两句）：既要表明会讨论双方，又要给出明确的个人立场（可以是有条件的立场），并简要点出主要理由，不展开例子。
content:
Prompt: Some people think that parents should strictly limit the time their children spend playing video games. Others believe that children should be allowed to decide for themselves. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Hook and background: Video games have become one of the most popular forms of entertainment for children, often filling hours of their free time. While some parents set firm daily limits, others feel that children should learn to manage their own screen time.
accepted: This essay will examine both views before arguing that parents should set clear limits for younger children but gradually give teenagers more freedom, since self-control is a skill that has to be learned.
Although allowing children to decide can teach them responsibility, I believe that parents should limit gaming time, because most children lack the self-control to protect their sleep and schoolwork.
After considering both positions, this essay will argue that firm limits are necessary, as they protect children's health and studies at an age when self-discipline is still developing.
criteria: 合格条件：(1) 写 1–2 句；(2) 表明会讨论双方：可以用 This essay will examine both views... 等预告，也可以用 Although/While 先承认另一方的合理之处；(3) 立场明确：明确支持家长严格限制、支持孩子自己决定，或给出具体的有条件立场（如低龄儿童由家长限制、青少年逐步自主）；不能只写“双方都有道理”“视情况而定”而不说明具体条件；(4) 至少简要给出一个主要理由；(5) 不写具体例子、个人经历或数据；(6) 不重复已给出的 hook 和背景句；(7) 语法正确、表达自然。
hints: 这个题型要求你做两件事：讨论双方，并给出自己的观点。你的 thesis 要同时体现这两点。
可以用 This essay will examine both views before arguing that... 或 Although..., I believe that... 等结构；立场可以有条件，但条件必须具体。
检查：你的句子有没有写成“双方都有道理”？有没有给出一个简短的理由？有没有把具体例子写进来？
explanation: 双方观点题的 thesis = 讨论双方的信号 + 明确立场 + 简要理由。常见错误是写成“两种观点各有道理”或“取决于孩子”却不说明具体条件。有条件的立场是允许的，但条件必须具体（例如按年龄区分）。中国学生受“一分为二”写作习惯的影响，常用骑墙句代替观点。示例：This essay will examine both views before arguing that parents should set clear limits for younger children but gradually give teenagers more freedom, since self-control is a skill that has to be learned.
focus: thesis 立场模糊或不回应题型

instruction: 下面是一篇作文结尾段的第一句，开头缺少一个短语。选出最合适的一项。
content: Conclusion (first sentence): ______, all children should learn to swim at primary school, because swimming is both a life-saving skill and a healthy form of exercise.
options: At last
Last but not least
To conclude
At the end
option_explanations: At last 的意思是“（经过等待）终于”，如 At last the bus arrived.，不能用来引出全文总结。这是把中文“最后”直译造成的典型错误。
Last but not least 用来引出列举中的“最后一点（同样重要）”，读者会以为后面还有一个新论点。它只适合放在最后一个主体段开头，不适合结尾段。
正确。To conclude 是标准的结尾信号词，告诉读者下面是全文的总结和立场重申。
At the end 表示时间或位置上的“末尾”，通常要接 of 说明是什么的末尾（如 at the end of the film）；它不能表示“总之”。把“最后”直译成 At the end 放在结尾段开头是中式错误。
hints: 想一想这个短语要告诉读者什么：后面是“又一个理由”，还是“全文的总结”？
有几个短语中文都可以译成“最后”，但英文意思不同：有的表示“终于”，有的表示“列举的最后一项”，有的只表示某件事的“末尾”。
排除表示“等了很久终于……”、引出“最后一个要点”以及只表示“末尾”的短语。
explanation: 结尾段开头应使用表示“总结”的信号词，如 In conclusion / To conclude / To sum up / In summary / Overall。中国学生常把“最后、总之”直译成 At last 或 At the end，或者把 Last but not least 当成“总而言之”。但 At last＝终于（经过等待），At the end 只表示“末尾”（通常要接 of），Last but not least 只用于引出列举中的最后一个论点。正确写法：To conclude, all children should learn to swim at primary school, because swimming is both a life-saving skill and a healthy form of exercise.
focus: 误用 At last / Last but not least 等作结尾信号词

instruction: 阅读 thesis 和两个主体段的主旨。选出最适合放在结尾段、用来概括全文理由的一句。
content:
Thesis: Schools should give students an hour of exercise every day, because it keeps them healthy and helps them concentrate.
Body 1: Daily exercise keeps students' bodies strong and helps prevent weight problems.
Body 2: Students who exercise find it easier to pay attention in class.
options: Daily exercise keeps students fit and helps them focus on their lessons.
Daily exercise keeps students fit and teaches them how to work in a team.
Daily exercise helps students focus and gives them a welcome break from screens.
Daily exercise builds students' confidence and helps them make new friends.
option_explanations: 正确。只概括了 Body 1（身体健康）和 Body 2（上课专注）这两个已有理由，并且换了说法（fit, focus on their lessons）。
前半句概括了健康理由，但“学会团队合作”是正文没有讨论过的新理由，而且漏掉了“专注”这个理由。
前半句概括了专注理由，但“让学生暂时离开屏幕”是正文没有出现过的新理由，而且漏掉了健康理由。
“增强自信”“结交朋友”都是新理由，正文的两个理由反而都不见了。
hints: 先找出 Body 1 和 Body 2 各自讲的是什么理由。
结尾段的总结只能“回收”正文已经论证过的理由，不能顺手再加一个。
逐个选项检查：句子里的每一个好处，能在 Body 1 或 Body 2 里找到吗？
explanation: 结尾段的总结句要概括主体段已经论证过的理由，不能引入新理由。本文的两个理由是“保持健康”（Body 1）和“帮助专注”（Body 2），所以正确的总结是 Daily exercise keeps students fit and helps them focus on their lessons. 中国学生写到结尾时常常“想到一点加一点”（如团队合作、交朋友），觉得理由越多越有说服力；但没有在正文展开的理由只是空口断言，还会让结尾显得跑题。
focus: 结尾引入新论据或新证据

instruction: 这是一道“讨论双方观点并给出自己看法”的题目。根据 thesis，选出最适合作为结尾段第一句的一项。
content:
Prompt: Some people believe that elderly parents should live with their adult children, while others think that care homes are a better option. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Thesis: Although care homes offer professional medical support, I believe that most elderly people are happier living with their families, where they receive emotional support and remain part of their grandchildren's lives.
options: In conclusion, both living with family and moving into a care home have their own advantages, so it is hard to say which is better.
In conclusion, while care homes can provide expert medical care, most older people are better off living with their families, who can give them love and companionship.
In conclusion, every family is different, so whether elderly parents move in with their children or into a care home should depend on each family's situation.
In conclusion, care homes can provide expert medical care, and in some cases this may matter more than living with one's family.
option_explanations: 典型的“骑墙”结尾：说双方各有优点、“很难说哪个更好”，等于收回了 thesis 中的明确立场，也没有完成 give your own opinion 的要求。
正确。用 while 从句简短承认反方（养老院有专业医疗），主句明确重申作者立场（多数老人和家人同住更好），并用 love and companionship 换说法概括了“情感支持”这个理由。
“每个家庭不同，应视情况而定”听起来很理性，但它放弃了 thesis 的立场，变成“因人而异”，与开头不一致。
只强调养老院的医疗优势，并说它有时比和家人同住更重要，立场滑向了反方，与 thesis 矛盾。
hints: 先确认 thesis 支持的是哪一方。
结尾可以承认反方的优点，但主句必须回到作者自己的立场，不能变成“各有利弊”或“因人而异”。
找一找：哪个选项在提到养老院之后，主句仍然站在 thesis 那一边？
explanation: 讨论类题目（Discuss both views and give your own opinion）的结尾必须给出明确观点，并与 thesis 一致。让步（while care homes can provide expert medical care）是允许的，但主句必须重申自己的立场：most older people are better off living with their families。中国学生受“中庸”“辩证看问题”的写作习惯影响，常在结尾写“各有利弊”“因人而异”，以为这样更全面；在 IELTS 中这会被视为立场不清，Task Response 会扣分。
focus: 立场弱化、骑墙或与 thesis 不一致

instruction: 以下四句都想在结尾段重申这个 thesis。哪一句真正换了说法，而不是变相照抄？
content: Thesis: Governments should ban single-use plastic packaging, since it pollutes rivers and oceans and places a heavy burden on waste management systems.
options: In conclusion, governments should prohibit single-use plastic packaging, since it pollutes rivers and oceans and places a heavy burden on waste management systems.
In conclusion, since single-use plastic packaging pollutes rivers and oceans and places a heavy burden on waste management systems, governments should ban it.
In conclusion, single-use plastic packaging should be banned by governments, since it pollutes rivers and oceans and places a heavy burden on waste management systems.
In conclusion, throwaway plastic packaging should be outlawed, as it contaminates seas and rivers and overwhelms the facilities that cities rely on to deal with waste.
option_explanations: 只把 ban 换成了 prohibit，其余部分逐字照抄，是“换一个词”的变相照抄。
只把 since 从句移到了句首，用词完全相同，仍然是照抄。
只把主动语态改成了被动语态（should be banned by governments），其余一字未改，仍然是照抄。
正确。词汇（throwaway, outlawed, contaminates, overwhelms the facilities ... deal with waste）和句式都换了，但立场（应该禁止）和两个理由（污染水体、加重垃圾处理负担）完全保留。
hints: 把每个选项和 thesis 并排对比，数一数有多少词是一模一样的。
真正的改写要同时更换词汇和句式；只换一个词、只调换语序或只改语态都不算。
找出那个几乎没有与 thesis 相同的短语、但意思没有改变的选项。
explanation: 结尾重申 thesis 要“意思不变，说法要变”。中国学生知道不能照抄后，常用三种“偷懒改写”：换一个同义词（ban→prohibit）、调换从句顺序、主动改被动。这些句子与原句九成相同，阅卷人仍会认为是重复，Lexical Resource 也得不到加分。真正的改写要同时更换关键词和句子结构，例如：In conclusion, throwaway plastic packaging should be outlawed, as it contaminates seas and rivers and overwhelms the facilities that cities rely on to deal with waste.
focus: 照抄或变相照抄 thesis

instruction: 下面的结尾段还缺最后一句（升华）。选出最合适的一句。
content:
Thesis: People should repair broken items instead of throwing them away, because this saves money and reduces waste.

Conclusion so far: To sum up, fixing broken items rather than replacing them is good for both our wallets and the environment, since it cuts household spending and reduces waste. ______
options: As the old saying goes, every coin has two sides, and repairing things is no exception.
Let us all join hands and work together to build a better and brighter future for our planet.
After all, protecting the environment is the duty of every one of us, and we must never forget it.
If more people learned basic repair skills, households could save money and far fewer repairable goods would end up in landfill.
option_explanations: 套用谚语 every coin has two sides，与“修理物品”没有具体联系，还暗示“有利有弊”，削弱了立场。
空洞的口号，放在任何一篇作文结尾都能用，没有扣住本文的话题和理由。
笼统的道德说教，只泛泛地说“保护环境人人有责”，没有和“修理旧物”联系起来，也没有提升本文的意义。
正确。用 If ... 展望了更多人学会修理之后的具体结果，紧扣本文的两个理由（省钱、减少浪费），没有引入新论据。
hints: 升华句应该和本文话题有多紧密的联系？
检查每个选项：如果把它放到一篇关于交通或教育的作文结尾，是否同样说得通？说得通的就是空话。
选一个提到本文具体话题（修理物品）并展望其结果的句子。
explanation: 结尾的升华句应该扣住本文话题，给出具体的建议、展望或意义，而不是万能套话。Let us all join hands...、every coin has two sides、protecting the environment is the duty of every one of us 这类句子在任何作文里都能用，阅卷人会视为背诵的模板，没有内容。中国学生受中文作文“结尾要升华、要号召”的训练影响，常用口号和谚语收尾。好的升华：If more people learned basic repair skills, households could save money and far fewer repairable goods would end up in landfill.
focus: 空洞套话、谚语式升华

instruction: 阅读 thesis 和两个主体段使用的例子。选出最适合在结尾段概括主体段内容的一句。
content:
Thesis: Universities should require all students to complete an internship before graduating, because internships develop practical skills and help students choose the right career.
Body 1 (example): My cousin spent three months at an advertising agency, where she learned to use design software and present ideas to clients.
Body 2 (example): In a survey of 500 graduates at one university, 62% said that an internship had changed their career plans.
options: Internships equip students with practical workplace skills and help them make better-informed career choices.
My cousin, for example, spent three months at an advertising agency, where she learned to use design software and present ideas to clients.
As the survey showed, 62% of the 500 graduates said that an internship had changed their career plans.
My cousin learned design software at an agency, and 62% of the surveyed graduates changed their career plans.
option_explanations: 正确。把两个例子“提炼”成了两个理由：获得实用技能、做出更明智的职业选择，用的是概括性的语言。
把 Body 1 的表姐例子原封不动地搬了过来。结尾不应重复具体例子，而应概括它说明的道理。
重复了 Body 2 的调查数据。结尾不需要再列一次数字，读者已经在正文读过。
把两个例子的细节压缩在一起，仍然是复述例子，没有说出它们证明了什么理由。
hints: 先想一想：Body 1 和 Body 2 的例子分别是用来证明什么理由的？
结尾段概括的是“理由”，而不是“例子”；人名、数字、具体经历属于主体段。
选一个没有出现任何具体人物或数字、但涵盖了两个理由的句子。
explanation: 结尾段要把主体段的例子提炼成理由，而不是再讲一遍故事或数字。本文两个例子分别证明“实习培养实用技能”和“实习帮助选择职业”，因此结尾应写 Internships equip students with practical workplace skills and help them make better-informed career choices. 中国学生常因为担心结尾“没内容”或字数不够，就把正文最生动的例子再抄一遍，这会让结尾冗长、重复，也浪费了展示概括能力的机会。
focus: 复述例子细节而非概括理由

instruction: 下面分别是一篇作文第三个主体段和结尾段的第一句，各缺一个开头短语。选出两个空都填得恰当的一项。
content:
Topic: Should more young people learn a skilled trade instead of going to university?
Body paragraph 3 (first sentence): ① ______, skilled trades offer a level of job security that many office jobs no longer provide.
Conclusion (first sentence): ② ______, more school leavers should be encouraged to learn a skilled trade, which offers good pay, little or no student debt and secure employment.
options: ① Lastly / ② Last but not least
① Finally / ② At last
① Last but not least / ② To sum up
① To sum up / ② Lastly
option_explanations: ① Lastly 引出最后一个主体论点，用得对；但 ② Last but not least 同样表示“列举的最后一项”，放在结尾段开头会让读者以为又来了一个新理由。
① Finally 引出最后一个论点可以；但 ② At last 意为“（经过漫长等待）终于”，不能表示总结。
正确。Last but not least 引出最后一个（同样重要的）论点，适合第三主体段；To sum up 是总结信号词，适合结尾段。
两处都放反了：To sum up 表示总结，不该放在主体段开头；Lastly 表示列举的最后一点，不该用来开启结尾段。
hints: 先分清两个位置的功能：① 引出最后一个论点，② 引出全文总结。
Lastly、Last but not least 和 At last 中文都可以译成“最后”，但用法不同：有的用来列举最后一点，有的表示“经过等待终于”。
① 需要“列举最后一点”的短语，② 需要真正表示“总结”的短语；检查每个选项是否两个空都符合。
explanation: Lastly / Finally / Last but not least 用来引出列举中的最后一个论点，适合放在最后一个主体段开头；In conclusion / To sum up / To conclude 用来引出全文总结，放在结尾段开头。At last 意为“（经过等待）终于”，两个位置都不合适。中国学生常把中文的“最后”统统译成 At last 或 Last but not least 放在结尾段，导致读者以为后面还有新论点。正确搭配：① Last but not least, skilled trades offer a level of job security that many office jobs no longer provide. ② To sum up, more school leavers should be encouraged to learn a skilled trade, which offers good pay, little or no student debt and secure employment.
focus: 误用 At last / Last but not least 等作结尾信号词

instruction: 阅读 thesis、主体段主旨和结尾段，选出对这个结尾段最准确的诊断。
content:
Thesis: Television advertisements aimed at young children should be banned, because they encourage unhealthy eating and put pressure on parents to buy expensive toys.
Body 1: Adverts for snacks and fast food lead children to eat unhealthily.
Body 2: Toy adverts make children pester their parents for costly products.

Conclusion: In conclusion, adverts targeting young children do more harm than good. They promote junk food and push families into buying overpriced toys. Indeed, after cereal adverts aimed at children were taken off the air in one region, a local supermarket chain saw its sales of sugary cereals fall by a third. For these reasons, such advertising should be prohibited.
options: The conclusion takes a different position from the one stated in the thesis.
The conclusion copies the thesis word for word instead of paraphrasing it.
The conclusion is effective, because the supermarket example only supports a reason already given in the body.
The conclusion introduces new evidence that was not presented in the body paragraphs.
option_explanations: 立场没有变化：结尾第一句和最后一句都主张禁止针对儿童的广告，与 thesis 一致。
结尾用 adverts targeting young children、do more harm than good、push families into buying overpriced toys 等换了说法，并没有逐字照抄。
这是常见误解。超市销量下降的例子确实是在支持 Body 1 的“不健康饮食”这个已有理由，但它本身是正文从未出现过的新证据。结尾只能总结已经论证过的内容，新证据应该放进 Body 1。
正确。超市销量下降这个例子和数据在正文中从未出现，是结尾第一次提出的新证据。即使它支持的是已有理由，也应该写进主体段，而不是放在结尾。
hints: 把结尾段的每一句和 Body 1、Body 2 逐一对照。
结尾段的任务是总结已经论证过的内容。想一想：支持已有理由的“新材料”，在正文中被论证过吗？
注意 Indeed 后面的内容：超市的例子在 Body 1 或 Body 2 里出现过吗？
explanation: 结尾段只总结正文已经论证过的内容：不能出现新论点，也不能出现新例子或新数据。本文结尾的 Indeed... 一句给出了正文从未提到的超市销量例子。很多学生认为“只要支持的是已有理由，就可以放进结尾”，觉得结尾再补一个“重磅证据”更有说服力；但读者在结尾才第一次看到这条证据，它没有得到分析，结尾也失去了总结功能。正确做法是把这个例子移到 Body 1，结尾只保留概括：In conclusion, adverts targeting young children do more harm than good. They promote junk food and push families into buying overpriced toys, so such advertising should be prohibited.
focus: 结尾引入新论据或新证据

instruction: 阅读 thesis 和结尾段，选出对这个结尾段最准确的评价。
content:
Thesis: Although some people worry that digital payments threaten their privacy, I believe a cashless society is a positive development, because paying electronically is faster and safer than carrying cash.

Conclusion: In conclusion, while concerns about privacy are understandable, they do not outweigh the advantages of going cashless. Paying by card or phone saves time for shoppers and shop owners alike, and it greatly reduces the risk of having cash stolen. As payment technology continues to improve, everyday purchases are likely to become quicker and more secure still.
options: The concession in the first sentence weakens the writer's stance, leaving readers unsure which side the writer supports.
The final sentence brings in a new argument about future technology that was never discussed in the essay.
It is effective: it admits the opposing concern but firmly reaffirms the thesis, summarises both reasons and looks ahead.
It repeats the thesis almost word for word, so the writer misses the chance to show a range of vocabulary.
option_explanations: while concerns about privacy are understandable 只是让步，紧接着主句明确说 they do not outweigh the advantages，立场反而更坚定了，并没有被削弱。
最后一句只是展望：quicker and more secure 呼应的正是 thesis 中 faster and safer 这两个理由，并没有提出新论点。
正确。它先承认反方关于隐私的担忧，再明确重申支持无现金社会；第二句概括了“更快”（saves time）和“更安全”（reduces the risk of having cash stolen）两个理由；最后一句围绕这两个理由展望未来，没有新论据。
结尾用 going cashless、Paying by card or phone、having cash stolen 等表达换了说法，并非照抄 thesis。
hints: 先对比结尾第一句的主句和 thesis：立场变了吗？
区分“让步”和“骑墙”：承认对方有道理之后，作者有没有回到自己的立场？
再检查最后一句：它说的 quicker and more secure 是新的好处，还是 thesis 里已有的理由？
explanation: 让步不等于骑墙。好的结尾可以用 while / although 简短承认反方观点（while concerns about privacy are understandable），只要主句清楚地重申自己的立场（they do not outweigh the advantages of going cashless）。这个结尾还用新的措辞概括了两个理由，并以紧扣这两个理由的展望收尾，是合格的结尾。很多中国学生把“结尾不能削弱立场”误解为“结尾不能提反方”，或者反过来以为提了反方就要说“两边都对”；判断的关键是主句的立场是否与 thesis 一致。
focus: 立场弱化、骑墙或与 thesis 不一致

instruction: 阅读 thesis、主体段中的例子和结尾段，选出对这个结尾段最准确的诊断。
content:
Thesis: Local governments should provide free sports facilities, because they encourage people to exercise and bring communities together.
Body 1 (example): In one town, the share of adults who exercised weekly rose from 30% to 45% after a free outdoor gym opened.
Body 2 (example): In another city, a free weekly football session now attracts over 200 players from different backgrounds.

Conclusion: In conclusion, in one town the share of adults who exercised weekly rose from 30% to 45% after a free outdoor gym opened, and in another city a free weekly football session now attracts over 200 players from different backgrounds. Local governments should therefore treat free sports facilities as a worthwhile public investment.
options: It introduces new statistics and examples that were not presented in the body paragraphs.
It retells the body's examples and figures instead of summarising the two main reasons in general terms.
Its final recommendation contradicts the position taken in the thesis.
It has no major problem, because repeating specific figures makes a conclusion more convincing.
option_explanations: 这些数字和例子在 Body 1 和 Body 2 中都出现过，并不是新证据。
正确。结尾几乎把两个主体段的例子和数字原样复述了一遍，却没有用概括性的语言说出它们证明的理由：鼓励锻炼、凝聚社区。
最后一句建议把免费体育设施视为值得的公共投资，与 thesis 的立场一致，并不矛盾。
结尾的任务是概括，而不是再次举证；重复具体数字只会让结尾冗长，并不会更有说服力。
hints: 先判断结尾里的数字和例子是新的，还是正文已经出现过的。
结尾段应该概括主体段的“理由”，而不是复述“例子”。
找一找：结尾有没有用一般性的语言说出 thesis 的两个理由？
explanation: 结尾段要把例子提炼成理由。本文 thesis 的两个理由是“鼓励人们锻炼”和“凝聚社区”，结尾却只是把“30% 升到 45%”“200 多名球员”等细节重抄了一遍。中国学生常担心结尾太短或“没东西写”，就把正文例子再搬一次。改进写法：In conclusion, free sports facilities get more people exercising and bring residents from different backgrounds together, so local governments should treat them as a worthwhile public investment.
focus: 复述例子细节而非概括理由

instruction: 阅读 thesis 和结尾段，选出这个结尾段最主要的问题。
content:
Thesis: Supermarkets should be required to donate unsold food to charities, because this reduces waste and helps people in need.

Conclusion: In conclusion, making supermarkets give their unsold food to charities would cut waste and support struggling families. Food that is still safe to eat would end up on people's plates instead of in rubbish bins. As the old saying goes, 'Where there is a will, there is a way.' Let us join hands and make the world a better place for everyone.
options: It introduces a new argument that was not mentioned in the thesis.
It ends with a proverb and a slogan that have no clear link to the essay's argument.
It weakens the writer's position by suggesting that both sides have a point.
It does not summarise the reasons that the essay has given.
option_explanations: 最后两句没有提出任何新的理由或证据，只是空话，所以问题不是“新论据”。
正确。前两句已经很好地重申和总结了观点，但结尾用一句与主题无关的谚语和一句万能口号收尾，没有扣住“超市捐赠剩余食品”这个话题。
全文立场始终支持让超市捐赠食品，结尾没有说双方都有道理。
第一句已经概括了两个理由：减少浪费（cut waste）和帮助有需要的人（support struggling families）。
hints: 先看前两句：重申和总结做到了吗？
再看最后两句：它们和“超市捐赠剩余食品”有具体联系吗？
如果把最后两句放到任何一篇作文的结尾也说得通，那它们属于哪一类问题？
explanation: 升华要扣题，不能用万能套话。Where there is a will, there is a way 和 Let us join hands and make the world a better place for everyone 与本文论点没有具体联系，阅卷人会视为背诵的模板句。中国学生习惯在作文结尾用名言、号召来“拔高”，但英语议论文的升华应该具体，例如：If such a law were introduced, food that is now thrown away every night could instead reach the families who need it most.
focus: 空洞套话、谚语式升华

instruction: 阅读引言段的最后三句和结尾段，选出对这个结尾段最准确的诊断。
content:
Introduction (last three sentences): For millions of households, a cat or dog is a member of the family. Yet many landlords still refuse to rent their homes to anyone who owns a pet. I firmly believe that landlords should be required to accept tenants with pets, as animals improve their owners' well-being and pet owners tend to stay in the same home for longer.

Conclusion: In conclusion, for millions of households, a cat or dog is a member of the family. I strongly believe that landlords should be required to accept tenants with pets, as animals improve their owners' happiness and pet owners tend to stay in the same home for longer.
options: It repeats the introduction almost word for word instead of restating the thesis in fresh language.
It introduces a new reason that was not mentioned earlier in the essay.
It changes the writer's position from the one taken in the introduction.
It is effective, because repeating the thesis exactly makes the writer's position as clear as possible.
option_explanations: 正确。结尾除了把 firmly 换成 strongly、well-being 换成 happiness 之外，几乎逐字重复了引言，属于变相照抄，没有体现改写能力，也没有任何升华。
“宠物让主人身心更好”和“养宠物的租客住得更久”在引言中都已经出现，并不是新理由。
结尾仍然主张房东应该接受养宠物的租客，立场没有改变。
照抄 thesis 并不能让立场更清楚，反而显得重复、词汇贫乏，在 Lexical Resource 和 Coherence and Cohesion 上都会失分。
hints: 把引言和结尾并排放，逐句对比用词。
结尾重申 thesis 时，意思要保持一致，但措辞应该怎样？
数一数两段之间一共改动了几个词。
explanation: 结尾重申 thesis 时要“意思不变、说法要变”。这个结尾只换了两个词（firmly→strongly, well-being→happiness），其余与引言一模一样，属于变相照抄。中国学生常把引言的 thesis 复制到结尾，再换一两个同义词，以为这样就是“首尾呼应”。真正的首尾呼应是用新的词汇和句式表达同一立场，例如：In conclusion, obliging landlords to welcome cats and dogs would let more families keep the companions that support their mental health, while giving property owners more reliable, long-term tenants.
focus: 照抄或变相照抄 thesis

instruction: 下面结尾段的第二句是空洞的套话。请重写这一句（只写 1 句），使它成为紧扣本文话题的升华（建议、展望或意义），不要引入新论据。
content:
Thesis: Popular tourist sites should limit the number of daily visitors, because overcrowding damages them and spoils the experience for everyone.

Conclusion: In conclusion, a daily cap on visitor numbers would protect famous sites from damage and make each visit more enjoyable. Let us work hand in hand to create a bright future for everyone.
accepted: If such limits are introduced now, future generations will still be able to enjoy these remarkable places.
Managing crowds in this way would allow these famous places to be enjoyed for many generations to come.
Without such limits, many of the world's best-loved sites risk being ruined by their own popularity.
criteria: 合格条件：(1) 只写 1 句，用来替换原来的第二句；(2) 必须紧扣本文话题，出现与热门景点、游客或限流措施相关的具体内容；(3) 属于升华：建议、展望未来或指出更长远的意义；(4) 不引入新理由，例如“增加门票收入”“创造就业”“减少交通拥堵”等正文没有提到的好处一律不合格；(5) 不使用空泛口号或谚语（如 make the world a better place、a bright future for everyone、every coin has two sides）；(6) 立场与 thesis 一致，不能削弱（如“但限流也可能伤害旅游业”不合格）；(7) 语法基本正确。
hints: 先看原来的第二句：把它放到一篇讲环保或教育的作文结尾，是不是也说得通？
好的升华要扣题：可以设想如果限制（或不限制）游客数量，这些景点将来会怎样，或者这对谁有更长远的意义。
试着用 If ... 或 Without ... 开头，并使用本文的具体名词（如 sites、visitors、future generations）。
explanation: 升华句要具体、扣题。Let us work hand in hand to create a bright future for everyone 是可以套进任何作文的口号，没有内容。好的升华应联系本文的话题和理由（保护景点、改善游览体验），例如展望未来：Without such limits, many of the world's best-loved sites risk being ruined by their own popularity. 中国学生常沿用中文作文里的“号召式结尾”，但英语议论文更看重具体、合乎逻辑的结论。注意不要在升华时加入新理由（如“增加门票收入”）。
focus: 空洞套话、谚语式升华

instruction: 下面结尾段的第二句在复述主体段的例子。请把这一句改写成 1 句概括性的总结：保留 thesis 的两个理由，不出现具体人物、数字或例子。只写改写后的这一句。
content:
Thesis: Secondary schools should teach financial skills, because this helps young people avoid debt and prepares them to live independently.

Conclusion: In conclusion, money management deserves a place on the school timetable. My neighbour, for example, ran up $3,000 of credit card debt at nineteen because nobody had explained interest to him, while students in my school's budgeting project learned how to plan for rent, food and bills. If schools take this subject seriously, young people will enter adult life far better prepared.
accepted: Learning how to handle money helps teenagers stay out of debt and gives them the practical skills they need to live on their own.
Lessons in budgeting and borrowing would protect students from falling into debt and equip them to run their own households.
Such lessons teach young people to avoid unnecessary debt and to cope with everyday costs once they leave home.
criteria: 合格条件：(1) 只写 1 句，用来替换原来的第二句；(2) 必须同时概括两个理由：帮助年轻人避免负债，以及为独立生活（如支付房租、账单、管理日常开销）做准备，同义表达即可；(3) 不得出现具体人物、数字或例子（如 my neighbour、$3,000、nineteen、budgeting project 等）；(4) 不引入新理由（如“学会投资致富”“提高数学成绩”）；(5) 与 thesis 立场一致；(6) 不要求与 thesis 完全不同，但不能逐字照抄 thesis；(7) 语法基本正确，能与前后句自然衔接。
hints: 先分别找出两个例子（邻居、学校项目）各自说明了哪个理由。
结尾段概括的是理由，不是例子：人名、金额、年龄、具体项目都应该删掉。
用一个概括性的主语开头（如指代“这类课程”或“学习理财”），再用两个动词短语分别对应两个理由。
explanation: 结尾段需要把例子提炼为理由：邻居欠下信用卡债说明“理财课能帮人避免负债”，学校预算项目说明“理财课让人为独立生活做准备”。所以第二句应改为类似：Learning how to handle money helps teenagers stay out of debt and gives them the practical skills they need to live on their own. 中国学生常认为例子越具体越有说服力，于是在结尾再讲一遍故事；但例子的任务在主体段已经完成，结尾重复只会显得冗长，也容易被误认为在补充新证据。
focus: 复述例子细节而非概括理由

instruction: 下面结尾段的第一句立场模糊，与 thesis 不一致。请重写这一句（1 句）：明确重申 thesis 的立场，并概括两个理由，不要照抄 thesis。
content:
Thesis: I believe people should buy fewer cheap, low-quality clothes, because they create a lot of waste and cost more in the long run.

Conclusion (first sentence): In conclusion, buying cheap clothes has both advantages and disadvantages, so everyone can make their own choice.
accepted: In conclusion, buying fewer cheap clothes is a wise choice, because it cuts waste and saves money over time.
To sum up, we should stop buying so much fast fashion, as it creates mountains of waste and ends up costing us more.
Overall, shoppers should choose quality over quantity, since cheap clothes soon end up as rubbish and cost more to keep replacing.
criteria: 合格条件：(1) 只写 1 句；(2) 立场明确且与 thesis 一致：支持少买廉价、低质量的衣服，不得出现“有利有弊”“因人而异”“各自选择”等骑墙说法；(3) 概括两个理由：造成大量浪费或垃圾、长期来看更花钱，同义表达即可；(4) 不引入新理由（如“保护工人权益”“节省时间”）；(5) 不逐字照抄 thesis（可以保留个别词）；(6) 建议用 In conclusion / To sum up / Overall 等开头（非强制）；(7) 语法基本正确。
hints: 读完原句，你能看出作者到底支持哪一方吗？
结尾段的立场必须和 thesis 一致；“有利有弊”“自己选择”这类说法等于放弃了立场。
先用 should 写出作者的明确主张，再用 because / since 接上 thesis 的两个理由，记得换一些词。
explanation: 结尾段的立场必须与 thesis 一致。原句 has both advantages and disadvantages, so everyone can make their own choice 把明确的主张变成了“各有利弊、自己选择”，读者无法判断作者的观点。中国学生常担心观点太绝对，或受“凡事都有两面”的思维影响，在结尾把立场“软化”。正确做法是明确重申主张并概括理由，例如：In conclusion, buying fewer cheap clothes is a wise choice, because it cuts waste and saves money over time.
focus: 立场弱化、骑墙或与 thesis 不一致

instruction: 这个结尾段中有一句引入了正文没有讨论过的新论据。请写一句话替换它：只概括 Body 1 和 Body 2 的内容，不加入任何新论据。只写替换句。
content:
Thesis: Cities should install free drinking fountains in public places, because they reduce plastic waste and help people stay healthy.
Body 1: When people can refill their own bottles for free, far fewer plastic bottles are bought and thrown away.
Body 2: Easy access to free water encourages people to drink water instead of sugary drinks.

Conclusion: In conclusion, public drinking fountains are a simple investment that cities should not overlook. Because they are used by so many tourists, they also improve a city's image as a welcoming place to visit. Cities that install them widely are therefore likely to become cleaner and healthier places to live.
accepted: By letting people refill their own bottles, they cut the number of plastic bottles thrown away and encourage people to choose water over sugary drinks.
They reduce plastic waste, since people can refill their own bottles, and they make it easier for everyone to drink water instead of sugary drinks.
Free fountains keep plastic bottles out of the bin and make water, rather than sugary drinks, the easy choice for thirsty residents.
criteria: 合格条件：(1) 只写 1 句，用来替换含新论据的第二句；(2) 必须同时概括两个理由：减少塑料瓶垃圾（人们可以自带瓶子免费接水），以及让人们更容易喝水而不是含糖饮料、有益健康，同义表达即可；(3) 不得出现正文没有的内容，如吸引游客、提升城市形象、节省家庭开支、预防中暑等；(4) 用概括性语言，不编造具体人物、例子或数字；(5) 立场与 thesis 一致；(6) 能与前后句自然衔接（如用 they 指代 drinking fountains）；(7) 语法基本正确。
hints: 把结尾段的每一句与 Body 1、Body 2 逐一对照。
结尾段只能概括正文已有的理由；找出哪一个“好处”在正文中从来没有出现过。
替换句要把两个主体段的要点都概括进去，并用 they 指代 drinking fountains，使它与前后两句自然衔接。
explanation: 第二句 Because they are used by so many tourists, they also improve a city's image as a welcoming place to visit 提出了“吸引游客、提升城市形象”这一新论点，正文从未讨论过。它没有用 Moreover 等明显的信号词，而是用 also 悄悄加入，因此更难发现。结尾段只能概括主体段已有的理由：减少塑料瓶垃圾（Body 1），以及鼓励人们喝水而不是含糖饮料（Body 2）。参考：By letting people refill their own bottles, they cut the number of plastic bottles thrown away and encourage people to choose water over sugary drinks. 中国学生写结尾时常把“临时想到”的新好处顺手写上；自查方法是：结尾的每一个观点都必须能在正文中找到出处。
focus: 结尾引入新论据或新证据

instruction: 下面是一篇议论文开头段的四个句子，请按正确顺序排列。
sentences: Today, most students bring a smartphone to school.
These phones are useful, but they can also distract students during lessons.
Because of this problem, some schools have decided to ban phones in class.
In my opinion, such a ban is a good idea, because it helps students focus on their lessons.
hints: 先找出不含 these、this、such 等回指词、可以独立出现的句子。
英语开头段通常“由宽到窄”：先写背景，再引出问题，最后亮出作者的立场（thesis）。
These phones、this problem、such a ban 分别要求前面先出现什么内容？表明立场的 In my opinion 一般放在开头段的什么位置？
explanation: 正确顺序：背景（Today, most students bring a smartphone to school.）→ 问题（These phones ... can also distract students）→ 现状（Because of this problem, some schools have decided to ban phones）→ thesis（In my opinion, such a ban is a good idea, because it helps students focus on their lessons）。These phones 回指 smartphone，this problem 回指“分散注意力”，such a ban 回指 ban phones in class，所以顺序是唯一的。英语开头段像漏斗一样由宽到窄，thesis 一般放在开头段末尾，并简要点出理由。中国学生常把立场放在第一句，或者用大段空泛背景（如 With the development of society...）开头、迟迟不给出 thesis，这都会让开头段的功能不清楚。
focus: 开头段与结尾段的功能和内部顺序

instruction: 阅读下面这篇作文的 thesis，选出最适合作为结尾段第一句的句子。
content: Thesis: Young people should spend less time playing video games, because gaming late at night harms both their sleep and their schoolwork.
options: In conclusion, one student in my class plays video games until two o'clock every night.
In conclusion, cutting down on gaming would help young people sleep better and do better at school.
In conclusion, video games can also make young people more aggressive towards their friends.
In conclusion, millions of people around the world now play video games every day.
option_explanations: 这是一个具体例子，属于主体段的论证材料。结尾段的任务是概括全文，不应该再举新的例子。
正确。这句话重申了 thesis 的立场（少玩游戏），并概括了两个理由（睡眠和学业），没有加入任何新内容。
“让人更有攻击性”是 thesis 里没有出现过的新论点。结尾段不能引入新论点，否则这个论点没有得到任何论证。
这是开头段常用的背景句，内容太宽泛，既没有重申立场，也没有概括理由，起不到总结全文的作用。
hints: 结尾段的功能是什么？它应该写新内容，还是回顾已有内容？
好的结尾段会重申 thesis 的立场，并简要概括主体段的理由，不加入新论点、新例子。
把每个选项和 thesis 逐项对比：哪一句同时对应了 thesis 的立场和两个理由？
explanation: 结尾段 = 重申立场 + 概括理由（+ 可选的建议或展望），不能出现新论点、新例子或泛泛的背景句。本题 thesis 的立场是“少玩游戏”，理由是“睡眠”和“学业”，只有 In conclusion, cutting down on gaming would help young people sleep better and do better at school. 同时回应了这三点。中国学生常在结尾“升华”，或补充一个刚想到的新理由，或者用开头式的大背景句收尾，这都会让结尾段失去总结功能。
focus: 开头段与结尾段的功能和内部顺序

instruction: 下面是一篇利弊题作文（题目：Do the advantages of tourism for small villages outweigh the disadvantages?）各段的主题句，请按正确顺序排列。
sentences: Tourism brings many changes to small villages, and, in my view, its advantages are greater than its disadvantages.
The main advantage of tourism is that it creates jobs for local people.
Another advantage is that money from visitors can pay for better roads and schools.
However, tourism also has one clear disadvantage: large crowds can make village life noisy and stressful.
In conclusion, although tourism can bring noise and crowds, the jobs and money it creates make it good for small villages.
hints: 先找出给出立场的开头段和以 In conclusion 开头的结尾段。
利弊题要把同一方面的内容放在一起：好处写完再转向坏处，不要来回切换。
Another advantage 要求前面已经出现过什么？However 和 also 说明这一句之前已经讨论过哪一方面？
explanation: 正确顺序：开头（立场：利大于弊）→ 好处 1（The main advantage：创造就业）→ 好处 2（Another advantage：游客的钱可以修路建校）→ 坏处（However, tourism also has one clear disadvantage：拥挤吵闹）→ 结尾。Another 必须跟在第一个好处之后；However 表示从“利”转到“弊”，also 表示前面已经谈过别的方面。利弊题的结构要求“好处一组、坏处一组”，各自成段。中国学生常在同一段里利弊交替，或者只写一方面，导致没有完整回答题目。
focus: 结构须匹配题型要求

instruction: 阅读下面两个主体段的主题句，选出与它们最匹配的 thesis。
content:
Body 1 topic sentence: Working from home saves employees the time and money they would otherwise spend travelling to the office.
Body 2 topic sentence: Working from home also gives employees more time to spend with their families.
options: Working from home is good for employees, because it saves them travel time and money and gives them more time with their families.
Working from home is good for employees, because it gives them more time with their families and saves them travel time and money.
Working from home is good for employees, because it saves them travel time and money, gives them more time with their families and improves their health.
Working from home is good for employees, because it saves them travel time and money.
option_explanations: 正确。thesis 预告的两个理由（省时省钱、陪伴家人）与两个主体段一一对应，而且顺序一致。
两个理由都有，但顺序与主体段相反：thesis 先说陪伴家人，Body 1 却先写省时省钱，读者按“路线图”阅读时会对不上。
多预告了一个理由（improves their health），但文中没有任何一段论证它，读者会期待一个并不存在的段落。
只预告了一个理由，Body 2 的“陪伴家人”在 thesis 中没有出现，thesis 不能完整概括全文。
hints: 先概括两个主体段各讲了什么理由，以及谁先谁后。
thesis 是全文的路线图：预告的理由数量和顺序都要与主体段一致。
逐个检查选项：理由是不是不多不少？出现的先后是否与 Body 1、Body 2 相同？
explanation: thesis 要像路线图一样准确预告主体段：理由不能多（预告了却不写），不能少（写了却没预告），顺序也要一致。两个主体段依次讲“省时省钱”和“陪伴家人”，所以 thesis 应写成 Working from home is good for employees, because it saves them travel time and money and gives them more time with their families. 中国学生常常先写 thesis 时随手列理由，写正文时又调整了顺序或增减了理由，最后忘记回头修改 thesis。
focus: 主体段顺序与 thesis 预告一致

instruction: 下面这篇短文被写成了一整段。选出最合理的分段方案。
content: (1) Many museums charge visitors an entrance fee, but I believe public museums should be free for everyone. (2) The main reason is that free entry allows people from all income groups to enjoy their country's art and history. (3) For example, when one city museum stopped charging, the number of families visiting it almost doubled within a year. (4) Free museums also benefit the local economy. (5) Tourists who visit a free museum often spend money in nearby cafés, shops and hotels. (6) In this way, free entry partly pays for itself through the money that visitors spend. (7) In conclusion, free entry makes culture available to everyone and supports local businesses, so it is well worth the cost.
options: Start new paragraphs at sentences (3), (5) and (7).
Start new paragraphs at sentences (2) and (7) only.
Start new paragraphs at sentences (2), (4) and (7).
Start new paragraphs at sentences (2) and (4) only.
option_explanations: 这样会把例子 (3)、解释 (5) 和它们支持的观点 (2)、(4) 拆开，新段落没有主题句；同时 thesis (1) 和第一个理由 (2) 被挤在开头段里。
(2)–(6) 包含两个不同的理由（让所有收入群体都能接触文化、带动当地经济），放在同一段违反“一段一个中心”。
正确。开头段 (1) 给出 thesis；主体段一 (2)–(3) 讲“所有人都能参观”；主体段二 (4)–(6) 讲“带动当地经济”；结尾段 (7) 总结。每段只有一个功能。
结尾句 (7) 被放进了第二个主体段，结尾段的总结功能没有独立出来，读者看不出全文在哪里收尾。
hints: 先找出 thesis、结尾句，以及每个新理由开始的句子。
一段只讲一个中心：开头、每个理由、结尾各占一段；例子和解释要跟它支持的观点留在同一段。
(3) 和 (5)(6) 分别在支持哪一句？“新的中心”是从哪几句开始的？
explanation: 分段原则是“换中心就换段”。本文有四个功能单位：开头（thesis）、理由 1（文化对所有收入群体开放 + 例子）、理由 2（Free museums also benefit the local economy + 解释）、结尾（In conclusion），所以应在 (2)、(4)、(7) 处另起一段。中国学生在考试中常常一段写到底，或者按篇幅而不是按中心分段：有时把例子单独切成一段，有时把结尾句挂在最后一个主体段后面。
focus: 一段一个中心：换中心就分段

instruction: 下面是一篇观点题作文各段的主题句，请按正确顺序排列。
sentences: Although some drivers would object, I believe private cars should be banned from city centres, because this would make the air cleaner, the streets quieter and pedestrians safer.
The most obvious benefit of a car-free centre would be a sharp fall in air pollution.
Besides enjoying cleaner air, residents would suffer far less from traffic noise, especially at night.
The last of these benefits, greater safety, would matter most to parents of young children.
In conclusion, although a ban would inconvenience some drivers, cleaner air, quieter streets and greater safety would make city centres far better places to live.
hints: 先找出 thesis 和以 In conclusion 开头的结尾段。
thesis 里理由出现的先后就是主体段的“路线图”，主体段要按同样的顺序展开。
Besides enjoying cleaner air 说明前一段已经讨论了哪个好处？the last of these benefits 应该是第几个主体段？
explanation: thesis 预告了三个理由：the air cleaner → the streets quieter → pedestrians safer。主体段按同样顺序展开：空气（The most obvious benefit... air pollution）→ 噪音（Besides enjoying cleaner air... traffic noise）→ 安全（The last of these benefits, greater safety）。Besides enjoying cleaner air 回指上一段，the last of these benefits 说明它是最后一个理由，结尾也按同样顺序概括。中国学生常在 thesis 中随手列理由，主体段却换了顺序，读者对照路线图时会感到困惑。
focus: 主体段顺序与 thesis 预告一致

instruction: 下面是一篇议论文结尾段的四个句子，请按正确顺序排列。
sentences: In conclusion, I firmly believe that every secondary school should employ a full-time counsellor.
As this essay has shown, such a counsellor not only helps students cope with stress before it becomes serious but also allows teachers to concentrate on teaching.
To secure these benefits, governments must give schools enough funding to hire trained counsellors.
If they do so, schools are likely to become calmer and happier places in which to learn.
hints: 结尾段的信号词是什么？以它开头的句子应该放在哪里？
结尾段一般按“重申立场 → 概括主体段论点 → 提出建议 → 展望结果”的顺序写。
such a counsellor、these benefits、If they do so 分别回指前面哪一句里的内容？
explanation: 结尾段顺序：重申立场（In conclusion, ... employ a full-time counsellor）→ 概括主体段的两个理由（As this essay has shown, such a counsellor...）→ 提出建议（To secure these benefits, governments must...）→ 展望结果（If they do so, ...）。such a counsellor 回指第一句的 full-time counsellor，these benefits 回指“帮助学生应对压力、让老师专心教学”，they 回指 governments。结尾段只重申和概括已经论证过的内容，可以加建议或展望，但不能引入新论点。中国学生常把结尾写成口号式的“升华”，或者到结尾才第一次提出新的理由。
focus: 开头段与结尾段的功能和内部顺序

instruction: 阅读下面的 thesis 和四个主体段的主题句，选出内容重复、应该合并的两段。
content:
Thesis: Public transport in large cities should be free, because this would reduce traffic, help low-income families and cut air pollution.
Body 1: If buses and trains cost nothing, many commuters would switch from driving to public transport, which would ease congestion on city roads.
Body 2: Families on low incomes would save a large part of their monthly budget if they no longer had to pay fares.
Body 3: With fewer people choosing to drive, the long queues of traffic during the morning and evening rush hours would become much shorter.
Body 4: A full bus produces far less pollution per passenger than a private car, so free public transport would also make city air cleaner.
options: Body 1 and Body 2
Body 2 and Body 4
Body 3 and Body 4
Body 1 and Body 3
option_explanations: Body 1 讲缓解交通拥堵，Body 2 讲帮低收入家庭省钱，是 thesis 中两个不同的理由，并不重复。
Body 2 讲省钱，Body 4 讲减少空气污染，分别对应 thesis 的第二和第三个理由，各有中心。
两段都提到“少开车”，但 Body 3 的中心是高峰期堵车减少，Body 4 的中心是空气更干净，属于不同的理由。
正确。Body 1（ease congestion on city roads）和 Body 3（rush-hour queues would become much shorter）都在论证 thesis 的第一个理由 reduce traffic，只是换了说法，应该合并成一段。
hints: thesis 预告了几个理由？主体段却有几段？
每个主体段应该对应 thesis 中一个不同的理由；两段论证同一个理由、只是换了说法，就应该合并。
把四个主体段分别对应到 thesis 的三个理由上，哪个理由被对应了两次？
explanation: thesis 预告了三个理由（减少交通拥堵、帮助低收入家庭、减少空气污染），却有四个主体段，说明有两段在重复。Body 1 的 ease congestion 和 Body 3 的 queues of traffic... much shorter 都是“交通不再拥堵”，应合并为一段：以“通勤者改乘公交”为原因、“高峰期排队变短”为结果来展开。中国学生为了凑够段数或字数，常把同一个理由换个说法写两遍，英语读者会把它看作冗余，而不是强调。
focus: 主体段之间内容重复

instruction: 下面是一篇支持在公共场所增加监控摄像头（CCTV）的作文中的让步反驳段，请按正确顺序排列句子。
sentences: Opponents of CCTV argue that cameras in public places are an invasion of people's privacy.
This concern is understandable, since nobody enjoys the feeling of being watched all the time.
However, the concern is largely exaggerated, because cameras in streets and stations record only public spaces, not private homes.
Moreover, the recordings are normally viewed only after a crime has been reported.
Therefore, a small loss of privacy is a reasonable price to pay for safer streets.
hints: 先找出介绍对方观点的句子，让步反驳段通常从这里开始。
让步反驳段的内部顺序一般是：对方观点 → 承认其合理之处 → 转折反驳 → 补充反驳理由 → 回到自己的立场。
This concern、However、Moreover、Therefore 分别要求前面先出现什么内容？
explanation: 正确顺序：对方观点（Opponents of CCTV argue...）→ 让步（This concern is understandable...）→ 反驳（However, the concern is largely exaggerated...）→ 补充反驳（Moreover, the recordings...）→ 回到立场（Therefore, a small loss of privacy is a reasonable price to pay...）。This concern 回指对方观点；However 从让步转向反驳；Moreover 只能补充反驳理由，不能紧跟在让步之后；Therefore 把论证收回到作者立场。中国学生常常只写对方观点或只写让步，不用 However 转回来反驳，结果立场变得模糊，甚至像在支持对方。
focus: 让步反驳段的位置与写法

instruction: 阅读下面的作文题目，选出最符合题目要求的篇章结构。
content: Prompt: Many people now buy cheap clothes that they wear only a few times before throwing them away. Why is this happening, and what can be done to reduce this habit?
options: Introduction → Body 1: reasons why people buy cheap clothes → Body 2: how this habit harms the environment → Conclusion
Introduction → Body 1: reasons why people buy cheap clothes → Body 2: measures that could reduce this habit → Conclusion
Introduction → Body 1: measures governments could take → Body 2: measures shoppers could take → Conclusion
Introduction → Body 1: advantages of cheap clothes → Body 2: disadvantages of cheap clothes → Conclusion
option_explanations: 只回答了第一个问题（原因）。第二个主体段写的是“危害”，题目并没有问，而“怎么解决”却完全没写。
正确。题目有两个问题：为什么（原因）和怎么办（措施）。两个主体段按题目的提问顺序各回答一个问题。
两个主体段都在写措施，“为什么会出现这种现象”完全没有回答。
这是利弊题的结构，题目并没有问好处和坏处，整篇文章会偏离题目要求。
hints: 数一数题目一共问了几个问题。
结构必须与题型对应：题目问什么，主体段就答什么，每个问题各占一段，并按提问顺序排列。
Why is this happening 需要写什么内容？what can be done 又需要写什么内容？
explanation: 原因—解决类题目（Why...? What can be done...?）要求主体段依次回答两个问题：先写原因，再写解决办法。只写原因、只写办法、写成危害或写成利弊，都没有完整回答题目，在 IELTS 中会直接影响 Task Response 分数。中国学生常套用自己熟悉的模板（比如一律写利弊），而不是先审题、再按题目的问题安排段落。
focus: 结构须匹配题型要求

instruction: 阅读下面的主体段，选出最好的修改建议。
content: (1) One major advantage of following the news on social media is speed. (2) When a big story breaks, eyewitnesses often post photos and videos within minutes, long before newspapers can publish a report. (3) As a result, users can respond to urgent information, such as severe weather warnings, almost immediately. (4) Social media also allows readers to comment on stories and discuss them with people from very different backgrounds. (5) This kind of exchange can expose users to opinions that they would rarely encounter in a single newspaper. (6) Consequently, many young people feel more involved in discussions about local and global issues than earlier generations did.
options: Split the paragraph after sentence (3) and use sentence (4) as the topic sentence of a new paragraph.
Split the paragraph after sentence (5), so that sentence (6) starts a new paragraph about young people.
Move sentences (4)–(6) into the conclusion, because they sum up the advantages discussed earlier.
Keep the paragraph unchanged, because every sentence in it supports the writer's positive view.
option_explanations: 正确。(1)–(3) 的中心是“速度快”，(4)–(6) 转向了另一个好处“可以评论、交流观点”。两个中心应分成两段，(4) 正好可以作为新段的主题句。
错误。(6) 以 Consequently 开头，说明的是 (4)(5)“评论和交流”带来的结果，并不是新的中心；把它单独切成一段，会把结果和它的原因拆开。真正换中心的地方是 (4)。
(4)–(6) 提出的是一个新的好处，并附有解释和结果，并不是在总结前文；把新论点挪进结尾段，会让结尾出现未经论证的新内容。
所有句子确实都支持作者的正面观点，但支持 thesis 不等于属于同一段：本段有两个不同的中心，违反“一段一个中心”。
hints: 先找出本段的主题句，看看它预告的中心是什么。
一段只讲一个中心；所有句子都支持 thesis，并不代表它们应该放在同一段。但也不要因为出现了一个新名词就切段。
从哪一句开始，内容已经不再围绕主题句的那个中心？
explanation: 主题句 (1) 只预告了一个中心：speed。(2)(3) 用目击者快速发帖和天气预警来支持“快”；但 (4) 用 also 引出了另一个好处：评论和交流，(5)(6) 都在发展这个新中心。正确做法是在 (3) 之后分段，让 (4) 成为新段的主题句。(6) 虽然提到了 young people，但它是 (4)(5) 的结果（Consequently），应该和它们留在同一段。中国学生常认为“只要都支持我的观点就可以放在一段”，或者按字数、按表面出现的新名词分段；英语议论文要求一段一个中心，换中心才换段。
focus: 一段一个中心：换中心就分段

instruction: 下面是一篇“双问题”作文各段的主题句。题目问：为什么在很多国家，年轻人和父母同住的时间越来越长？这是积极还是消极的发展？请按正确顺序排列。
sentences: In many countries, young adults are increasingly living with their parents until their late twenties or beyond, a trend that has clear economic causes and, in my view, largely positive effects.
The main reason for this trend is the soaring cost of housing, which has put even a small flat beyond the reach of many young workers.
Job insecurity adds to this financial pressure, since people on short-term contracts are often reluctant to commit to a long lease.
Whatever the causes of this trend, living in the family home can bring real benefits to both generations.
Admittedly, sharing a home may delay young people's independence, but this drawback is usually outweighed by the financial and emotional support it provides.
In conclusion, although high housing costs and insecure work are keeping young adults at home, this development is, on balance, a positive one.
hints: 先找出开头段和结尾段；开头段的后半句预告了全文先写什么、后写什么。
双问题题要按题目的提问顺序作答：先把第一个问题完整回答完，再回答第二个问题。
this financial pressure 回指哪个原因？Whatever the causes of this trend 表示从哪部分过渡到哪部分？Admittedly 之前需要先出现一个什么样的观点？
explanation: 本题问了两个问题：原因（为什么）和评价（积极还是消极）。开头段预告 clear economic causes and largely positive effects，所以主体段先写原因：原因 1（The main reason... housing）→ 原因 2（Job insecurity adds to this financial pressure）；再写评价：用 Whatever the causes of this trend 过渡，先给出正面评价（benefits to both generations），再用 Admittedly... but 处理反方意见；最后是结尾。this financial pressure 回指高房价，Whatever the causes 必须紧跟在原因之后，Admittedly 必须放在正面观点之后。中国学生写双问题题时常常只答一个问题，或者把原因和评价混在同一段。
focus: 结构须匹配题型要求

instruction: 下面是一篇观点题作文各段的主题句（其中一段专门回应反方观点），请按正确顺序排列。
sentences: Some people argue that unused public land in cities should be saved for housing, but I believe much of it would be better used as community gardens.
Critics claim that every empty plot is needed for new homes, and housing is certainly in short supply; however, many of these sites are too small or awkwardly shaped for developers to build on.
Not only would community gardens put these awkward plots to good use, but they would also provide residents with cheap, fresh vegetables.
In addition to providing fresh food, shared gardens bring together neighbours who might otherwise never meet.
In conclusion, because they put wasted land to good use and offer both food and friendship, community gardens deserve the support of local councils.
hints: 先确定开头段（thesis）和结尾段。
让步反驳段既可以放在自己的论点之前，也可以放在之后，关键看其他段落有没有回指它。
these awkward plots 指的是哪一段提到的地块？In addition to providing fresh food 又回指哪一段？
explanation: 本文把让步反驳放在第一个主体段：先转述批评者的说法（空地都需要用来建房），承认住房确实紧张，再用 however 反驳（很多地块太小或形状不规则，开发商建不了房），然后展开自己的两个理由。Not only would community gardens put these awkward plots to good use 回指反驳段中“不适合建房的地块”，所以必须紧跟在它之后；In addition to providing fresh food 回指上一段的“新鲜蔬菜”；结尾 because they put wasted land to good use and offer both food and friendship 也按“土地 → 食物 → 邻里关系”的顺序总结。让步反驳段的位置可前可后，但必须先承认、后反驳，并用衔接词与上下文连起来。中国学生常把反方观点放在结尾，或者只提反方观点而不反驳。
focus: 让步反驳段的位置与写法

instruction: 阅读下面的 thesis 和四个主体段的主题句。其中有两段实际上在重复同一个论点，选出正确的修改建议。
content:
Thesis: Companies should encourage employees to keep working beyond the traditional retirement age, as experienced staff are valuable to businesses and work benefits older people themselves.
Body 1: Retaining older employees spares firms the considerable expense of recruiting and training replacements.
Body 2: Older staff can mentor younger colleagues, passing on practical knowledge that is rarely found in any manual.
Body 3: Remaining in work keeps older people mentally active and socially connected, which protects their well-being.
Body 4: Because seasoned workers already know their jobs thoroughly, businesses that keep them avoid the cost of hiring and preparing newcomers.
options: Merge Body 2 and Body 3, because both describe how older workers interact with other people.
Merge Body 1 and Body 2, because both explain why older employees are valuable to companies.
Merge Body 3 and Body 4, because both describe what happens when older people stay in work.
Merge Body 1 and Body 4, because both argue that keeping older staff saves recruitment and training costs.
option_explanations: Body 2 的中心是“向年轻同事传授经验”（对企业的好处），Body 3 的中心是“保持身心健康”（对老人自己的好处），二者只是都涉及人际交往，核心论点不同。
Body 1 和 Body 2 都属于 thesis 的第一个大理由（对企业有价值），但一个讲节省招聘培训成本，一个讲传授经验，是两个不同的分论点，各自成段没有问题。
Body 3 讲老人自身的健康，Body 4 讲企业节省成本，受益对象和核心论点都不同。
正确。Body 1（spares firms the expense of recruiting and training replacements）和 Body 4（avoid the cost of hiring and preparing newcomers）用不同的词表达了完全相同的论点，应该合并成一段。
hints: 不要只看表面用词，先用几个字概括每个主体段的核心论点。
两段属于 thesis 的同一个大理由并不等于重复；只有核心论点完全相同、只是换了说法，才需要合并。
试着给每段贴一个两三个字的标签（比如 Body 2 可以贴“传授经验”），看看哪个标签会出现两次。
explanation: 判断重复要看核心论点，而不是看用词或所属的大类。Body 1 的 recruiting and training replacements 和 Body 4 的 hiring and preparing newcomers 是同义改写，两段说的都是“留住老员工可以省下招聘和培训新人的费用”，应该合并。Body 1 和 Body 2 虽然都说明老员工对企业有价值，但分论点不同（省钱 vs. 传授经验），可以各自成段。中国学生为了显得论点多，常把同一个论点用同义词改写后另起一段；考官会把它看作重复，而不是新的论证。
focus: 主体段之间内容重复

instruction: 下面是一篇观点题作文各段的主题句，请按正确顺序排列。
sentences: Although meat plays a central role in many traditional diets, governments should encourage citizens to eat less of it, both to protect the environment and to ease the pressure on public health systems.
The environmental case rests on the vast quantities of land, water and feed that livestock farming consumes.
Equally compelling is the medical evidence linking a diet high in processed meat to heart disease and certain cancers.

Despite the strength of these arguments, sceptics insist that diet is a private matter; however, encouraging healthier choices through information campaigns is very different from banning particular foods.
Ultimately, by gently steering citizens towards a diet with less meat, governments could protect both the planet and public health without restricting personal freedom.
hints: 先找出 thesis（开头段）和总结全文的结尾句。
thesis 预告理由的先后就是主体段的顺序；反驳段要等被它回指的论点都出现之后才能出现。
Equally compelling 要求前面已经有一个怎样的论点？these arguments 指的是哪几段？结尾中的 without restricting personal freedom 回应的是哪一段？
explanation: thesis 预告了两个目的：先 protect the environment，后 ease the pressure on public health systems，所以主体段先写环境（The environmental case...）再写健康（Equally compelling is the medical evidence...）。Equally compelling 要求前面已经有一个有力的论点；Despite the strength of these arguments 回指前两段，所以反驳段放在两个论点之后；结尾的 without restricting personal freedom 回应了反驳段中“饮食是私事”的反对意见。中国学生常在 thesis 中按一种顺序列理由，正文却按想到的顺序写，或者把反方意见放在任意位置而没有衔接，读者难以把握文章的逻辑。
focus: 主体段顺序与 thesis 预告一致

instruction: 阅读下面的作文提纲，选出最好的修改建议。
content:
Prompt: Driverless cars may soon become common on our roads. Is this a positive or negative development?
Thesis: The spread of driverless cars will be a largely positive development.
Body 1: Driverless cars could prevent most road accidents, since the vast majority of crashes are caused by human error.
Body 2: They would also give elderly and disabled people who cannot drive a far greater degree of independence.
Body 3: However, driverless cars could put millions of professional drivers out of work, and many of them would struggle to find new jobs.
Conclusion: In conclusion, driverless cars will make our roads safer and our society more inclusive.
options: Move Body 3 into the conclusion, so that the essay ends with a balanced view.
Delete Body 3, because an opinion essay should present only one side of the issue.
Keep Body 3, but add a rebuttal explaining why the benefits outweigh this drawback.
Merge Body 1 and Body 2, because both of them describe benefits of driverless cars.
option_explanations: 把未经回应的反方观点挪进结尾，结尾就出现了新论点，而且全文以削弱自己立场的内容收尾，问题反而更严重。
选项给出的理由不成立：观点题并不要求只写一方。题目问的是积极还是消极，提到消极面并加以反驳正好体现了全面思考，删掉它会让文章失去平衡。
正确。Body 3 提出了一个有力的反对意见（司机失业），却没有任何反驳，结尾也没有回应，读者会觉得作者的立场被自己推翻了。保留这一段并补充反驳，才能说明为什么好处仍然大于坏处。
Body 1 讲减少交通事故，Body 2 讲帮助老人和残障人士获得独立，是两个不同的中心，合并会违反“一段一个中心”。
hints: 对照 thesis 的立场，逐段判断每一段是在支持它还是在削弱它。
议论文可以写反方观点，但让步之后必须反驳，否则让步段会削弱自己的立场。
Body 3 提出问题之后，文章有没有说明作者为什么仍然坚持原来的立场？结尾有没有回应它？
explanation: 让步反驳段的关键是“先让步，再反驳”。Body 3 用 However 提出了司机失业这一有力的反对意见，但既没有反驳，结尾也只字未提，于是全文的结论显得缺乏依据。最好的修改是保留 Body 3 并加上反驳，例如：Although driverless cars could put many professional drivers out of work, this change is likely to be gradual, giving drivers time to retrain for new jobs. 中国学生常把“提到对方观点”误当作“全面”，却忘了反驳，或者干脆把反方意见放进结尾，导致立场摇摆。
focus: 让步反驳段的位置与写法

instruction:
题目：Some people think that teenagers should have part-time jobs. Do you agree or disagree?
下面是一位同学描述自己 5 分钟规划过程的句子，顺序被打乱了。请按正确顺序排列。
sentences: First, I underline the key words in the prompt: 'teenagers', 'part-time jobs' and 'agree or disagree'.
These words tell me that this is an opinion essay, so I must take a clear position.
I decide to agree, and I write a thesis with two reasons: managing money and gaining work experience.
Next, I turn each of these reasons into the main point of a body paragraph.
Under each main point, I add one or two supporting details, such as 'saving for a bike' or 'serving customers'.
Finally, I check that the two points do not overlap and that both answer the prompt.
hints: 先找表示先后的词：First、Next、Finally 分别应该放在什么位置？
These words、these reasons、each main point 都指向前面已经出现的内容，被指代的内容必须先出现。
these reasons 指的是哪一句里第一次提出的两个理由？each main point 又是在哪一句里产生的？
explanation: 规划的顺序是：① 圈出题目关键词，判断题型（agree or disagree 表示要表明立场）；② 写 thesis（立场＋理由）；③ 把每个理由变成一个主体段的中心论点；④ 在每个论点下加 1–2 个支撑细节；⑤ 检查论点是否重复、是否切题。英文中的指代词也提示了顺序：These words 指前一句的关键词，these reasons 指 thesis 里的两个理由，each main point 指刚刚列出的主体段论点。很多中国学生习惯“边写边想”，或者先想例子再找观点，结果写到一半才发现立场不清或论点重复。
focus: 提纲未围绕 thesis 组织（步骤/顺序/内容）

instruction:
题目：Some people think that more people should cycle to work. Do you agree or disagree?
下面是一份提纲的各行，顺序被打乱了。请按正确顺序排列。
sentences: Thesis: agree — cycling to work is cheaper, healthier and greener than driving.
Cost: no petrol or parking fees; bikes are cheap to maintain
Health: daily exercise without paying for a gym
Environment: no exhaust fumes and less traffic
Conclusion: cities should build safe cycle lanes so that more people cycle to work
hints: 先确定哪一行必须放在最前面，哪一行必须放在最后。
中间几行是主体段，它们的顺序应该与 thesis 预告理由的顺序一致。
thesis 里的 greener 对应哪一行？它在 thesis 中排第几个？
explanation: 提纲的顺序：thesis 在最前，结尾在最后，中间的主体段按 thesis 预告的顺序排列。这里 thesis 依次提到 cheaper → healthier → greener，所以主体段依次是 Cost → Health → Environment。读者读完 thesis 后会期待按这个顺序看到论证；顺序打乱，文章就显得没有规划。中文写作中段落顺序比较随意，很多学生列提纲时想到哪写到哪，导致 thesis 与正文顺序不一致。
focus: 提纲未围绕 thesis 组织（步骤/顺序/内容）

instruction:
题目：Many children today are overweight. What are the causes of this problem, and what can be done to solve it?
下面是一位同学解释自己提纲的句子，顺序被打乱了。请按正确顺序排列。
sentences: This prompt asks two questions, so my outline needs one body paragraph on causes and another on solutions.
With this structure in mind, I write a thesis: unhealthy diets and too little exercise are to blame, but schools and parents can help.
The first body paragraph explains these two causes, using sugary drinks and long hours in front of screens as examples.
The second body paragraph then suggests one solution for each cause.
For instance, schools could stop selling sugary drinks, and parents could limit their children's screen time.
Finally, I check that my plan answers both questions in the prompt.
hints: 先看哪一句在分析题目本身：题目一共问了几个问题？
With this structure、these two causes、For instance 这些衔接词都要求前面已经出现相应的内容。
For instance 后面举的是原因还是措施？它应该紧跟在介绍哪一段的句子后面？
explanation: 两问题题型（causes + solutions）的提纲必须为两问都留出位置：一段写原因，一段写措施，而且最好让每个措施对应一个原因（含糖饮料 → 学校停售；屏幕时间长 → 家长限制）。规划顺序是：先审题、确定结构（This prompt asks two questions），再写 thesis（With this structure in mind），然后按原因 → 措施展开（The first... / The second... / For instance），最后检查两问是否都已回答（Finally）。中国学生常只抓住话题词（children, overweight）就开始写“肥胖的危害”，漏掉题目真正问的两个问题。
focus: 漏答题目要求（未按题型规划）

instruction:
题目：Some people think that all schools should offer team sports such as football and basketball. Do you agree or disagree?
下面是一份提纲的各行，顺序被打乱了。请按正确顺序排列（例子要放在它所支撑的论点下面）。
sentences: Thesis: agree — team sports teach cooperation and keep students healthy.
Point: cooperation — players learn to work towards a shared goal
e.g. a basketball team planning its moves together before a match
Point: health — regular exercise reduces stress and the risk of obesity
e.g. weekly football training that keeps pupils fit and helps them relax after exams
Conclusion: team sports are worth the time they take from academic lessons
hints: 先找出 thesis 和结尾，再区分哪几行是论点（Point），哪几行是例子（e.g.）。
主体段按 thesis 预告的顺序排列；每个例子紧跟在它所支撑的论点后面。
“赛前一起商量战术”证明的是哪个论点？“保持健康、考后放松”又证明哪个？
explanation: 提纲有层级：论点（理由）在上，例子在下。例子只能用来支撑某一个论点，不能和论点平起平坐，也不能放错位置。这里 thesis 先提 cooperation、后提 health，所以先写合作这一点及其例子（篮球队赛前一起商量战术），再写健康这一点及其例子（每周足球训练让学生保持健康、考后放松）。中国学生受“摆事例”式作文影响，常把例子当成独立段落，或者把几个例子堆在一起，却不对应具体论点。
focus: 把例子当成独立论点（层级混乱）

instruction:
题目：Some people believe that governments should spend money on exploring outer space, while others think this money should be spent on solving problems on Earth. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
下面是一位同学解释自己提纲的句子，顺序被打乱了。请按正确顺序排列。
sentences: The instruction 'discuss both views and give your own opinion' tells me that my outline has three jobs to do, not just one.
Specifically, it must present the case for space exploration, present the case for spending the money on Earth, and make my own position clear.
I deal with the third job first: since I lean towards spending on Earth, my thesis says so, while accepting that a small space budget is still justified.
The first body paragraph then presents the view I find less convincing, including its strongest argument: satellites that improve weather forecasts.
The second body paragraph covers the view I support, with examples such as clean water and disease prevention, so that the essay builds towards my own opinion.
hints: 先找出在分析题目要求的那一句：它提出了一个需要后面展开说明的说法。
Specifically、the third job、then 这些词说明了句子之间的指代和先后关系。
the third job 指的是哪一句列出的第三项任务？作者支持的观点放在第几个主体段？
explanation: discuss both views and give your own opinion 包含三个任务：讨论观点一、讨论观点二、给出自己的观点。提纲必须三项都覆盖：thesis 写明个人立场（这里偏向把钱用于地球上的问题，但承认少量太空预算合理）；Body 1 写自己不太认同的一方，并公平地给出它最强的论据；Body 2 写自己支持的一方，让文章逐步推向自己的观点。中国学生常见的问题是只写自己同意的一方，或者两方都写了却不表态、用“各有道理”结尾，这在雅思评分中会被视为没有完整回应题目。
focus: 漏答题目要求（未按题型规划）

instruction: 下面是四位同学提纲中的 thesis 行。哪一行既有明确的立场，又给出了理由？
content: Prompt: Some people think that children should learn to cook at school. Do you agree or disagree?
options: Thesis: cooking lessons at school have many good points and many bad points.
Thesis: agree — cooking lessons teach healthy habits and independence.
Thesis: cooking is a very important life skill for everyone in today's world.
Thesis: some people agree with this idea, but other people strongly disagree.
option_explanations: 只说“有好有坏”，没有回答同意还是不同意，等于没有立场，也没有具体理由。
正确。agree 表明立场，healthy habits 和 independence 是两个理由，可以分别发展成两个主体段。
这句话只是关于烹饪的泛泛之谈，没有回应“在学校学”这一点，也没有给出理由。
只是复述别人的看法，看不出作者自己的立场。
hints: 先看题目问的是什么：同意还是不同意？
好的 thesis 行＝立场＋理由，两者缺一不可。
先排除看不出作者本人到底同意还是不同意的选项，再看剩下的有没有理由。
explanation: 提纲的第一行应该是 thesis：先写立场（agree / disagree / partly agree），再写 1–2 个理由，例如 Thesis: agree — healthy habits + independence。这样两个理由正好对应两个主体段。中国学生常用“有利有弊”“有人同意，有人反对”开头，这来自中文议论文先“辩证分析”、最后才表态的习惯；但英文议论文要求在开头就明确回答题目。
focus: thesis 无明确立场或立场方向错误

instruction: 这位同学列了四个主体段论点。哪一个偏离了题目？
content:
Prompt: Some people think that primary school children should not be given any homework. Do you agree or disagree?
Thesis: agree — homework does young children more harm than good.
options: Body: young children learn social skills through free play after school.
Body: young pupils who rest properly concentrate better in class.
Body: parents and young children can spend weekday evenings together.
Body: secondary school students already face heavy exam pressure.
option_explanations: 切题：不布置作业，小学生放学后有时间自由玩耍，学会与人相处，支持 thesis。
切题：没有作业，小学生能休息好，第二天上课更专注，支持 thesis。
切题：没有作业，家长和孩子晚上有更多相处时间，支持 thesis。
正确。题目的对象是 primary school children（小学生），这个论点讲的却是 secondary school students（中学生）的考试压力，偏离了题目限定的对象。
hints: 圈出题目中限定“谁”的关键词。
每个论点都必须针对题目限定的对象，换了对象就算跑题。
逐一检查四个选项各自讲的是哪一类学生。
explanation: 列提纲前要圈出题目的关键词，特别是限定对象、地点、范围的词（这里是 primary school children 和 homework）。每个论点都要针对这些关键词。中学生的考试压力虽然也和学业负担有关，但对象换成了中学生，不能支持“小学生不应该有作业”。中国学生审题时常只抓话题大词（homework），忽略限定词，导致论点泛化或跑题。
focus: 论点偏离题目关键词或限定词

instruction: 选出最适合作为 Body 2 的论点：既要支持 thesis，又不能与 Body 1 重复。
content:
Prompt: Some people think that working from home is better than working in an office. Do you agree or disagree?
Thesis: agree — working from home benefits both employees and companies.
Body 1: employees save time — no daily commute
options: Body 2: companies spend less on office rent and electricity.
Body 2: employees no longer waste hours travelling to work.
Body 2: employees gain free time because they skip the commute.
Body 2: some employees feel lonely without their colleagues.
option_explanations: 正确。从公司的角度提出新理由（节省租金和电费），与 Body 1 不重复，并且兑现了 thesis 中对 companies 的承诺。
与 Body 1 重复：不用花几个小时在路上，就是“节省通勤时间”的另一种说法。
与 Body 1 重复：多出来的空闲时间正是省去通勤的直接结果，写成一段会和 Body 1 内容重叠。
这一点说的是居家办公的缺点，与 thesis（同意）方向相反，不能作为支持论点。
hints: 先看 thesis 承诺要写哪几方面的好处。
Body 2 不能只是 Body 1 换个说法，也不能是 Body 1 的直接结果。
thesis 中提到了两类受益者，Body 1 已经写了其中一类。
explanation: 提纲中的每个主体段都要提供一个新的理由。Body 1 讲的是员工省去通勤时间；“不用花几小时在路上”“因此多了空闲时间”都只是同一个理由的换说法或直接结果。thesis 还承诺写 companies 的好处，所以最好的 Body 2 是“公司节省租金和电费”。中文写作中常用同义反复来强调观点，但英文提纲要求各论点彼此独立。
focus: 主体段论点重叠（换说法或互为因果）

instruction: 选出最符合这道题要求的提纲。
content: Prompt: More and more older people are continuing to work after the official retirement age. Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?
options: Thesis: older workers are a great asset to companies. Body 1: experience and practical skills. Body 2: loyalty to their employers.
Thesis: this trend has both advantages and disadvantages. Body 1: benefits — experience, income. Body 2: drawbacks — health risks, fewer jobs for young people.
Thesis: the advantages outweigh the disadvantages. Body 1: drawback — fewer jobs for young people. Body 2: benefits — experience, income, staying active.
Thesis: this trend is growing quickly. Body 1: reasons — longer lives, rising living costs. Body 2: solutions — flexible hours, part-time roles.
option_explanations: 只列了优点，没有讨论缺点，也没有回答“优点是否大于缺点”。
优缺点都列了，但 thesis 只说“有优有缺”，没有判断哪一方更重，没有回答 outweigh 这个核心问题。
正确。thesis 明确判断优点大于缺点；Body 1 先承认缺点，Body 2 写更有分量的优点，既覆盖了两方面，又回答了题目的核心问题。
把题目当成了“原因＋措施”题，没有讨论优缺点，也没有做比较。
hints: 圈出题目最后一句的任务词，它要求你做什么？
outweigh 题既要写到优点和缺点，又要判断哪一方更重。
检查每份提纲的 thesis：有没有给出“哪一方更重”的明确判断？
explanation: “Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?” 是比较型题目，提纲需要：① 在 thesis 中明确判断哪一方更重；② 同时写到优点和缺点；③ 通常先承认较弱的一方，再用更多篇幅写自己认为更重的一方。只写优点、只说“有利有弊”，或者写成原因＋措施，都没有回答题目。中国学生常把各种题型都写成“优缺点各一段＋辩证结尾”，恰恰漏掉了 outweigh 要求的判断。
focus: 漏答题目要求（未按题型规划）

instruction: 阅读这份提纲，选出它最主要的问题。
content:
Prompt: Online shopping is rapidly replacing shopping in physical stores. Is this a positive or negative development?

Thesis: largely positive — online shopping is convenient for consumers and helps small businesses reach new customers.
Body 1: convenience — order at any time, no need to travel to shops
Body 2: time — shoppers no longer spend hours going from store to store
Body 3: limitation — some older people find online payment difficult
options: Body 2 repeats Body 1, and the benefit to small businesses promised in the thesis has no paragraph.
Body 3 should be deleted, because a largely positive essay must not mention any drawbacks.
The thesis has no clear position, because 'largely positive' does not show the writer's view.
Body 1 is off-topic, because convenience has nothing to do with the decline of physical stores.
option_explanations: 正确。“不用跑商店”和“不用花几小时逛店”本质上是同一个理由（省时省力），Body 2 只是换了标签和说法；结果 thesis 预告的 small businesses 反而没有对应的段落。
largely positive 允许承认一个缺点，Body 3 作为让步段是合理的，问题不在这里。
largely positive 已经清楚表明了“总体正面”的立场。
convenience 正是网购取代实体店的主要原因之一，与题目直接相关。
hints: 把每个主体段用中文概括成一句话，比较它们是否在说同一件事。
标签不同（convenience / time）不代表内容不同；还要核对 thesis 预告的每一点是否都有对应的段落。
Body 2 带来的好处，是不是 Body 1 已经包含了？thesis 里还有哪一方没出现？
explanation: 重叠有时很隐蔽：两个主体段的标签不同（convenience 和 time），内容却是同一个理由——不用去实体店，所以省时省力。这样的提纲写出来，Body 2 只能重复 Body 1。同时，thesis 预告了 helps small businesses reach new customers，却没有任何段落论证它。修改：把 Body 1 和 Body 2 合并为 convenience，再加一段 small businesses — sell nationwide without renting a shop。中国学生常把“同一个好处的不同表现”当成不同论点，以为换了标签就是新的点。
focus: 主体段论点重叠（换说法或互为因果）

instruction: 下面四个主体段论点中，哪一个偏离了题目的关键词？
content:
Prompt: International tourism has brought more harm than good to local communities. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Thesis: disagree — on balance, tourism benefits the people who live in tourist destinations.
options: Body: tourism creates jobs for local residents in hotels, restaurants and transport.
Body: tourist income helps to preserve local traditions, crafts and historic buildings.
Body: travelling abroad broadens tourists' horizons and helps them understand other cultures.
Body: tourist spending pays for better roads and public transport that residents also use.
option_explanations: 切题：当地居民获得工作，是旅游业给当地社区带来的好处。
切题：旅游收入用于保护当地传统、手工艺和古建筑，直接关系到当地社区。
正确。“开阔眼界、了解其他文化”是游客自己的收获，而题目问的是旅游对 local communities（当地社区）的影响，这个论点换了受益对象。
切题：改善后的道路和公共交通由当地居民共同使用，是对当地社区的好处。
hints: 圈出题目中说明“对谁有利还是有害”的关键词。
论点必须写旅游对题目指定对象的影响，而不是对其他人的影响。
逐个问：这个好处落在谁身上——当地居民，还是游客？
explanation: 题目的关键限定词是 local communities：论证的必须是旅游对当地居民的利弊。“旅游开阔眼界”是很多学生背过的万能论点，但受益者是游客，用在这里就偏离了题目。列提纲时，要把每个论点和题目关键词逐一对照：这个点说的是不是题目指定的对象？中国学生常把背好的素材直接套进相近的题目，忽略限定词的变化。
focus: 论点偏离题目关键词或限定词

instruction: 阅读这份提纲，选出对它最准确的诊断。
content:
Prompt: Some people believe that longer prison sentences are the best way to reduce crime. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Thesis: partly agree — longer sentences may deter serious criminals, but education and job training are more effective for most offenders.
Body 1: deterrence — the fear of a long sentence may stop some people from committing serious crimes
Body 2: public safety — dangerous criminals are kept away from society for longer
Conclusion: long sentences have a place, but most offenders need other solutions
options: The thesis is too long; an outline thesis should say only 'agree' or 'disagree'.
Only the 'agree' half of the thesis is developed; education and job training get no paragraph.
Body 1 and Body 2 overlap, since both simply describe what happens to criminals in prison.
The outline is off-topic, because the prompt is about crime in general, not about prisons.
option_explanations: thesis 写出立场＋理由正是好提纲的要求，长度合适，不是问题。
正确。thesis 是 partly agree，后半句承诺论证“教育和职业培训对多数罪犯更有效”，但两个主体段都只支持“同意”的一面，结尾提到的 other solutions 在正文里没有任何依据。应把其中一段改为 education and job training — fewer offenders return to crime 之类的论点。
deterrence 讲的是“威慑潜在罪犯、预防犯罪”，public safety 讲的是“把危险罪犯与社会隔离”，作用机制不同，并不重复。
题目本身就是关于“延长刑期能否减少犯罪”，讨论监狱和刑期完全切题。
hints: 把 thesis 拆成两半，分别找一找它们由哪个主体段来论证。
提纲的每个部分都要兑现 thesis 的承诺：thesis 提到的每个理由都应该有对应的主体段。
thesis 中 but 后面的内容，在 Body 1 和 Body 2 里出现了吗？
explanation: 提纲内部必须一致：thesis 预告了什么，主体段就要论证什么。这份 partly agree 的 thesis 有两半——“长刑期对严重罪犯有威慑作用”和“教育与职业培训对多数罪犯更有效”，但两个主体段都只写了“同意”的一面，结尾却得出“大多数罪犯需要其他办法”的结论，没有正文支撑。修改：Body 1 写长刑期的作用（威慑＋保护公众），Body 2 改为 education and job training — fewer offenders return to crime。中国学生常在 thesis 里写“部分同意”显得全面，但列点时只顺着一个方向想，造成立场与论证脱节。
focus: 提纲未围绕 thesis 组织（步骤/顺序/内容）

instruction: 这份提纲的 Body 2 还空着。请补写 Body 2：一个中心论点＋1–2 个支撑关键词（英文短语即可）。要求：兑现 thesis 中还没有展开的那个理由，并且不与 Body 1 重复。
content:
Prompt: Some people believe that every child should learn to play a musical instrument. Do you agree or disagree?

Thesis: agree — learning an instrument trains children's concentration and builds their confidence.
Body 1: concentration — daily practice, paying attention to small details
Body 2: ______
accepted: Body 2: confidence — performing in front of an audience; e.g. a school concert or a small performance for the family
Body 2: self-confidence — mastering a difficult piece gives a sense of achievement; e.g. passing a music exam
Body 2: confidence — playing in a school band helps children overcome stage fright
criteria: 合格条件：(1) Body 2 的中心论点对应 thesis 后半句 builds their confidence（如自信、敢于在别人面前表现、成就感）；(2) 不与 Body 1 重复：不能再写 focus、attention、concentration、memory 等专注力或思维能力方面的内容，换说法也不行；写成与 thesis 无关的新理由（如 making friends）也不合格，因为没有兑现 thesis；(3) 写的是论点，而不是只写一个例子（只写“e.g. a school concert”不合格）；(4) 至少有 1 个支撑关键词（解释或例子）；(5) 英文短语或笔记即可，不要求完整句子，拼写小错误不影响合格。
hints: 先看 thesis：它预告了几个理由？Body 1 已经用掉了哪一个？
Body 2 应该对应 thesis 中还没有展开的那个理由，而且不能是 Body 1 的换说法。
想一想：孩子学会一首曲子、在别人面前演奏时，内心会发生什么变化？
explanation: 补写主体段论点时要做两项检查：① 它对应 thesis 中还没展开的理由（这里是 builds their confidence）；② 它和已有论点不重复。better memory 或 stronger focus 仍属于“专注力/思维能力”一类，会和 Body 1 重叠；在观众面前演奏、完成一首难曲带来的成就感，才是新的角度。示例：Body 2: confidence — performing in front of an audience; e.g. a school concert。中国学生常顺着第一个论点继续联想（练琴 → 专注 → 记忆力好），写出来的两个论点其实属于同一类。
focus: 主体段论点重叠（换说法或互为因果）

instruction: 这份提纲的 Body 2 只是一个例子，不能独立撑起一段。请改写 Body 2（英文短语即可）：先写一个与 thesis 对应的中心论点，再把这个例子（或类似的例子）放在论点后面作为支撑。
content:
Prompt: Some people think that shops should charge customers for every plastic bag. Do you agree or disagree?

Thesis: agree — a charge cuts plastic pollution, and most shoppers adapt to it easily.
Body 1: less pollution — fewer bags in rivers, on beaches and in the sea
Body 2: my local supermarket — started charging for bags last year; hardly anyone complained
accepted: Body 2: easy to accept — the fee is small and people soon bring their own bags; e.g. hardly anyone complained when my local supermarket started charging last year
Body 2: shoppers adapt quickly — reusing bags becomes a habit within weeks; e.g. almost no complaints after my local supermarket introduced a charge
Body 2: little public resistance — the fee is small and easy to avoid; e.g. hardly any complaints about my local supermarket's charge last year
criteria: 合格条件：(1) Body 2 开头是一个概括性的中心论点，并对应 thesis 后半句（顾客容易接受这项收费或很快适应，如 easy to accept、shoppers adapt quickly）；(2) 超市的例子（或其他类似的具体例子）放在论点之后作为支撑，可以用 e.g. 引出，不再单独充当论点；(3) 新论点不与 Body 1（减少塑料污染）重复；(4) 英文短语或笔记即可，不要求完整句子，拼写小错误不影响合格。
hints: 先问自己：“我家附近的超市去年开始收费，几乎没人抱怨”证明的是 thesis 里的哪一个理由？
主体段的第一行应该是一个概括的理由，例子放在理由后面，用来证明这个理由。
thesis 的后半句说的是顾客对收费的反应，把它概括成一个短语作为论点。
explanation: 提纲中每个主体段都应该是“论点＋支撑”：论点是概括的理由，例子是具体的证据。my local supermarket 只是一个具体事例，单独成段时读者不知道它要证明什么。它支撑的是 thesis 后半句 most shoppers adapt to it easily，所以应改为：Body 2: easy to accept — small fee, people soon bring their own bags; e.g. hardly anyone complained at my local supermarket。中国学生受中文作文“摆事实”习惯的影响，常把一个故事或个人经历直接当作一段的中心。
focus: 把例子当成独立论点（层级混乱）

instruction: 这份提纲缺少 thesis。请写一行 thesis（英文，一句话）：表明与提纲一致的立场，并预告两个主体段的理由。
content:
Prompt: Some people think that traditional festivals are no longer relevant in the modern world. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Thesis: ______
Body 1: family bonds — festivals bring relatives together; e.g. shared meals and visits
Body 2: cultural identity — children learn customs, songs and local history
Conclusion: traditional festivals still matter, even if some customs change
accepted: Thesis: disagree — traditional festivals are still relevant because they strengthen family bonds and pass on cultural identity.
Thesis: strongly disagree — festivals still matter, as they bring families together and help children learn about their culture.
Thesis: largely disagree — although some customs are changing, festivals remain important for family ties and cultural identity.
criteria: 合格条件：(1) 写出明确立场，而且必须是 disagree（或 strongly / largely / mostly disagree）。题目的说法是节日 no longer relevant（不再重要），而主体段和结尾都在论证节日仍然重要，所以作者是不同意题目的说法；写 agree 却论证节日重要，属于立场与提纲矛盾，不合格；只写“有利有弊”或不表态也不合格；(2) 同时预告两个理由：家庭联系（family bonds / family ties / bringing families together）和文化认同（cultural identity / customs / heritage），可用同义表达；(3) 一行或一句英文即可，不需要写成完整段落；(4) 不能只复述题目或只写“festivals are important”而没有理由。
hints: 先读主体段和结尾：作者认为传统节日现在还重要吗？
再看题目的说法：no longer relevant。作者的看法和题目的说法是一致还是相反？立场词要据此决定。
thesis 还要预告理由：Body 1 和 Body 2 的关键词各是什么？
explanation: thesis 的立场是针对题目中的说法而言的。题目说传统节日 no longer relevant（不再重要），而提纲论证的是节日仍然重要，所以立场应该是 disagree，而不是 agree。示例：Thesis: disagree — festivals are still relevant because they strengthen family bonds and pass on cultural identity。中国学生看到“我支持过节”就容易写 agree，忽略了题目本身带有否定（no longer）；也有人用“节日有利有弊”敷衍立场。写 thesis 前，先用一句中文复述题目的观点，再判断自己是赞同还是反对它。
focus: thesis 无明确立场或立场方向错误

instruction: 这道题有两问，但提纲目前只回答了第一问。请补写 Body 2（英文短语即可）：针对 Body 1 中的两个原因，各提出至少一个具体措施。
content:
Prompt: In many countries, households throw away large amounts of food. Why does this happen, and what can be done to reduce it?

Thesis: food waste is mainly caused by over-buying and confusion about date labels, but both problems can be tackled.
Body 1 (causes): over-buying — large weekly shops, 'buy one, get one free' offers; date labels — people throw away food that is still safe to eat
Body 2: ______
accepted: Body 2 (solutions): over-buying — plan meals and shop with a list; supermarkets replace multi-buy offers with simple discounts; date labels — clearer labels explaining the difference between 'best before' and 'use by'

Body 2 (solutions): smarter shopping — smaller, more frequent trips with a shopping list; clearer labelling — remove 'best before' dates from fresh fruit and vegetables, plus public campaigns explaining date labels
Body 2 (solutions): for over-buying — limit bulk offers and encourage shopping lists; for label confusion — school lessons and media campaigns on what 'best before' means
criteria: 合格条件：(1) Body 2 写的是措施（回答第二问 what can be done），而不是再写原因、危害或影响；(2) 至少两个措施，分别对应 Body 1 的两个原因：一个针对 over-buying（如购物清单、规划饮食、减少买一送一促销），一个针对日期标签的误解（如更清晰的标签、解释 best before 与 use by 区别的宣传）；只针对其中一个原因的不合格；(3) 措施具体可行，最好写出由谁来做（shoppers、supermarkets、schools、the government 等），像 “people should waste less food” 这样的空话不合格；(4) 英文短语或笔记即可，不要求完整句子，拼写小错误不影响合格。
hints: 先确认题目的第二问问的是什么，Body 2 应该回答它。
好的措施要和前面的原因一一对应：Body 1 列了几个原因，Body 2 就至少要有几个措施。
分别想一想：谁可以让人们少买多余的食物？谁可以让人们看懂食品上的日期？
explanation: 两问题题型（why + what can be done）的提纲必须两问都答：Body 1 写原因，Body 2 写措施，而且措施最好逐一回应原因，这样全文前后呼应。针对 over-buying：shop with a list、plan meals、fewer multi-buy offers；针对日期标签的误解：clearer labels explaining 'best before' and 'use by'、public campaigns。中国学生常只答第一问，或者把第二问写成“我们每个人都应该珍惜粮食”这类口号，缺少具体可行、由谁来做的措施。
focus: 漏答题目要求（未按题型规划）

instruction: 作者认为不应允许学生带手机进学校。下面哪一句最公正、最具体地陈述了反方观点？
content: Thesis: Students should not be allowed to bring mobile phones to school.
options: Some students only want phones at school so that they can play games in class.
Some people say that phones at school are good in some ways for some students.
Some parents argue that children need a phone to contact their family in an emergency.
Everybody knows that phones are harmful, so nobody really wants them at school.
option_explanations: 稻草人：把反方动机写成“只想上课玩游戏”，故意丑化对方。反驳这样的观点没有说服力。
措辞中立，但过于含糊：没有说明反方认为手机“好在哪里”，读者看不到对方的真实理由，后面也无从反驳。
正确。用 Some parents argue that… 中立地陈述反方，并给出具体、真实的理由（紧急情况下联系家人）。
用 Everybody knows / nobody 否认存在反方，既绝对化又不公正，读者会觉得作者在回避分歧。
hints: 公正的反方陈述要同时做到两点：措辞中立，并说出对方的具体理由。
逐个检查：哪些选项贬低了对方？哪些根本没说理由？哪些否认有人反对？
想象一位支持孩子带手机上学的家长：他会认为哪一句准确转述了他的想法？
explanation: 陈述反方观点要做到“公正+具体”：用中性句式（Some parents argue that…），并说出对方最真实的理由。中国学生常见两种问题：一是急于驳倒对方，把反方动机写得很负面（只想玩游戏）；二是只写 Some people say it is good，不给理由，反方段落因此空洞。正确示范：Some parents argue that children need a phone to contact their family in an emergency.
focus: 公正陈述反方：不贬低、不削弱、不夸大

instruction: 作者支持对含糖饮料征税。选择最恰当的词填空，使两句构成“让步+反驳”。
content: It is true that a sugar tax makes soft drinks more expensive for everyone. ________, the extra cost is small, and higher prices encourage people to choose healthier drinks such as water.
options: However
On the contrary
Besides
Therefore
option_explanations: 正确。However 表示转折：前一句承认价格上涨，后一句指出增加的费用很小，而且有健康上的好处，是标准的让步+反驳。
On the contrary 用来否定前面的说法，意思是“事实恰恰相反”。作者刚承认饮料确实变贵了，再说“恰恰相反”就自相矛盾。中文“相反”常被误译成 on the contrary。
Besides 表示“此外”，补充同方向的信息，不能引出反驳。
Therefore 表示因果（“因此”），但“饮料变贵”推不出“增加的费用很小”，逻辑不通。
hints: 先判断空格前后两句是什么关系：补充、因果，还是转折？
前一句是让步（It is true that…），后一句要回到作者立场，所以需要一个表示转折的词。
有一个选项中文意思像“相反”，但它是用来否认前一句的。作者并没有否认前一句。
explanation: 让步之后引出反驳，要用表示转折的词，如 However / Nevertheless / Even so。On the contrary 的意思是“事实恰恰相反”，只用来否定前面的说法（如 The test was not easy. On the contrary, it was very difficult.）。中国学生常把汉语“相反、反而”直译成 on the contrary，造成逻辑矛盾。Besides / In addition 表递进，Therefore 表因果，都不能引出反驳。正确：It is true that a sugar tax makes soft drinks more expensive for everyone. However, the extra cost is small, …
focus: 让步与转折衔接词的正确使用

instruction: 作者认为动物园在今天仍有存在的价值。让步句之后，哪一句是有理由的反驳？
content: Some people argue that zoos are cruel because animals are kept in small spaces. Admittedly, some animals in older zoos still live in cages that are far too small. ________
options: However, I strongly disagree with this view, and I believe that zoos are still necessary today.
However, many modern zoos have replaced small cages with large areas that are similar to natural habitats.
However, zoos are still very good places, so the people who criticise them are simply wrong.
However, this is only one opinion, and in a free society everyone can hold a different opinion.
option_explanations: 只说了“我不同意”和“动物园仍然必要”，没有任何理由。反驳不等于表态，读者不会因此被说服。
正确。直接针对“空间太小”这一理由，用事实说明现代动物园已经用大面积、接近自然的场地代替了小笼子，有理有据。
只是重复立场，并断言批评者“错了”，没有说明为什么，属于无理由的反驳。
回避问题：把反方说成“只是一种观点”，没有回应动物生活空间太小的担忧。
hints: 反方担心的具体问题是什么？反驳必须回应这一点。
反驳 = 转折信号 + 理由或证据。看看哪些选项只有“我不同意”或“他们错了”。
选那个读完后你能说出“为什么”的句子。
explanation: 让步之后，反驳必须给出理由或事实，不能只说 I disagree 或 they are wrong。中国学生写反方段落时，常常只写“However, I don't agree.”就转回自己的观点，在 IELTS 评分中这会被视为观点缺乏展开和支撑。这里的有效反驳直接回应“空间太小”：However, many modern zoos have replaced small cages with large areas that are similar to natural habitats.
focus: 让步后必须有带理由的反驳

instruction: 作者支持实行每周四天工作制。针对下面的反方观点，哪一个反驳正面回应了反方的核心理由？
content: Opposing view: Critics argue that a four-day working week would reduce productivity, because employees would have less time to finish their work.
options: However, a three-day weekend would give employees more time to rest and to spend with their families and friends.
However, most critics of the four-day week are managers who simply want to keep control of their staff.
However, surveys show that many employees would be much happier if they only had to work four days.
However, in several trials, staff finished the same amount of work in four days, partly because meetings were shorter.
option_explanations: 提出的是另一个好处（休息、陪伴家人），没有回应“生产率会下降”这一核心担忧，属于转移话题。
人身攻击：质疑批评者的动机，而不是回应他们的论点。即使动机不纯，论点本身也可能成立。
员工更开心是另一个话题，同样没有说明工作能否按时完成、生产率会不会下降。
正确。直接针对“时间少→工作做不完”这一理由，用试点结果说明工作量并未减少，还解释了原因（会议变短）。
hints: 先圈出反方观点的核心：它担心什么结果？理由是什么？
有效的反驳要正面回应这个核心，而不是换一个优点来说，也不是攻击说话的人。
问自己：读完哪个选项，“生产率会下降”这个说法才真正被动摇了？
explanation: 反驳必须击中反方的核心理由。这里反方的核心是“工作时间变少→生产率下降”，所以有效的反驳要证明工作量仍能完成：However, in several trials, staff finished the same amount of work in four days, partly because meetings were shorter. 中国学生常常“各说各的”：对方说缺点 A，自己就列优点 B（休息和家庭时间、幸福感），看似反驳，其实没有回应；或者攻击反方的动机，这是人身攻击。
focus: 反驳要回应反方的核心理由

instruction: 作者的立场是“公立博物馆应免费开放”。下面是文中的反方段落，请选出最合适的结尾句。
content: Critics argue that free entry would leave museums without the money they need to look after their collections. Admittedly, ticket sales are an important source of income for many museums.
